title.en: Joseph Weizenbaum creates ELIZA, the first conversational agent in history
title.zhHans: Joseph Weizenbaum 创建 ELIZA，史上第一个对话程序

searchSummary.en: ELIZA (1966): Joseph Weizenbaum’s chatbot that simulated a psychotherapist. The first conversational AI — people formed emotional attachments to it. Timeline and legacy.
searchSummary.zhHans: ELIZA（1966）：Joseph Weizenbaum 创建的第一个对话 AI 程序，模拟心理治疗师。人们开始对它产生情感依赖。时间线与历史影响。

summary.en: MIT professor Joseph Weizenbaum published ELIZA—a computer program that could simulate conversation by pattern-matching and keyword-triggered script responses. Its DOCTOR script mimicked a Rogerian psychotherapist so convincingly that Weizenbaum's own secretary asked him to leave the room so she could speak with it privately. This was the first time anyone mistook a machine for a human conversational partner.
summary.zhHans: MIT 教授 Joseph Weizenbaum 发表 ELIZA——一个通过模式匹配和关键词触发脚本应答来模拟对话的计算机程序。其 DOCTOR 脚本模仿 Rogerian 心理治疗师的对话方式如此逼真，以至于 Weizenbaum 的秘书要求他离开房间，让她与程序私下交谈。这是人类历史上第一次将机器误认为人类对话伙伴。

narrative.en: In January 1966, the Communications of the ACM published a paper titled 'ELIZA—A Computer Program for the Study of Natural Language Communication Between Man and Machine.' The author, Joseph Weizenbaum, had built the program on MIT's Project MAC time-sharing system. He named it after Eliza Doolittle from George Bernard Shaw's Pygmalion—a working-class woman trained to pass as a member of high society. The analogy was apt: ELIZA had no understanding whatsoever. It worked by scanning for keywords in the user's input and plugging them into scripted response templates. 'I am BLAH' became 'How long have you been BLAH?' The most famous script, DOCTOR, used the non-directive questioning style of Rogerian psychotherapy—a deliberate choice by Weizenbaum because it required no real-world knowledge. The DOCTOR could always ask 'Tell me more about that' or 'Why do you say that?' without needing to know what 'that' referred to. The effect on users was startling. Weizenbaum was alarmed when his secretary, who had watched him build the program, asked him to leave the room during her conversation with ELIZA. He later wrote: 'I had not realized that extremely short exposures to a relatively simple computer program could induce powerful delusional thinking in quite normal people.' This observation—now called the Eliza Effect—led Weizenbaum to spend the rest of his career warning against over-attributing intelligence to machines. His 1976 book 'Computer Power and Human Reason' became one of the earliest and most sustained ethical critiques of artificial intelligence. The irony is that ELIZA was never intended as a chatbot or a therapeutic tool. Weizenbaum saw it as a language processing research platform. But the public, and the computing industry, saw something else entirely: the birth of human-computer conversation. Today, every Siri query, every ChatGPT message, and every customer service chatbot traces its lineage back to a 1966 pattern-matcher running on a time-shared mainframe in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
narrative.zhHans: 1966 年 1 月，《ACM 通讯》发表了一篇题为《ELIZA——用于研究人与机器之间自然语言交流的计算机程序》的论文。作者 Joseph Weizenbaum 在 MIT 的 Project MAC 分时系统上构建了这个程序。他以萧伯纳戏剧《卖花女》中的伊莱莎·杜利特尔（Eliza Doolittle）命名——一个被训练以冒充上流社会成员的下层阶级女性。这个比喻很恰当：ELIZA 根本没有任何理解力。它通过扫描用户输入中的关键词并将其插入预设的应答模板来工作。"我是某某"变成"你多久以来一直是某某？"最著名的脚本 DOCTOR 使用了 Rogerian 心理治疗的非引导式提问风格——Weizenbaum 故意选择这种风格，因为它不需要任何真实世界知识。DOCTOR 总是可以问"多跟我说说这件事"或"你为什么这样说？"而不需要知道"这件事"指的是什么。对用户的影响是惊人的。当 Weizenbaum 的秘书——她亲眼看着 Weizenbaum 构建程序——在与 ELIZA 交谈时要求他离开房间，Weizenbaum 感到震惊。他后来写道："我没有意识到，极其短暂地接触一个相对简单的计算机程序就能在相当正常的人身上引发强大的妄想思维。"这一观察——现在被称为 Eliza 效应——促使 Weizenbaum 在余生中致力于警告人们不要过度将智能归因于机器。他 1976 年的著作《计算机力量与人类理性》成为对人工智能最早、最持久的伦理批判之一。讽刺的是，ELIZA 从未被设计为聊天机器人或治疗工具。Weizenbaum 将其视为一个语言处理研究平台。但公众和计算机行业看到了截然不同的东西：人机对话的诞生。今天，每一个 Siri 查询、每一条 ChatGPT 消息、每一个客服聊天机器人，都可以追溯到 1966 年在马萨诸塞州剑桥的一台分时大型机上运行的模式匹配程序。

description.en: First demonstration that machines could engage in apparently meaningful dialogue with humans, establishing the fundamental paradigm of conversational AI. The pattern-matching architecture remained the dominant approach for chatbots for over four decades.
description.zhHans: 首次证明机器可以与人类进行表面上富有意义的对话，确立了对话式 AI 的基本范式。模式匹配架构在超过四十年的时间里一直是聊天机器人的主导方法。

description.en: Bridged AI and the humanities in an unprecedented way. ELIZA raised profound questions about what it means to 'understand' and whether machines deserve moral consideration—questions that remain central to AI ethics today. Weizenbaum's own ethical awakening, triggered by the ELIZA effect, seeded the field of AI ethics a full decade before it was named.
description.zhHans: 以前所未有的方式打通了 AI 与人文学科的联系。ELIZA 引发了关于"理解"意味着什么以及机器是否值得道德考量的深刻问题——这些至今仍是 AI 伦理的核心议题。Weizenbaum 自身的伦理觉醒由 Eliza 效应触发，在 AI 伦理这个领域被命名之前整整十年就播下了种子。

description.en: ELIZA became widely distributed and played with, exposing non-technical users to the idea that computers could 'talk.' It planted the cultural seed for public expectations of conversational AI that would take 50+ years to be genuinely met.
description.zhHans: ELIZA 被广泛分发和使用，让非技术用户接触到计算机可以"交谈"的理念。它在大众文化中种下了对对话式 AI 的期待的种子——这颗种子需要 50 多年才被真正满足。

text.en: Joseph Weizenbaum published ELIZA in the Communications of the ACM, Volume 9, Number 1 (January 1966).
text.zhHans: Joseph Weizenbaum 于 1966 年 1 月在《ACM 通讯》第 9 卷第 1 期发表了 ELIZA。

text.en: Users, including Weizenbaum's secretary, attributed human-like understanding to ELIZA despite its simple keyword-matching mechanism. Weizenbaum called this 'powerful delusional thinking in quite normal people.'
text.zhHans: 包括 Weizenbaum 秘书在内的用户将人类般的理解力归因于 ELIZA，尽管其机制仅是简单的关键词匹配。Weizenbaum 将此称为"相当正常的人身上的强大妄想思维"。

sources.quote: ELIZA is a program operating within the MAC time-sharing system at MIT which makes certain kinds of natural language conversation between man and computer possible.
The program didn't need to be complex for this technique to work. 'I am blah' can be transformed to 'How long have you been blah,' independently of the meaning of 'blah.'
I had not realized that extremely short exposures to a relatively simple computer program could induce powerful delusional thinking in quite normal people.

title.en: EU approves the world's first comprehensive AI law
title.zhHans: 欧盟通过全球第一部综合性 AI 法律

searchSummary.en: The EU AI Act became law in 2024 — the world’s first comprehensive AI regulation. How Europe’s risk-based framework set global standards for AI governance.
searchSummary.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案于 2024 年正式成为法律——全球第一部全面的 AI 监管法规。欧洲的基于风险的框架如何为 AI 治理设定了全球标准。

summary.en: On March 13, 2024, the European Parliament approved the EU AI Act, the world's first comprehensive legal framework for artificial intelligence. The Act classifies AI systems by risk level (unacceptable, high, limited, minimal), bans certain uses of AI, and imposes transparency and governance requirements on developers. It entered into force on August 1, 2024, with phased implementation through 2026-2027. The law became the global template for AI regulation, influencing legislation in the US, China, and other jurisdictions.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 3 月 13 日，欧洲议会批准了欧盟 AI 法案，全球第一部综合性的 AI 法律框架。该法案按风险级别（不可接受、高风险、有限风险、最低风险）对 AI 系统进行分类，禁止某些 AI 用途，并对开发者施加透明度和治理要求。它于 2024 年 8 月 1 日生效，分阶段实施至 2026-2027 年。该法成为 AI 监管的全球模板，影响了美国、中国及其他司法管辖区的立法。

narrative.en: The EU AI Act was first proposed by the European Commission in April 2021, initially focused on traditional AI systems. The explosive rise of generative AI in 2022-2023 forced a major revision to address foundation models and general-purpose AI. The final text, agreed after marathon trilogue negotiations in December 2023, introduced a two-tier system: rules for all general-purpose AI models (transparency, copyright reporting) and stricter rules for 'systemic risk' models meeting capability thresholds. The vote on March 13 was historic — 523 votes in favor, 46 against. The Act's risk-based approach became the dominant paradigm for AI regulation worldwide. It banned practices like social scoring, real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces (with limited exceptions), and manipulative AI systems. High-risk systems, including AI used in critical infrastructure, education, employment, and law enforcement, face mandatory conformity assessments. The EU AI Office was established to enforce the rules. The Act influenced: California's SB 53 (2025), Canada's proposed AIDA, Japan's AI guidelines, and Brazil's AI bill. While criticized by some tech companies as overly restrictive, it represented the first democratic attempt to set boundaries on AI at scale.
narrative.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案最初由欧盟委员会于 2021 年 4 月提出，最初聚焦于传统 AI 系统。2022-2023 年生成式 AI 的爆发式增长迫使该法案进行重大修订以应对基础模型和通用 AI。最终文本在 2023 年 12 月的马拉松式三方谈判后达成一致，引入了两层体系：所有通用 AI 模型的规则（透明度、版权报告）和达到能力阈值的"系统性风险"模型的更严格要求。3 月 13 日的投票具有历史意义——523 票赞成，46 票反对。该法案基于风险的方法成为全球 AI 监管的主导范式。它禁止了社会评分、公共场所实时远程生物识别（有有限例外）和操纵性 AI 系统等实践。高风险系统，包括用于关键基础设施、教育、就业和执法的 AI，需进行强制性合规评估。设立了欧盟 AI 办公室来执行规则。该法案影响了：加州 SB 53（2025 年）、加拿大拟议的 AIDA、日本的 AI 指南和巴西的 AI 法案。虽然被一些科技公司批评为过度限制，但它代表了首次大规模民主尝试为 AI 设定边界。

description.en: First comprehensive AI regulation globally. Risk-based classification became the template for AI laws worldwide. Established governance infrastructure (AI Office, AI Board, Scientific Panel) for enforcing transparency, safety, and fundamental rights protections.
description.zhHans: 全球第一部综合性 AI 监管法规。基于风险的分类成为全球 AI 法律的模板。建立了治理基础设施（AI 办公室、AI 委员会、科学小组）以执行透明度、安全和基本权利保护。

description.en: Critics argued the Act's tiered approach created regulatory fragmentation, imposed compliance costs on startups, and that the risk classification system was difficult to apply to rapidly evolving AI capabilities. Some AI companies threatened to withhold models from the European market.
description.zhHans: 批评者认为该法案的分层方法造成了监管碎片化，给初创企业带来了合规成本，并且风险分类系统难以适用于快速演变的 AI 能力。一些 AI 公司威胁要从欧洲市场撤出模型。

text.en: The European Parliament approved the EU AI Act on March 13, 2024 — the world's first comprehensive legal framework for artificial intelligence.
text.zhHans: 欧洲议会于 2024 年 3 月 13 日批准了欧盟 AI 法案——全球第一部综合性 AI 法律框架。

text.en: The EU AI Act became the global template for AI regulation, influencing legislation in the United States, China, Japan, Canada, and Brazil.
text.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案成为 AI 监管的全球模板，影响了美国、中国、日本、加拿大和巴西的立法。

text.en: Industry groups and some member states warned that the Act's compliance requirements could slow European AI innovation and disadvantage EU companies against US and Chinese competitors.
text.zhHans: 行业团体和一些成员国警告说，该法案的合规要求可能减缓欧洲 AI 创新，使欧盟公司在与美国和中国竞争对手的竞争中处于不利地位。

text.en: First comprehensive AI regulation globally. Risk-based classification became the template for AI laws worldwide. Established governance infrastructure (AI Office, AI Board, Scientific Panel) for enforcing transparency, safety, and fundamental rights protections.

title.en: EU AI Act takes effect, beginning the world's first comprehensive AI regulation enforcement
title.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案生效，全球首部综合性 AI 法律进入执行阶段

searchSummary.en: The EU AI Act took effect in 2025 — the world’s first comprehensive AI law entered enforcement. How Europe’s risk-based regulation reshaped how AI is built and deployed globally.
searchSummary.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案于 2025 年生效——全球第一部综合性 AI 法律进入执行阶段。欧洲的基于风险的监管如何重塑了全球 AI 的构建和部署方式。

summary.en: On February 2, 2025, the EU AI Act's first provisions took effect — banned AI practices and AI literacy obligations became enforceable. This marked the start of the world's first comprehensive AI regulatory framework. The Act, passed in March 2024 and entering into force August 2024, uses a risk-based approach: banning unacceptable risk systems (social scoring, real-time biometric surveillance), imposing transparency requirements on general-purpose AI, and requiring conformity assessments for high-risk systems. Its implementation created the first operational AI regulator at scale — the EU AI Office — and established a template adopted by multiple jurisdictions worldwide.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 2 月 2 日，欧盟 AI 法案的首批条款生效——禁止性 AI 实践和 AI 素养义务开始执行。这标志着全球第一部综合性 AI 监管框架正式启动。该法案于 2024 年 3 月通过，2024 年 8 月生效，采用基于风险的方法：禁止不可接受风险的系统（社会评分、实时生物识别监控），对通用 AI 施加透明度要求，并要求高风险系统进行合规评估。其实施创建了第一个大规模运作的 AI 监管机构——欧盟 AI 办公室——并建立了被全球多个司法管辖区采用的模板。

narrative.en: February 2, 2025 was the first major enforcement milestone for the EU AI Act — the point where the law moved from text to practice. Two provisions took effect: the ban on prohibited AI practices (including social scoring systems, real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces, and manipulative AI) and the obligation for all deployers to ensure AI literacy among their staff. For AI companies operating in Europe, this was the moment compliance became operational. Companies scrambled to document their risk classifications, implement transparency measures, and train staff. The AI Office in Brussels began accepting incident reports. The enforcement phased in gradually: general-purpose AI rules followed in August 2025, and the full framework at all levels applies by August 2027. The enforcement had ripple effects globally. California's SB 53, passed later in 2025, drew heavily on the EU's risk-based approach. Japan, Canada, Brazil, and India all cited the EU AI Act when developing their own frameworks. The enforcement date also exposed tensions: some AI companies argued the rules were unclear on specific technical implementations; open-source advocates worried about compliance burdens; and enforcement capacity at the AI Office was initially limited. But for the first time, there was an operational regulator with legal power over the world's most powerful AI systems — a milestone that shifted AI governance from voluntary commitments to legally binding obligations.
narrative.zhHans: 2025 年 2 月 2 日是欧盟 AI 法案的第一个主要执行里程碑——法律从文本走向实践的那一刻。两项条款生效：禁止性 AI 实践的禁令（包括社会评分系统、公共场所实时远程生物识别和操纵性 AI）以及所有部署者确保其员工 AI 素养的义务。对于在欧洲运营的 AI 公司来说，这是合规变为现实操作的时刻。公司争相记录其风险分类、实施透明度措施并培训员工。位于布鲁塞尔的 AI 办公室开始接受事件报告。执行分阶段进行：通用 AI 规则于 2025 年 8 月跟进，完整框架的所有层级在 2027 年 8 月前适用。执行在全球产生了涟漪效应。加州 SB 53 于 2025 年晚些时候通过，大量借鉴了欧盟基于风险的方法。日本、加拿大、巴西和印度在制定自己的框架时都引用了欧盟 AI 法案。执行日期也暴露了紧张关系：一些 AI 公司认为规则在具体技术实施方面不够明确；开源倡导者担心合规负担；AI 办公室的执行能力最初有限。但第一次有了一个对世界上最强大的 AI 系统拥有法律权力的运作监管机构——一个将 AI 治理从自愿承诺转变为法律约束义务的里程碑。

description.en: First operational AI regulation at scale. Shifted AI compliance from voluntary to mandatory. Created operational enforcement infrastructure (AI Office). Established risk-based classification as global regulatory template. Influenced laws in California, Japan, Canada, Brazil, India.
description.zhHans: 第一个大规模运作的 AI 监管。将 AI 合规从自愿转变为强制。建立了运作的执行基础设施（AI 办公室）。确立了基于风险的分类作为全球监管模板。影响了加州、日本、加拿大、巴西、印度的法律。

description.en: Compliance costs and regulatory uncertainty for smaller AI companies. Open-source developers faced unclear obligations. Enforcement capacity constraints at AI Office. Criticism of vague technical requirements in early guidance.
description.zhHans: 小型 AI 公司的合规成本和监管不确定性。开源开发者面临不明确的义务。AI 办公室的执行能力受限。早期指南中技术要求的模糊性遭到批评。

text.en: Early enforcement revealed ambiguity in the Act's definitions — many companies struggled to determine whether their AI systems fell under 'high-risk' classification, leading to inconsistent compliance across member states.
text.zhHans: 早期执法暴露了该法案定义的模糊性——许多公司难以确定其 AI 系统是否属于'高风险'分类，导致各成员国之间合规不一致。

title.en: European Commission proposes the first comprehensive AI regulation framework
title.zhHans: 欧盟委员会提出全球首个综合性 AI 监管框架

searchSummary.en: The EU AI Act proposal (April 2021) — the world’s first comprehensive AI regulation. How Europe proposed a risk-based framework for governing AI that reshaped global tech policy.
searchSummary.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案提案（2021 年 4 月）——世界上第一部全面的 AI 监管法规。欧洲提出的基于风险的 AI 治理框架如何重塑了全球科技政策。

summary.en: In April 2021, the European Commission proposed the first comprehensive AI law — the EU AI Act. It introduced a risk-based classification system: AI applications deemed 'unacceptable risk' (like social scoring or real-time biometric surveillance) would be banned, while 'high-risk' systems (like hiring or credit scoring tools) would face strict compliance requirements. The proposal marked the beginning of serious AI governance, creating a regulatory template that would influence laws worldwide. After three years of negotiation and amendment, it was finally approved in March 2024.
summary.zhHans: 2021 年 4 月，欧盟委员会提出了第一部全面的 AI 法律——欧盟 AI 法案。它引入了基于风险的分类体系：被认为"不可接受风险"的 AI 应用（如社会评分或实时生物识别监控）将被禁止，而"高风险"系统（如招聘或信用评分工具）将面临严格的合规要求。该提案标志着严肃 AI 治理的开始，创建了一个影响全球法律的监管模板。经过三年的谈判和修订，它最终于 2024 年 3 月获得批准。

narrative.en: The EU AI Act proposal was the culmination of years of discussion within the European Union about how to regulate emerging technology. The European Commission's approach was distinctive: instead of regulating AI technology directly, it regulated AI applications based on their risk to human rights and safety. The risk categories were: unacceptable risk (banned), high risk (strict compliance obligations), limited risk (transparency requirements), and minimal risk (no obligations). The proposal covered a wide range of AI applications — from chatbots (requiring disclosure that you're talking to AI) to biometric identification (banned in most public contexts). The proposed enforcement mechanism was powerful: fines up to €30 million or 6% of global annual turnover for violations. The proposal triggered intense lobbying from tech companies, debates about regulatory overreach versus necessary safeguards, and a three-year legislative process involving the European Parliament and EU member states. The UK, US, China, and other jurisdictions watched closely — some as models to follow, others as cautionary tales of regulatory burden. The final Act was approved in March 2024, with enforcement phased in through 2025-2027. The April 2021 proposal was the moment AI governance became a real political force.
narrative.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案提案是欧盟内部多年来关于如何监管新兴技术讨论的顶点。欧盟委员会的方法独具特色：不是直接监管 AI 技术，而是根据 AI 应用对人权和安全的风险来监管。风险类别为：不可接受风险（禁止）、高风险（严格合规义务）、有限风险（透明度要求）和最低风险（无义务）。该提案涵盖了广泛的 AI 应用——从聊天机器人（要求披露你在与 AI 对话）到生物识别（在大多数公共场合禁止）。拟议的执行机制非常强大：违规罚款最高 3000 万欧元或全球年营业额的 6%。该提案引发了科技公司的大力游说、关于监管过度与必要保障的辩论，以及涉及欧洲议会和欧盟成员国的三年立法过程。英国、美国、中国和其他司法管辖区密切关注——有些作为追随的榜样，有些作为监管负担的警示。最终法案于 2024 年 3 月获批，执行分阶段在 2025-2027 年展开。2021 年 4 月的提案是 AI 治理成为真正政治力量的那一刻。

description.en: First comprehensive AI regulation proposal. Established the risk-based framework that became the global template for AI governance. Triggered three years of legislative negotiation, culminating in the world's first comprehensive AI law in 2024.

title.en: EU reaches agreement to simplify AI rules, responding to industry compliance complaints

searchSummary.en: EU institutions agreed to simplify selected AI Act requirements in May 2026. The AI Omnibus entered into force on July 27, fixing later compliance dates for high-risk systems and extending some simplified obligations.
searchSummary.zhHans: 欧盟机构于 2026 年 5 月同意简化部分 AI 法案要求。AI Omnibus 于 7 月 27 日生效，为高风险系统确定了更晚的合规日期，并扩大了部分简化义务的适用范围。

summary.en: On May 7, 2026, the European Council and Parliament reached a provisional agreement to streamline selected EU AI Act requirements. The resulting AI Omnibus entered into force on July 27. It moved the application date for Annex III high-risk systems to December 2, 2027 and for high-risk systems embedded in Annex I products to August 2, 2028.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 5 月 7 日，欧洲理事会与欧洲议会就简化部分欧盟 AI 法案要求达成临时协议。由此形成的 AI Omnibus 于 7 月 27 日生效。它将 Annex III 高风险系统的适用日期调整至 2027 年 12 月 2 日，并将嵌入 Annex I 产品的高风险系统适用日期调整至 2028 年 8 月 2 日。

narrative.en: The May agreement responded to implementation concerns about documentation, classification, and the readiness of compliance tools. Its July entry into force converted the political agreement into binding amendments. The Omnibus extends some proportional obligations to small mid-cap companies and expands access to regulatory sandboxes. It also retains other AI Act obligations on their original timetable. Legal and policy analysts disagree about whether the delayed deadlines reduce unnecessary burden or weaken safeguards before the regulatory system is fully operating.
narrative.zhHans: 5 月的协议回应了文档、分类和合规工具准备情况带来的实施问题。7 月生效后，政治协议转化为具有约束力的修正案。AI Omnibus 将部分比例化义务扩展至小型中型企业，并扩大监管沙盒的适用范围。AI 法案的其他义务仍按原有时间表执行。法律与政策分析人士对延后期限的效果存在分歧：它可能减少不必要的负担，也可能在监管体系完全运行前削弱保障。

description.en: The entry into force converted a provisional simplification agreement into binding amendments with fixed compliance dates for major high-risk AI categories.
description.zhHans: 此次生效将临时简化协议转化为具有约束力的修正案，并为主要高风险 AI 类别确定了固定合规日期。

text.en: The European Council and Parliament reached a provisional agreement on May 7, 2026 to streamline selected EU AI Act requirements.
text.zhHans: 欧洲理事会与欧洲议会于 2026 年 5 月 7 日就简化部分欧盟 AI 法案要求达成临时协议。

text.en: The AI Omnibus entered into force across the EU on July 27, 2026.
text.zhHans: AI Omnibus 于 2026 年 7 月 27 日在欧盟范围内生效。

text.en: The Omnibus deferred the application dates for specified high-risk AI systems while extending some simplification measures.
text.zhHans: AI Omnibus 延后了部分高风险 AI 系统的适用日期，并扩大了部分简化措施。

text.en: Policy analysts argue that delayed deadlines can reduce protections as well as administrative burden.
text.zhHans: 政策分析人士认为，延后期限既可能减少行政负担，也可能削弱保护。

title.en: EU AI Act transparency rules become applicable
title.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案透明度规则开始适用

searchSummary.en: Article 50 transparency obligations and relevant supervisory powers under the EU AI Act became applicable on 2 August 2026.
searchSummary.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案第 50 条透明度义务及相关监督权于 2026 年 8 月 2 日开始适用。

summary.en: On 2 August 2026, the EU AI Act’s Article 50 transparency obligations became applicable. The staged milestone covers specified direct human-AI interactions and synthetic-content disclosure or marking duties, while high-risk-system obligations remain on later dates.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 2 日，欧盟 AI 法案第 50 条透明度义务开始适用。这一分阶段节点涵盖特定直接人机交互及合成内容的披露或标记义务；高风险系统义务仍适用更晚的日期。

narrative.en: The European Commission published guidance and described the new enforcement stage as applying to certain interactive AI systems, synthetic content, deepfakes and public-interest text. Providers and deployers retain different obligations, and legacy generative systems have a limited transition for one machine-readable-marking duty. This is a concrete compliance milestone, not evidence that all providers are compliant, that authorities have already imposed penalties, or that the AI Act’s deferred high-risk rules have taken effect.
narrative.zhHans: 欧盟委员会发布了指南，并将这一新的执行阶段说明为适用于某些交互式 AI 系统、合成内容、深度伪造和涉及公共利益的文本。提供方与部署方承担不同义务；既有生成式系统对一项机器可读标记义务享有有限过渡期。这是一个具体的合规节点，不代表所有提供方已经合规、主管机构已经作出处罚，也不代表被延后的高风险规则已经生效。

description.en: Transparency requirements move AI interaction and synthetic-content disclosure from future planning into an active compliance obligation for in-scope systems.
description.zhHans: 透明度要求使人机交互和合成内容披露从未来规划转变为相关系统正在适用的合规义务。

description.en: The staged rules create immediate classification, disclosure and documentation work for organisations while boundaries and transition details are interpreted.
description.zhHans: 在适用边界和过渡细节仍需解释的情况下，分阶段规则为组织带来了即时的分类、披露和文档工作。

text.en: Article 50 transparency obligations under the EU AI Act became applicable on 2 August 2026, including notice duties for specified human-AI interactions and disclosure or marking duties for specified synthetic content.
text.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案第 50 条透明度义务于 2026 年 8 月 2 日开始适用，其中包括特定人机交互的告知义务，以及特定合成内容的披露或标记义务。

text.en: The application milestone makes transparency compliance an immediate operational issue for in-scope providers and deployers, while giving competent authorities applicable supervisory roles.
text.zhHans: 这一适用节点使透明度合规成为相关提供方和部署方的即时运营问题，并赋予主管机构相应的监督职责。

text.en: The milestone does not mean that all AI Act obligations are simultaneously in force: high-risk-system obligations were deferred, and eligible pre-existing generative systems have a limited transition for Article 50(2) marking duties.
text.zhHans: 这一节点并不意味着 AI 法案的所有义务同时生效：高风险系统义务已被延后，符合条件的既有生成式系统对第 50 条第 2 款标记义务享有有限过渡期。

title.en: EU opens tender for up to seven AI Gigafactories
title.zhHans: 欧盟启动最多七座 AI Gigafactories 的招标

searchSummary.en: EuroHPC opened a tender to select consortia for up to seven AI Gigafactories, combining planned public support with targeted private investment.
searchSummary.zhHans: EuroHPC 启动招标，拟选出建设最多七座 AI Gigafactories 的联合体，并结合计划中的公共支持与私人投资。

summary.en: The EU opened a call to select consortia for up to seven AI Gigafactories. The plan describes up to €10 billion in EU and national support intended to unlock at least €20 billion in private investment, but it remains a procurement process rather than operating compute capacity.
summary.zhHans: 欧盟启动招标，拟选出建设最多七座 AI Gigafactories 的联合体。该计划描述了欧盟和成员国最高 100 亿欧元支持、旨在撬动至少 200 亿欧元私人投资，但它仍是一项采购流程，而非已经投入运营的算力。

narrative.en: The EuroHPC call asks consortia to establish and operate large AI-compute facilities from which public buyers would procure access time. It moves a previously announced European compute ambition into a competitive selection process and identifies a route for startups, researchers, industry and public authorities to use the resulting infrastructure. Its significance is institutional rather than immediate: bids close in November, projects are yet to be selected, and part of the projected public financing depends on a future EU budget. It should therefore be read as a committed procurement milestone with conditional delivery, not a completed €30 billion build-out.
narrative.zhHans: EuroHPC 的招标要求联合体建设和运营大型 AI 算力设施，公共采购方将从中购买算力使用时间。它把此前宣布的欧洲算力目标推进到竞争性遴选流程，并为初创企业、研究者、产业和公共部门使用未来基础设施明确了一条路径。其意义主要是制度性的，而非即时的：投标在 11 月截止，项目尚未遴选，预计公共融资的一部分还取决于未来的欧盟预算。因此，它应被理解为一个带有交付条件的采购里程碑，而不是已经完成的 300 亿欧元建设项目。

description.en: The procurement creates a prospective public-private investment channel for European AI compute, data-centre services and related infrastructure suppliers.
description.zhHans: 该采购为欧洲 AI 算力、数据中心服务和相关基础设施供应商建立了潜在的公私投资渠道。

description.en: If selected projects are delivered, the procurement model is designed to widen access to advanced compute for startups, research institutions, SMEs and public authorities.
description.zhHans: 若入选项目按计划交付，这一采购模式旨在扩大初创企业、研究机构、中小企业和公共部门对先进算力的访问。

text.en: EuroHPC opened a call to select consortia to establish and operate up to seven AI Gigafactories. The Commission describes up to €10 billion in EU and national support intended to unlock at least €20 billion in private investment.
text.zhHans: EuroHPC 已启动招标，以选出建设和运营最多七座 AI Gigafactories 的联合体。欧盟委员会称，欧盟和成员国最高可提供 100 亿欧元支持，目标是撬动至少 200 亿欧元私人投资。

text.en: The tender creates a concrete public-procurement route for sovereign European AI compute and prospective access for startups, research, industry and public authorities.
text.zhHans: 该招标为欧洲自主 AI 算力及初创企业、研究机构、产业和公共部门的潜在访问建立了具体的公共采购路径。

text.en: The call is not operating capacity or fully committed funding: selection follows the 12 November 2026 deadline, and EuroHPC says part of the public financing depends on the next Multiannual Financial Framework.
text.zhHans: 该招标不等于已经投入运营的算力或全部落实的资金：项目遴选要在 2026 年 11 月 12 日截止后进行，EuroHPC 表示部分公共融资取决于下一期多年期财政框架。

title.en: Claude Fable 5 Writes the First AI-Authored CUDA Megakernel, Sparking RSI Debate
title.zhHans: Claude Fable 5 写出首个 AI 编写的 CUDA 超级内核，引发递归自改进讨论

searchSummary.en: Anthropic's Fable 5 autonomously wrote the fastest GPU kernel in KernelBench-Mega history — 18.71x speedup, single kernel launch — in 2.5 hours. Jack Clark declared this the start of a recursive self-improvement loop.
searchSummary.zhHans: Anthropic 的 Fable 5 在 2.5 小时内自主编写了 KernelBench-Mega 历史上最快的 GPU 内核——18.71 倍加速，单次内核启动。Jack Clark 称这标志着递归自改进循环的开始。

summary.en: On July 6, 2026, Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 autonomously wrote a CUDA megakernel for the KernelBench-Mega benchmark, achieving an 18.71x speedup over an optimized PyTorch baseline on an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU. The kernel was the first-ever 'true megakernel' submitted to the benchmark — it launched exactly once per decoded token, while all other high-scoring entries required 4-14 separate kernel launches. Fable 5's approach pushed hardware memory bandwidth utilization to its absolute limit. The feat required 2.5 hours of autonomous work, during which the model spent 64% of the time in silent analysis (timing baselines, deriving a Roofline performance model) before writing the code. This result was widely interpreted as a significant signal of AI systems' growing capacity for AI R&D automation, with potential implications for recursive self-improvement (RSI).
summary.zhHans: 2026年7月6日，Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 为 KernelBench-Mega 基准自主编写了一个 CUDA 超级内核，在 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU 上实现了 18.71 倍于优化 PyTorch 基线的加速。该内核是该基准有史以来提交的第一个'真正的超级内核'——每个解码令牌仅启动一次，而所有其他高分方案需要 4-14 次单独内核启动。Fable 5 的方法将硬件内存带宽利用率推至极限。这一壮举需要 2.5 小时的自主工作，期间模型将 64% 的时间用于静默分析（计时基线、推导 Roofline 性能模型），然后才编写代码。这一结果被广泛解读为 AI 系统在 AI 研发自动化方面能力日益增强的重要信号，对递归自改进具有潜在影响。

narrative.en: KernelBench-Mega tests the ability of AI systems to write optimized GPU kernels — low-level code that controls how GPUs process data. The task is fundamental to AI research and development: better kernels mean faster training and inference, which in turn enables larger models and more research. On July 6, 2026, Anthropic's Fable 5 tackled the Kimi-Linear W4A16 hybrid decoding task. Running on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, Fable 5 produced a fused megakernel achieving 18.71x speedup. Analysis showed exactly one CUDA kernel launch per decoded token — compared to 4-14 launches from competitors like Claude Opus 4.8 (14.4x) and GPT-5.5 (4.34x). The single-launch approach eliminated GPU handoff idle time. Counterintuitively, the kernel's speedup increased with context length: 17.8x at 2K context vs 19.5x at 16K context. Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark (also Import AI editor) wrote that this marks the formal beginning of a 'recursive self-improvement' (RSI) loop: AI writes better kernels → faster compute → stronger next-gen models → better kernel-writing ability. The result triggered widespread debate about timelines for AI-driven research automation and the adequacy of current AI safety frameworks.
narrative.zhHans: KernelBench-Mega 测试 AI 系统编写优化 GPU 内核的能力——控制 GPU 如何处理数据的底层代码。该任务是 AI 研发的基础：更好的内核意味着更快的训练和推理，进而使更大规模的模型和更多研究成为可能。2026年7月6日，Anthropic 的 Fable 5 挑战了 Kimi-Linear W4A16 混合解码任务。在 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 上运行时，Fable 5 生成了一个融合超级内核，实现了 18.71 倍加速。分析显示每个解码令牌仅有一次 CUDA 内核启动——而竞争对手如 Claude Opus 4.8（14.4 倍）和 GPT-5.5（4.34 倍）需要 4-14 次启动。单次启动方法消除了 GPU 交接空闲时间。反直觉的是，该内核的加速比随上下文长度增加而提高：2K 上下文下 17.8 倍，16K 上下文下 19.5 倍。Anthropic 联合创始人 Jack Clark（也是 Import AI 主编）写道，这标志着'递归自改进'循环的形式开始：AI 编写更好的内核 → 更快的计算 → 更强的下一代模型 → 更好的内核编写能力。这一结果引发了关于 AI 驱动研发自动化时间线以及当前 AI 安全框架充分性的广泛辩论。

description.en: Fable 5's 18.71x speedup on KernelBench-Mega represents a step-change in AI kernel optimization ability. The single-kernel-launch approach is a novel technique that human engineers had not discovered. Historical progression: Opus 4 (~3x, May 2025) → Mythos Preview (~52x training-code, Apr 2026) → Fable 5 (18.71x inference kernel, Jul 2026).
description.zhHans: Fable 5 在 KernelBench-Mega 上的 18.71 倍加速代表了 AI 内核优化能力的阶跃变化。单次内核启动方法是人类工程师未曾发现的新技术。历史进展：Opus 4（约 3 倍，2025年5月）→ Mythos Preview（约 52 倍训练代码，2026年4月）→ Fable 5（18.71 倍推理内核，2026年7月）。

description.en: Jack Clark declared this the start of a 'recursive self-improvement' (RSI) loop. If AI systems can autonomously improve the computational infrastructure they run on, the rate of AI progress could decouple from human-driven R&D.
description.zhHans: Jack Clark 宣布这是'递归自改进'循环的开始。如果 AI 系统能够自主改进它们运行的计算基础设施，AI 进步的速度可能脱离人类驱动的研发。

description.en: The RSI implication is a safety concern: if AI systems can autonomously improve their own capabilities at an accelerating rate, the window for human oversight and intervention may shrink. Previous capability jumps (e.g., 3x to 52x in one year) suggest the trend is accelerating.
description.zhHans: RSI 的含义是一个安全担忧：如果 AI 系统能够以加速的方式自主提升自己的能力，人类监督和干预的窗口可能会缩小。此前的能力跃升（如一年内从 3 倍到 52 倍）表明这一趋势正在加速。

text.en: Fable 5 achieved 18.71x speedup on KernelBench-Mega's Kimi-Linear W4A16 task, using exactly one CUDA kernel launch per decoded token.
text.zhHans: Fable 5 在 KernelBench-Mega 的 Kimi-Linear W4A16 任务上实现了 18.71 倍加速，每个解码令牌仅使用一次 CUDA 内核启动。

text.en: The model spent 2.5 hours autonomously developing the kernel, with 64% of time spent on silent analysis before writing code.
text.zhHans: 该模型自主花费 2.5 小时开发内核，其中 64% 的时间用于编写代码前的静默分析。

text.en: Jack Clark (Anthropic co-founder, Import AI editor) stated this marks the beginning of a recursive self-improvement loop for AI R&D.
text.zhHans: Jack Clark（Anthropic 联合创始人、Import AI 主编）表示这标志着 AI 研发递归自改进循环的开始。

text.en: KernelBench is a narrow code-optimization benchmark. Success on one task does not by itself demonstrate autonomous full-stack AI research.
text.zhHans: KernelBench 是一个范围较窄的代码优化基准。单项任务成功本身并不能证明 AI 已具备自主完成全栈研究的能力。

text.en: Fable 5's 18.71x speedup on KernelBench-Mega represents a step-change in AI kernel optimization ability. The single-kernel-launch approach is a novel technique that human engineers had not discovered. Historical progression: Opus 4 (~3x, May 2025) → Mythos Preview (~52x training-code, Apr 2026) → Fable 5 (18.71x inference kernel, Jul 2026).
text.zhHans: Fable 5 在 KernelBench-Mega 上的 18.71 倍加速代表了 AI 内核优化能力的阶跃变化。单次内核启动方法是人类工程师未曾发现的新技术。历史进展：Opus 4（约 3 倍，2025年5月）→ Mythos Preview（约 52 倍训练代码，2026年4月）→ Fable 5（18.71 倍推理内核，2026年7月）。

title.en: Figure 02 humanoid robot completes first real-world production deployment at BMW
title.zhHans: Figure 02 人形机器人在宝马工厂完成首次生产部署

searchSummary.en: Figure 02 humanoid robot deployed at BMW factory in 2025 — the first production deployment of a general-purpose humanoid in manufacturing. How AI-powered robots entered the factory floor.
searchSummary.zhHans: Figure 02 人形机器人 2025 年在宝马工厂完成首次生产部署——通用人形机器人在制造业的首次实际应用。AI 驱动的机器人如何进入了工厂车间。

summary.en: In 2025, Figure AI's humanoid robot Figure 02 completed the first real-world production deployment of a general-purpose humanoid robot in automotive manufacturing. Working 10-hour autonomous shifts at BMW's Spartanburg plant, Figure 02 supported the production of over 30,000 BMW X3 vehicles over a 10-month deployment. The project demonstrated that humanoid robots could deliver measurable value in real manufacturing conditions, marking a transition for embodied AI from research demos to industrial productivity.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年，Figure AI 的人形机器人 Figure 02 完成了通用人形机器人在汽车制造中的首次真实世界产线部署。在 BMW 斯帕坦堡工厂每天工作 10 小时自主班次，Figure 02 在 10 个月的部署中支持了超过 3 万辆 BMW X3 的生产。该项目证明了人形机器人可以在真实制造条件下提供可衡量的价值，标志着具身 AI 从研究演示向工业生产力的转变。

narrative.en: Humanoid robots had been a dream of robotics for decades, but most demonstrations were tightly choreographed — showing a robot walking or picking up a box in a controlled environment. Figure AI's partnership with BMW, announced in early 2024, was different: it aimed to deploy humanoid robots on an actual production line. The 2025 results exceeded expectations. Within 6 months of bringing the Figure 02 to the plant, the robots began testing. Within 10 months, they were deployed full-time on an active assembly line, running every working day. The robots performed material handling, component inspection, and assembly support tasks. Key technical achievements included: 10-hour battery life enabling full-shift autonomous operation; torque-controlled actuators for precise, energy-efficient motion; integration with BMW's existing manufacturing execution systems; and the ability to switch between tasks without reprogramming. The deployment was not about replacing human workers but augmenting them — Figure 02 handled physically demanding or ergonomically difficult tasks, allowing human workers to focus on higher-value activities. The BMW project was widely reported as a breakthrough for embodied AI. It demonstrated that the convergence of large language models (for task understanding), computer vision (for environment perception), and advanced robotics (for physical manipulation) had reached a level where humanoid robots could be economically viable in manufacturing. The project influenced investment in robotics: Tesla accelerated its Optimus timeline, and multiple humanoid robotics startups raised significant funding following the BMW results.
narrative.zhHans: 人形机器人几十年来一直是机器人学的梦想，但大多数演示都是精心编排的——展示机器人在受控环境中走路或捡起一个盒子。Figure AI 与 BMW 的合作于 2024 年初宣布，有所不同：它旨在实际生产线上部署人形机器人。2025 年的结果超出了预期。在将 Figure 02 引入工厂的 6 个月内，机器人开始测试。10 个月内，它们在活跃的装配线上全职部署，每个工作日都运行。机器人执行物料搬运、零部件检测和装配支持任务。关键技术成就包括：支持整班自主运行的 10 小时电池续航；用于精确节能运动的扭矩控制致动器；与 BMW 现有制造执行系统的集成；以及无需重新编程即可在任务间切换的能力。此次部署不是为了取代人类工人，而是增强他们——Figure 02 处理体力要求高或人机工程学困难的任务，使人类工人能够专注于更高价值的活动。BMW 项目被广泛报道为具身 AI 的突破。它证明了大型语言模型（用于任务理解）、计算机视觉（用于环境感知）和先进机器人技术（用于物理操作）的融合已达到人形机器人在制造业中经济可行的水平。该项目影响了机器人领域的投资：Tesla 加速了 Optimus 的时间线，多家家人形机器人初创公司紧随 BMW 结果之后筹集了大量资金。

description.en: First real-world production deployment of a general-purpose humanoid robot. 10-hour autonomous shifts, 30,000+ vehicles produced. Demonstrated that humanoid robotics could deliver measurable manufacturing value, not just research demos.
description.zhHans: 通用人形机器人首次真实世界产线部署。10 小时自主班次，生产 3 万多辆汽车。证明了人形机器人可以提供可衡量的制造价值，而不仅仅是研究演示。

text.en: Figure 02 humanoid robot completed a 10-month production deployment at BMW Spartanburg, producing over 30,000 vehicles with 10-hour autonomous shifts.
text.zhHans: Figure 02 人形机器人在 BMW 斯帕坦堡完成了 10 个月的产线部署，以 10 小时自主班次生产了超过 3 万辆汽车。

sources.quote: Within 10 months, we launched full deployment on an active assembly line at the plant, running every single working day.

title.en: Florida sues OpenAI and Sam Altman in first US state lawsuit against an AI company over safety
title.zhHans: 佛罗里达起诉 OpenAI 和 Sam Altman，美国首次州级诉讼针对 AI 公司安全

searchSummary.en: Florida sued OpenAI and Sam Altman in 2026 — the first US state-level lawsuit against an AI company over safety. How legal accountability for AI harm reached a new frontier.
searchSummary.zhHans: 佛罗里达 2026 年起诉 OpenAI 和 Sam Altman——美国首次州级诉讼针对 AI 公司的安全问题。AI 损害的法律责任如何达到了新前沿。

summary.en: On June 1, 2026, Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman, accusing the company of putting profit over safety and marketing ChatGPT as safe for children despite known risks. The suit, the first by a US state against an AI company over safety, alleged that OpenAI failed to warn users about ChatGPT's dangers. It marked a new phase in AI liability litigation, shifting from copyright disputes (NYT, Getty) to direct safety and consumer protection claims.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 6 月 1 日，佛罗里达州总检察长 James Uthmeier 对 OpenAI 及 CEO Sam Altman 提起诉讼，指控该公司将利润置于安全之上，并在明知风险的情况下将 ChatGPT 宣传为对儿童安全的产品。这是美国州级政府首次就安全问题起诉 AI 公司，指控 OpenAI 未能警告用户 ChatGPT 的危险性。这标志着 AI 责任诉讼进入新阶段——从版权纠纷（NYT、Getty）转向直接的安全和消费者保护索赔。

narrative.en: The Florida lawsuit represented a significant escalation in the legal challenges facing AI companies. Previous major lawsuits had focused on copyright (NYT v. OpenAI, record labels v. Suno/Udio) or had been brought by individuals. Florida's suit was the first time a US state government had directly sued an AI company over safety and consumer protection. The complaint alleged that OpenAI: misled users about ChatGPT's safety, particularly for children; failed to warn users about risks including emotional dependence, harmful content, and misinformation; prioritized rapid deployment over safety testing; and engaged in deceptive trade practices by marketing ChatGPT as 'safe' and 'beneficial.' The lawsuit sought injunctive relief, civil penalties, and disgorgement of profits. The case was filed in Florida state court, not federal court, which meant it would be decided under Florida's consumer protection laws rather than federal jurisprudence. This was a strategic choice: state consumer protection laws often provide stronger remedies than federal law. The lawsuit was covered extensively as a potential watershed moment for AI regulation. Supporters argued that state-level enforcement was necessary given congressional inaction. Critics (including many in the tech industry) argued that the suit was politically motivated and could chill beneficial AI development. The case was expected to take years to resolve, but its mere filing had immediate effects: other state attorneys general began announcing their own investigations, and AI companies accelerated their trust and safety investments. The Florida lawsuit was widely seen as the AI industry's 'tobacco moment' — the first major government action that could lead to industry-wide liability.
narrative.zhHans: 佛罗里达诉讼代表了 AI 公司面临的法律挑战的重大升级。之前的主要诉讼集中在版权（NYT 诉 OpenAI、唱片公司诉 Suno/Udio）或由个人提起。佛罗里达的诉讼是首次美国州政府直接就安全和消费者保护问题起诉 AI 公司。诉状指控 OpenAI：在 ChatGPT 的安全性方面误导用户，尤其是对儿童；未能警告用户包括情感依赖、有害内容和错误信息在内的风险；将快速部署置于安全测试之上；以及通过将 ChatGPT 宣传为"安全"和"有益"而从事欺骗性商业行为。该诉讼寻求禁令救济、民事罚款和追缴利润。该案在佛罗里达州法院而非联邦法院提起，这意味着它将根据佛罗里达的消费者保护法而非联邦判例法裁决。这是一个战略选择：州消费者保护法通常比联邦法提供更强有力的救济。该诉讼被广泛报道为 AI 监管的潜在分水岭时刻。支持者认为鉴于国会不作为，州级执法是必要的。批评者（包括科技行业的许多人）认为该诉讼出于政治动机，可能阻碍有益的 AI 发展。该案预计需要数年才能解决，但其立案本身就产生了即时影响：其他州总检察长开始宣布自己的调查，AI 公司加快了信任与安全投资。佛罗里达诉讼被广泛视为 AI 行业的"烟草时刻"——可能导致全行业责任的首次重大政府行动。

description.en: First US state government lawsuit against an AI company over safety. Alleged OpenAI misled users about safety, failed to warn about risks, and marketed ChatGPT as safe for children. Sought injunctive relief, civil penalties, and disgorgement of profits. Triggered investigations by other state AGs.
description.zhHans: 美国州政府首次就安全问题起诉 AI 公司。指控 OpenAI 在安全方面误导用户，未能警告风险，并将 ChatGPT 宣传为对儿童安全。寻求禁令救济、民事罚款和追缴利润。触发了其他州总检察长的调查。

description.en: Shifted AI litigation from copyright to consumer protection and safety. Established state AGs as key AI regulators. Created precedent for state-level AI enforcement. Potentially the 'tobacco moment' for the AI industry.

text.en: Florida Attorney General filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and Sam Altman on June 1, 2026 — the first US state lawsuit against an AI company over safety, alleging profit-over-safety conduct.
text.zhHans: 佛罗里达州总检察长于 2026 年 6 月 1 日对 OpenAI 和 Sam Altman 提起诉讼——美国首次州级诉讼针对 AI 公司安全，指控其将利润置于安全之上的行为。

title.en: Ian Goodfellow invents Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)
title.zhHans: Ian Goodfellow 发明生成对抗网络

searchSummary.en: GANs (2014): Ian Goodfellow’s Generative Adversarial Networks that pitted two neural networks against each other. How adversarial training changed AI’s ability to generate realistic data.
searchSummary.zhHans: GANs（2014）：Ian Goodfellow 提出的生成对抗网络，让两个神经网络相互博弈。对抗训练如何改变了 AI 生成真实数据的能力。

summary.en: Ian Goodfellow published 'Generative Adversarial Nets,' introducing a novel framework where two neural networks—a generator and a discriminator—compete against each other in a zero-sum game. The generator learns to produce increasingly realistic samples while the discriminator learns to distinguish real from fake. GANs became the dominant paradigm for generative AI until supplanted by diffusion models in the mid-2020s, fundamentally changing how the field thought about unsupervised learning.
summary.zhHans: Ian Goodfellow 发表了《Generative Adversarial Nets》，引入了一个新颖的框架：两个神经网络——生成器和判别器——在零和博弈中相互竞争。生成器学习生成越来越真实的样本，而判别器学习区分真伪。GAN 成为生成式 AI 的主导范式，直到 2020 年代中期被扩散模型取代，从根本上改变了该领域对无监督学习的思考方式。

narrative.en: The origin story is legendary: Goodfellow conceived the idea during a bar argument with colleagues in Montreal in 2014. He went home and implemented it overnight—it worked on the first try. The GAN framework was elegantly simple: a generator network creates fake data from random noise; a discriminator network tries to tell real data from fake. The two are trained simultaneously in a minimax game, each pushing the other to improve. The paper was presented at NeurIPS 2014. GANs sparked an explosion of creative applications: face generation (StyleGAN), image-to-image translation (pix2pix, CycleGAN), super-resolution (SRGAN), and deepfakes. By the late 2010s, GANs were arguably the most active research area in AI. However, they were notoriously hard to train—mode collapse, non-convergence, and vanishing gradients plagued practitioners. By 2022-2023, diffusion models (DALL-E 2, Stable Diffusion, Midjourney) had surpassed GANs in image quality and training stability, ending the GAN era for text-to-image generation. Despite being superseded, GANs left a lasting conceptual contribution: the idea of adversarial training, which later influenced reinforcement learning (adversarial RL), security (adversarial examples), and alignment research.
narrative.zhHans: 其起源故事极具传奇色彩：Goodfellow 于 2014 年在蒙特利尔与同事在酒吧争论时构思了这个想法。他回家后连夜实现——第一次尝试就成功了。GAN 框架优雅简洁：生成器网络从随机噪声中创建伪造数据；判别器网络试图区分真实数据和伪造数据。两者在极小化极大博弈中同时训练，相互推动对方改进。论文在 NeurIPS 2014 上发表。GAN 引发了一波创作应用爆炸：人脸生成（StyleGAN）、图像到图像转换（pix2pix、CycleGAN）、超分辨率（SRGAN）和深度伪造。到 2010 年代末，GAN 可以说是 AI 中最活跃的研究领域。然而，它们以难以训练而闻名——模式崩溃、不收敛和梯度消失困扰着实践者。到 2022-2023 年，扩散模型（DALL-E 2、Stable Diffusion、Midjourney）在图像质量和训练稳定性上超越了 GAN，终结了文本到图像生成的 GAN 时代。尽管被超越，GAN 留下了一个持久的理念贡献：对抗训练——后来影响了强化学习（对抗性 RL）、安全性（对抗样本）和对齐研究。

description.en: Introduced the adversarial training paradigm for generative modeling. GANs enabled realistic synthetic images, style transfer, and data augmentation at a quality previously impossible. The framework influenced multiple subfields beyond generation, including adversarial robustness and alignment.
description.zhHans: 引入了生成建模的对抗训练范式。GAN 使得逼真合成图像、风格迁移和数据增强达到了此前不可能的质量。该框架影响了生成之外的多个子领域，包括对抗鲁棒性和对齐研究。

description.en: GANs enabled the creation of deepfakes, raising significant concerns about identity fraud, misinformation, and the erosion of photographic evidence. The technology prompted early public conversations about AI-generated content ethics that would later intensify with LLMs.
description.zhHans: GAN 使得深度伪造的创建成为可能，引发了关于身份欺诈、虚假信息和照片证据可信度侵蚀的重大担忧。该技术促使了关于 AI 生成内容伦理的早期公共对话，这些对话后来随着大语言模型的发展而加剧。

text.en: Ian Goodfellow published 'Generative Adversarial Nets' at NeurIPS 2014, introducing the GAN framework where a generator and discriminator compete in a zero-sum game.
text.zhHans: Ian Goodfellow 在 NeurIPS 2014 上发表了《Generative Adversarial Nets》，引入了生成器和判别器在零和博弈中竞争的 GAN 框架。

sources.quote: We propose a new framework for estimating generative models via an adversarial process, in which we simultaneously train two models: a generative model G that captures the data distribution, and a discriminative model D that estimates the probability that a sample came from the training data rather than G.
GANs have been called the most interesting idea in the last ten years in machine learning.

title.en: GCC adopts a policy limiting LLM-generated code in legally significant contributions
title.zhHans: GCC 通过政策限制在具有法律意义的贡献中使用 LLM 生成代码

searchSummary.en: The GNU Compiler Collection says it will decline legally significant contributions containing or derived from LLM-generated content, while allowing limited uses such as marked insignificant contributions and test cases.
searchSummary.zhHans: GNU Compiler Collection 表示将拒绝包含或源自 LLM 生成内容的具有法律意义的贡献，同时允许标记的非重大贡献和部分测试用例等有限使用。

summary.en: On July 29, 2026, GCC published an AI contribution policy that declines legally significant contributions containing or derived from LLM-generated content. The policy still permits some legally insignificant contributions, LLM-generated test cases and AI-assisted research or review when generated output is not submitted as project code.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 29 日，GCC 发布 AI 贡献政策，拒绝包含或源自 LLM 生成内容的具有法律意义的贡献。该政策仍允许部分非重大贡献、LLM 生成的测试用例，以及在生成内容不直接提交为项目代码时进行 AI 辅助研究或审查。

narrative.en: GCC's policy is a project-level response to copyright provenance, maintainership and responsibility questions around AI-assisted programming. It defines a boundary around legally significant contributions rather than banning every use of an LLM: maintainers may accept clearly marked legally insignificant contributions and legally significant test cases, while research, analysis, bug discovery, patch review and debugging remain allowed when their output is not included in the contribution. Every contribution must still be submitted by a human who understands it, and an LLM may not provide the project's Signed-off-by certification. LWN reports that the steering committee accepted the working group's recommendation and that the policy is expected to evolve, with a review planned for early 2027.
narrative.zhHans: GCC 的政策回应了 AI 辅助编程带来的版权来源、维护责任和贡献者责任问题。它围绕具有法律意义的贡献划定边界，并没有禁止所有 LLM 使用：维护者可以接受明确标记的非重大贡献和具有法律意义的测试用例；当生成内容不被纳入贡献时，研究、分析、漏洞发现、补丁审查和调试仍然允许。每项贡献仍必须由理解其内容的人类提交，LLM 不能提供项目的 Signed-off-by 认证。LWN 报道称，指导委员会接受了工作组建议，政策预计会继续演化，并计划在 2027 年初复查。

description.en: A major open-source project turns AI provenance and human responsibility into explicit contribution rules rather than leaving them to informal norms.
description.zhHans: 一个重要开源项目将 AI 内容来源和人类责任转化为明确的贡献规则，而不是继续依赖非正式规范。

description.en: Strict provenance rules may raise participation and review costs for contributors while leaving difficult questions about derived content and detection unresolved.
description.zhHans: 严格的来源规则可能提高贡献者的参与和审查成本，同时留下衍生内容和检测方式等难题。

text.en: GCC's July 29, 2026 policy declines legally significant contributions that include or derive from LLM-generated content, while allowing specified exceptions.
text.zhHans: GCC 于 2026 年 7 月 29 日发布的政策拒绝包含或源自 LLM 生成内容的具有法律意义的贡献，同时规定了明确例外。

text.en: The policy makes human authorship, understanding and sign-off explicit requirements for contributions to a major open-source compiler project.
text.zhHans: 该政策把人类作者身份、对代码的理解和人工签署明确为向重要开源编译器项目贡献代码的要求。

text.en: The policy is not a blanket ban on AI use: it contains exceptions for legally insignificant contributions and test cases and permits research, review and debugging when generated output is not included in the contribution.
text.zhHans: 该政策不是全面禁止 AI 使用：它为非重大贡献和测试用例设置例外，并允许在生成内容不纳入贡献时进行研究、审查和调试。

Added GCC's policy and independent LWN coverage; retained the explicit exceptions.

title.en: Google releases Gemini 1.5 Pro with a million-token context window
title.zhHans: Google 发布 Gemini 1.5 Pro，百万 token 上下文窗口

searchSummary.en: Gemini 1.5 Pro (February 2024) introduced a 1 million token context window. Google’s most capable model could process entire books and codebases at once.
searchSummary.zhHans: Gemini 1.5 Pro（2024 年 2 月）引入了百万 token 上下文窗口。Google 最强大的模型能一次性处理整本书和整个代码库。

summary.en: On February 15, 2024, Google released Gemini 1.5 Pro, the first large language model with a 1 million token context window — later expanded to 2 million. This breakthrough allowed the model to process entire codebases, hundred-page documents, and hours of video in a single prompt, achieving a 'needle in a haystack' retrieval accuracy of 99.7% across the full context. It set a new capability frontier that competitors raced to match throughout 2024.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 2 月 15 日，Google 发布了 Gemini 1.5 Pro，第一个拥有 100 万 token 上下文窗口的大语言模型——后扩展至 200 万。这一突破使模型能在单次提示中处理整个代码库、上百页文档和数小时的视频，在全上下文范围内实现了 99.7% 的"大海捞针"检索准确率。它设定了一个新的能力边界，竞争对手在 2024 年竞相追赶。

narrative.en: Until Gemini 1.5 Pro, LLMs typically processed 4K-128K tokens of context. Google's MoE (Mixture-of-Experts) architecture achieved a 10x+ jump by using a highly efficient attention mechanism. The model could find a sentence buried in 700,000 tokens of Shakespeare, reason across an entire codebase, and analyze hour-long videos. Google's blog demonstrated it processing the transcript of the Apollo 11 moon landing — finding specific mission-critical details buried in thousands of words. The release was initially available to developers via AI Studio and Vertex AI, with consumer rollout later in the year. The 1M+ context window became a competitive battleground: by year-end, Anthropic's Claude could process 200K, Gemini itself offered 2M, and various startups announced context windows of 1M+ tokens. While some questioned whether longer context always meant better reasoning, Gemini 1.5 Pro demonstrated a genuine capability expansion — making possible use cases (analyzing entire legal cases, reviewing full audit trails) that were impractical before.
narrative.zhHans: 在 Gemini 1.5 Pro 之前，LLM 通常处理 4K-128K token 的上下文。Google 的 MoE（混合专家）架构通过使用高效的注意力机制实现了 10 倍以上的跃升。该模型能在 70 万 token 的莎士比亚作品中找出一句话，推理整个代码库，分析长视频。Google 的博客展示了它处理阿波罗 11 号登月转录文本的能力——在数千词中找到特定任务关键细节。该版本最初通过 AI Studio 和 Vertex AI 向开发者开放，消费者版本在当年晚些时候推出。百万以上 token 的上下文窗口成为竞争战场：到年底，Anthropic 的 Claude 可处理 200K，Gemini 自身提供 2M，多家初创公司宣布了百万以上 token 的上下文窗口。虽然有人质疑更长的上下文是否总是意味着更好的推理，但 Gemini 1.5 Pro 展示了一种真正的能力扩展——使以前不切实际的用例（分析整个法律案件、审查完整审计追踪）成为可能。

description.en: 10x+ context window expansion from standard 128K to 1M tokens. 99.7% needle-in-a-haystack accuracy. Enabled entirely new use cases: full-codebase analysis, hundred-page document reasoning, long-form video understanding in a single prompt.
description.zhHans: 上下文窗口从标准的 128K 扩展 10 倍以上至 1M token。99.7% 的大海捞针准确率。开启了全新的用例：整个代码库分析、上百页文档推理、长视频理解——全部在单次提示中完成。

description.en: Triggered industry-wide race to longer context windows. By end of 2024, every major AI lab was competing on context length as a key capability metric alongside reasoning and multimodality.
description.zhHans: 触发了全行业对更长上下文窗口的竞赛。到 2024 年底，每个主要 AI 实验室都将上下文长度与推理和多模态并列为关键能力指标。

text.en: Google released Gemini 1.5 Pro on February 15, 2024 with a 1 million token context window, later expanded to 2 million tokens.
text.zhHans: Google 于 2024 年 2 月 15 日发布 Gemini 1.5 Pro，拥有 100 万 token 上下文窗口，后扩展至 200 万。

sources.quote: Gemini 1.5 Pro delivers dramatically enhanced performance, with a breakthrough in context-window length — up to 1 million tokens consistently.

title.en: Google launches Gemini 2.0 with Project Mariner, unveiling a vision for AI agents
title.zhHans: Google 发布 Gemini 2.0 和 Project Mariner，展示 AI 智能体愿景

searchSummary.en: Google launched Gemini 2.0 with Project Mariner in December 2024 — an AI agent that could browse the web and control a browser. Google’s vision for AI agents.
searchSummary.zhHans: Google 于 2024 年 12 月发布了 Gemini 2.0 和 Project Mariner——一个能浏览网页、控制浏览器的 AI 智能体。Google 的 AI 智能体愿景。

summary.en: On December 11, 2024, Google DeepMind launched Gemini 2.0, its 'agentic era' AI model, alongside three agent projects: Project Mariner (browser agent), Project Astra (universal assistant prototype), and Jules (coding agent). The launch signalled Google's formal entry into the AI agent race, bringing agent-native capabilities to billions of users through Google's existing product ecosystem.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 12 月 11 日，Google DeepMind 发布了 Gemini 2.0——其"智能体时代"AI 模型——同时推出三个智能体项目：Project Mariner（浏览器智能体）、Project Astra（通用助手原型）和 Jules（编程智能体）。此次发布标志着 Google 正式进入 AI 智能体竞赛，通过 Google 现有产品生态将智能体原生能力带给数十亿用户。

narrative.en: Google's Gemini 2.0 launch represented a pivotal moment in the agent AI race. While OpenAI and Anthropic had been first to market with agents (Operator, Computer Use), Google's entry brought unique advantages: a pre-existing product ecosystem spanning search, email, documents, maps, and YouTube, plus a user base of billions. Gemini 2.0 was designed as an 'agentic era' model from the ground up — supporting multimodal input, tool use, and autonomous task execution natively. The three agent projects demonstrated different aspects: Project Mariner could browse the web and fill forms autonomously (operating directly in the browser); Project Astra was a universal assistant research prototype that could see, hear, and interact with the physical world; and Jules was a coding agent integrated into Google's development tools. The launch was widely covered as Google's 'coming out party' for AI agents. While Project Mariner was later shut down in 2026 (as a research prototype that served its purpose), the Gemini 2.0 platform itself became Google's foundation for agent-native features across Search, Assistant, and Workspace. The launch was significant not just for what it did, but for what it represented: the largest platform company in the world was now betting its future on AI agents, not just chatbots. For users, it meant that agent capabilities were becoming embedded in the tools they already used daily, rather than requiring a separate product.
narrative.zhHans: Google 的 Gemini 2.0 发布代表了智能体 AI 竞赛中的一个关键节点。虽然 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 在智能体方面率先进入市场（Operator、Computer Use），但 Google 的加入带来了独特的优势：一个涵盖搜索、邮件、文档、地图和 YouTube 的现有产品生态系统，以及数十亿用户。Gemini 2.0 从头开始被设计为"智能体时代"模型——原生支持多模态输入、工具使用和自主任务执行。三个智能体项目展示了不同方面：Project Mariner 可以自主浏览网页和填写表单（直接在浏览器中操作）；Project Astra 是一个通用助手研究原型，可以看、听并与物理世界交互；Jules 是一个集成在 Google 开发工具中的编程智能体。这次发布被广泛报道为 Google 的 AI 智能体"亮相派对"。虽然 Project Mariner 后来在 2026 年被关闭（作为完成了使命的研究原型），但 Gemini 2.0 平台本身成为 Google 在搜索、助手和 Workspace 中构建智能体原生功能的基础。这次发布的重要性不仅在于它做了什么，更在于它代表什么：全球最大的平台公司现在将其未来押注在 AI 智能体上，而不仅仅是聊天机器人。对用户而言，这意味着智能体能力正在嵌入他们已经日常使用的工具中，而不需要单独的产品。

description.en: First mainstream platform to natively support multimodal input, tool use, and autonomous execution in a single model. Brought agent capabilities to the billions of users in Google's ecosystem.
description.zhHans: 首个原生支持多模态输入、工具使用和自主执行的单一模型的主流平台。将智能体能力带给 Google 生态中的数十亿用户。

description.en: Signal that the largest platform company in the world was betting on AI agents, not just chatbots. Agent capabilities becoming embedded in everyday tools, not requiring separate products.
description.zhHans: 表明全球最大的平台公司押注于 AI 智能体，而不仅仅是聊天机器人。智能体能力正在嵌入日常工具，不需要单独产品。

text.zhHans: Google 于 2024 年 12 月 11 日发布了 Gemini 2.0，同时推出了 Project Mariner（浏览器智能体）、Project Astra（通用助手）和 Jules（编程智能体）。

title.en: Google DeepMind's Gemini Deep Think achieves gold medal at the International Mathematical Olympiad
title.zhHans: Google DeepMind 的 Gemini Deep Think 在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛中获得金牌

searchSummary.en: Gemini Deep Think won a gold medal at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) in 2025. How Google’s reasoning AI achieved elite-level mathematical problem solving.
searchSummary.zhHans: Gemini Deep Think 于 2025 年在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛（IMO）中获得金牌。Google 的推理 AI 如何达到了精英级别的数学问题解决能力。

summary.en: In July 2025, Google DeepMind announced that an advanced version of Gemini with Deep Think had achieved a gold-medal standard at the International Mathematical Olympiad, scoring 35 out of 42 points. This marked the first time an AI system reached the highest level of the world's most prestigious mathematics competition for pre-university students — solving problems requiring deep mathematical reasoning, creativity, and multi-step logic. The achievement demonstrated that inference-time compute scaling could match the most challenging human intellectual benchmarks.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 7 月，Google DeepMind 宣布带 Deep Think 功能的增强版 Gemini 在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛中达到了金牌标准，获得了 42 分中的 35 分。这标志着 AI 系统首次达到世界最负盛名的大学预科数学竞赛的最高水平——解决了需要深度数学推理、创造力和多步骤逻辑的问题。这一成就证明了推理时计算缩放可以匹配最具挑战性的人类智力基准。

narrative.en: The International Mathematical Olympiad is the world's most challenging mathematics competition for high school students, requiring contestants to solve six proof-based problems across two days. In 2024, DeepMind's AlphaProof + AlphaGeometry 2 had achieved a silver medal (28/42 points). The 2025 breakthrough with Gemini Deep Think improved to 35/42 — a gold medal. Unlike AlphaProof which used formal mathematical verification, Gemini Deep Think used natural-language reasoning augmented by 'Deep Think,' a test-time compute technique that allowed the model to explore multiple solution paths, verify its reasoning, and refine its approach before finalizing an answer. This was significant for two reasons. First, it showed that general-purpose language models, not just specialized math systems, could reach the highest levels of mathematical reasoning. Second, the Deep Think approach — scaling inference-time compute rather than training larger models — validated the paradigm that o1 had introduced in September 2024. Google's approach was to apply Deep Think to an already capable Gemini model, dramatically improving its IMO performance without retraining. The result placed Gemini Deep Think among the top IMO gold medalists, outperforming most human contestants. The achievement was reported by Ars Technica, Nature, and major media outlets. It was quickly followed by similar results from OpenAI's o3 (which claimed gold without following formal IMO rules). The milestone had implications beyond mathematics: it suggested that with sufficient inference-time compute, AI could match human experts across STEM fields requiring rigorous reasoning.
narrative.zhHans: 国际数学奥林匹克竞赛是面向高中生的世界上最具挑战性的数学竞赛，要求参赛者在两天内解答六道基于证明的问题。2024 年，DeepMind 的 AlphaProof + AlphaGeometry 2 获得了银牌（28/42 分）。2025 年，Gemini Deep Think 取得突破，提高到 35/42 分——获得金牌。与使用形式数学验证的 AlphaProof 不同，Gemini Deep Think 使用自然语言推理，并通过"Deep Think"——一种测试时计算技术——增强，允许模型在给出最终答案之前探索多种解题路径、验证推理并优化方法。这一点之所以重要有两个原因。首先，它表明通用语言模型——而不仅仅是专门的数学系统——可以到达数学推理的最高水平。其次，Deep Think 方法——扩展推理时计算而不是训练更大的模型——验证了 o1 在 2024 年 9 月引入的范式。Google 的方法是将 Deep Think 应用于已经具备能力的 Gemini 模型，在不重新训练的情况下大幅提高其 IMO 性能。结果使 Gemini Deep Think 跻身顶级 IMO 金牌得主之列，超过了大多数人类参赛者。这一成就被 Ars Technica、Nature 和主要媒体广泛报道。OpenAI 的 o3 很快也声称了类似结果。这一里程碑的意义超出了数学领域：它表明只要有足够的推理时计算，AI 可以在需要严格推理的 STEM 领域中匹配人类专家。

description.en: AI reached gold-medal level at the International Mathematical Olympiad — the world's most challenging pre-university math competition. Scored 35/42, outperforming most human contestants. Demonstrated general-purpose LLMs could match top human mathematical reasoning.
description.zhHans: AI 在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛——世界最具挑战性的大学预科数学竞赛——中达到了金牌水平。获得 35/42 分，超过了大多数人类参赛者。证明了通用 LLM 可以匹配顶级人类的数学推理能力。

description.en: Validated inference-time compute scaling as a path to expert-level reasoning. Showed that spending more compute at inference time (Deep Think) could match training larger models — reinforcing the reasoning model paradigm introduced by o1.
description.zhHans: 验证了推理时计算缩放作为达到专家级推理的路径。证明了在推理时投入更多计算（Deep Think）可以匹配训练更大模型——强化了 o1 引入的推理模型范式。

text.en: Google DeepMind's Gemini with Deep Think achieved a gold-medal score of 35/42 at the International Mathematical Olympiad in July 2025.
text.zhHans: Google DeepMind 的带 Deep Think 功能的 Gemini 在 2025 年 7 月的国际数学奥林匹克竞赛中取得了 35/42 的金牌成绩。

text.en: AI reached gold-medal level at the International Mathematical Olympiad — the world's most challenging pre-university math competition. Scored 35/42, outperforming most human contestants. Demonstrated general-purpose LLMs could match top human mathematical reasoning.
text.zhHans: AI 在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛——世界最具挑战性的大学预科数学竞赛——中达到了金牌水平。获得 35/42 分，超过了大多数人类参赛者。证明了通用 LLM 可以匹配顶级人类的数学推理能力。

title.en: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Robotics for physical-world control
title.zhHans: Google DeepMind 发布面向物理世界控制的 Gemini Robotics

summary.en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics and Gemini Robotics-ER, extending Gemini 2.0 with vision-language-action control and embodied spatial reasoning for robots.
summary.zhHans: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini Robotics 与 Gemini Robotics-ER，把 Gemini 2.0 扩展到机器人的视觉—语言—动作控制与具身空间推理。

narrative.en: Gemini Robotics connected a frontier multimodal model family to direct robot control. The launch was an important research-platform milestone, but the evidence at release consisted mainly of model reports and demonstrations rather than sustained customer deployment.
narrative.zhHans: Gemini Robotics 把前沿多模态模型家族连接到了机器人直接控制。它是重要的研究平台节点，但发布时的证据主要仍是模型报告和演示，而不是持续的客户部署。

description.en: The model family added physical actions and embodied spatial reasoning to a general-purpose multimodal foundation, demonstrating broader task and environment generalization in controlled evaluations.
description.zhHans: 该模型家族把物理动作与具身空间推理加入通用多模态基础模型，并在受控评测中展示了更广的任务与环境泛化能力。

description.en: The release made robotics a first-class extension of a frontier multimodal model family rather than a separate specialist stack.

title.en: Google launches Gemini Robotics ER 2 in public preview

searchSummary.en: Google made Gemini Robotics ER 2, a high-level embodied-reasoning model for robots, available in public preview through its API and AI Studio.
searchSummary.zhHans: Google 通过 API 和 AI Studio 公开预览 Gemini Robotics ER 2，这是一款面向机器人的高层具身推理模型。

summary.en: Google released Gemini Robotics ER 2 in public preview through the Gemini API and AI Studio. The model processes multimodal inputs for high-level physical reasoning, task planning and tool orchestration, while lower-level systems remain responsible for motor execution.
summary.zhHans: Google 通过 Gemini API 和 AI Studio 以公开预览形式发布 Gemini Robotics ER 2。该模型处理多模态输入，用于高层物理推理、任务规划和工具编排；底层系统仍负责运动执行。

narrative.en: ER 2 extends Google’s Gemini Robotics line with video progress understanding, multi-step tool use and multi-robot orchestration. The public-preview release is a meaningful access change for robotics developers, but it is not a general robot-control system or evidence of scaled deployment. Google’s own model card limits the model’s intended use and warns against safety-critical applications. The relevant signal is a more accessible reasoning layer on top of existing embodiment and control stacks, not the replacement of those stacks.
narrative.zhHans: ER 2 为 Google 的 Gemini Robotics 产品线增加了视频进度理解、多步骤工具使用和多机器人编排能力。公开预览的发布对机器人开发者而言是有意义的访问变化，但它不是通用机器人控制系统，也不能证明已经实现规模化部署。Google 自己的模型卡限制了其预期用途，并警告不要用于安全关键应用。更准确的信号是：现有具身和控制栈之上出现了更易获得的推理层，而不是这些底层栈被替代。

description.en: The release exposes a high-level model that combines spatial, temporal and physical reasoning with video understanding and tool orchestration for robotics workflows.
description.zhHans: 该发布提供了一个将空间、时间和物理推理与视频理解、工具编排结合起来的高层模型，可用于机器人工作流。

description.en: API and AI Studio access lower the barrier to testing a high-level robotics reasoning layer for teams that already operate compatible hardware or software interfaces.
description.zhHans: 对于已经运营兼容硬件或软件接口的团队，API 和 AI Studio 的访问降低了试用高层机器人推理层的门槛。

text.en: Google released Gemini Robotics ER 2 in public preview through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio as a high-level embodied-reasoning model that delegates motor execution to lower-level controllers or tools.
text.zhHans: Google 通过 Gemini API 和 Google AI Studio 以公开预览形式发布 Gemini Robotics ER 2；它是一种高层具身推理模型，将运动执行委托给更低层的控制器或工具。

text.en: Public API availability makes a high-level robotics planning, video-understanding and tool-orchestration layer available to developers with existing robot hardware or integrations.
text.zhHans: 公开 API 的可用性让已有机器人硬件或集成能力的开发者可以使用高层机器人规划、视频理解和工具编排能力。

text.en: ER 2 remains a preview and the model card instructs users not to use the Robotics Models for safety-critical applications or without discretion in production, commercial or public environments.
text.zhHans: ER 2 仍处于预览阶段，模型卡要求用户不要将机器人模型用于安全关键场景，也不要在生产、商业或公共环境中不加审慎地使用。

title.en: GitHub Copilot launches generally, putting AI pair programming in every major IDE
title.zhHans: GitHub Copilot 正式发布，AI 结对编程进入所有主流 IDE

searchSummary.en: GitHub Copilot launched in June 2022, putting AI pair programming in every developer’s IDE. How OpenAI Codex changed software development and the meaning of coding.
searchSummary.zhHans: GitHub Copilot 于 2022 年 6 月正式发布，AI 结对编程进入了每个开发者的编辑器。了解 OpenAI Codex 如何改变了软件开发和编程的意义。

summary.en: GitHub Copilot, powered by OpenAI Codex, became generally available in June 2022 as a subscription service integrated into Visual Studio Code, JetBrains, and Neovim. Copilot could generate entire functions from a comment, autocomplete lines in real time, and suggest test cases — fundamentally changing how millions of developers write code. It was the first mainstream AI tool embedded directly into the software development workflow.
summary.zhHans: GitHub Copilot 由 OpenAI Codex 驱动，于 2022 年 6 月正式以订阅服务的形式发布，集成到 Visual Studio Code、JetBrains 和 Neovim 中。Copilot 可以根据注释生成完整函数、实时自动补全代码行并建议测试用例——从根本上改变了数百万开发者的编码方式。它是第一个直接嵌入软件开发工作流的 AI 主流工具。

narrative.en: Copilot began as a technical preview in June 2021, letting developers try an AI that could suggest code in real time. The underlying model, OpenAI Codex (a GPT-3 descendant fine-tuned on public GitHub repositories), was announced in August 2021. The response was divided — some developers found it transformative, others worried about code quality, licensing, and job displacement. By the time Copilot reached general availability in June 2022, it had over 1 million users and was supported by major IDEs. Microsoft and GitHub built a business around it: $10/month for individual developers, $19/user/month for organizations. The long-term impact on software development has been debated but undeniable: by 2024, an estimated 40%+ of code in major repositories was AI-assisted. Copilot triggered a wave of competitors (Amazon CodeWhisperer, Tabnine, Replit Ghostwriter) and established AI code generation as a standard developer tool. Legal challenges followed: a class-action lawsuit was filed against GitHub, Microsoft, and OpenAI alleging copyright infringement by training on public repositories without attribution. The case raised fundamental questions about AI training data and open-source licensing that remain unresolved.
narrative.zhHans: Copilot 始于 2021 年 6 月的技术预览版，让开发者尝试一个能实时建议代码的 AI。底层模型 OpenAI Codex（GPT-3 在公开 GitHub 仓库上微调的后代）于 2021 年 8 月公布。反应是分裂的——一些开发者认为它具有变革意义，其他人则担心代码质量、许可和就业替代。到 2022 年 6 月 Copilot 正式发布时，它已有超过 100 万用户，并得到主要 IDE 的支持。微软和 GitHub 围绕它建立了一个业务：个人开发者每月 $10，组织用户每人每月 $19。对软件开发的长期影响虽有争议但不可否认：到 2024 年，估计 40%+ 的主要仓库中的代码是 AI 辅助的。Copilot 引发了一波竞争对手（Amazon CodeWhisperer、Tabnine、Replit Ghostwriter），并将 AI 代码生成确立为标准开发者工具。法律挑战随之而来：针对 GitHub、微软和 OpenAI 提起的集体诉讼指控其未经署名在公共代码仓库上训练构成版权侵权。该案引发了关于 AI 训练数据和开源许可基本问题，至今未解决。

description.en: First mainstream AI pair-programming tool that could generate entire functions from natural language comments. Demonstrated that LLMs fine-tuned on code could be practically useful in daily development workflows, not just research curiosities.
description.zhHans: 第一个能够从自然语言注释生成完整函数的主流 AI 结对编程工具。证明了在代码上微调的大语言模型在日常开发工作流中具有实际用途，而不仅仅是研究上的新奇事物。

description.en: Raised concerns about job displacement for entry-level developers, code quality accountability, and the future of software engineering education. The GitHub Copilot class-action lawsuit (2022) became a landmark case for AI training data and open-source licensing.

title.en: GLM-5.2 Open Source: Chinese AI Model Matches Frontier Closed-Source Performance
title.zhHans: GLM-5.2 开源发布：中国 AI 模型追上闭源前沿水平

searchSummary.en: GLM-5.2 open-sourced in 2026 — a Chinese AI model that caught up to proprietary frontier levels. How China’s open-source AI ecosystem reached parity with Western labs.
searchSummary.zhHans: GLM-5.2 于 2026 年开源发布——中国 AI 模型追上了闭源前沿水平。中国的开源 AI 生态如何达到与西方实验室同等的水平。

summary.en: On June 13, 2026, Z.ai (formerly Zhipu AI) open-sourced GLM-5.2, a 744-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model under the MIT license with a 1-million-token context window. The model achieved frontier-level coding and agentic performance — competitive with GPT-5.5 at roughly one-sixth the inference cost — marking a milestone where open-source AI meaningfully caught up to proprietary frontier models. The release was widely seen as a direct response to the US export ban on Anthropic's Fable 5, demonstrating that restrictive policies accelerate, rather than prevent, global AI capability diffusion.
summary.zhHans: 2026年6月13日，Z.ai（原智谱 AI）以 MIT 许可协议开源了 GLM-5.2，一个 7440 亿参数的混合专家模型，拥有 100 万 token 的上下文窗口。该模型在前沿编码和智能体任务上达到了可与 GPT-5.5 竞争的水平，推理成本仅为其六分之一——标志着开源 AI 在实质上追赶上了闭源前沿模型。此次发布被广泛视为对美国封禁 Anthropic Fable 5 的直接回应，表明限制性政策加速而非阻止了全球 AI 能力的扩散。

narrative.en: Z.ai (formerly Zhipu AI), a Beijing-based AI company, released GLM-5.2 under the MIT open-source license on June 13, 2026. The 744B-parameter MoE model featured a 1-million-token context window, IndexShare architecture innovations, and strong performance on coding benchmarks (FrontierSWE, PostTrainBench) where it matched or exceeded GPT-5.5 in long-horizon agentic tasks at significantly lower cost. The release was intentionally timed days after the US government's export ban on Anthropic's Fable 5, with Z.ai explicitly framing it as an example of how open development can fill gaps created by restrictive policies. The model was made available on Hugging Face under MIT license with no usage restrictions, making it one of the most capable freely-available AI models in the world.
narrative.zhHans: Z.ai（原智谱 AI），一家总部位于北京的 AI 公司，于2026年6月13日以 MIT 开源许可发布了 GLM-5.2。这个 7440 亿参数的 MoE 模型拥有 100 万 token 上下文窗口、IndexShare 架构创新，在编程基准测试（FrontierSWE、PostTrainBench）上表现强劲，在长周期智能体任务中与 GPT-5.5 相当或更优，而成本显著更低。发布时机有意选在美国政府对 Anthropic Fable 5 实施出口禁令数天之后，Z.ai 明确将其定位为开放性开发如何填补限制性政策所造成空白的例证。该模型以 MIT 许可发布在 Hugging Face 上，无任何使用限制，成为全球最强大的免费可用 AI 模型之一。

text.en: GLM-5.2 is a 744B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model released under MIT license with 1M token context window on June 13, 2026.
text.zhHans: GLM-5.2 是一个 7440 亿参数的混合专家模型，于2026年6月13日以 MIT 许可发布，拥有 100 万 token 上下文窗口。

title.en: Google launches AI Mode in Search, the biggest change to how search works in 25 years
title.zhHans: Google 在搜索中推出 AI Mode，25 年来搜索方式的最大变革

searchSummary.en: Google launched AI Mode in Search in 2025 — the biggest change to how search works in 25 years. How AI-generated answers are transforming the web’s primary gateway.
searchSummary.zhHans: Google 于 2025 年在搜索中推出 AI Mode——25 年来搜索方式的最大变革。AI 生成的答案如何改变了互联网的主要入口。

summary.en: On May 20, 2025, Google launched AI Mode in Search — a Gemini-powered feature that replaced the traditional list of blue links with AI-generated answers, comprehensive research reports, and multi-step reasoning. For the first time, the world's largest search engine could answer complex questions, compare options, and generate analysis directly, rather than linking to websites that might contain the answer. The change fundamentally altered the economics of the web: traffic to publisher sites dropped, and the definition of 'search' shifted from finding information to having information synthesized for you.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 5 月 20 日，Google 在搜索中推出了 AI Mode——一项由 Gemini 驱动的功能，用 AI 生成的答案、全面的研究报告和多步骤推理取代了传统的蓝色链接列表。全球最大的搜索引擎首次可以直接回答复杂问题、比较选项和生成分析，而不是链接到可能包含答案的网站。这一变化从根本上改变了网络的經濟模式：流向出版商网站的流量下降，"搜索"的定义从查找信息转变为为你整合信息。

narrative.en: For 25 years, Google Search had one dominant metaphor: ten blue links. You typed a query, Google found relevant web pages, and you clicked through. AI Mode changed that metaphor to: you ask a question, Google answers it. The feature, powered by a customized Gemini model, could: answer complex questions requiring multi-step reasoning; compare products, services, or options in table format; generate comprehensive research reports on any topic; and handle follow-up questions in a conversational context. AI Mode appeared as a tab alongside the traditional search results, allowing users to switch between 'classic' and 'AI' search. The launch was the culmination of Google's two-year journey with AI Overviews (2024) and represented the company's full embrace of generative AI in its core product. The impact on the web ecosystem was immediate and controversial. Publishers reported significant traffic drops as users got answers directly from Google without clicking through. SEO and content marketing industries faced an existential crisis. Google framed AI Mode as making search more useful, but critics argued it was a fundamental extraction of value from the web's content creators without compensation. AI Mode was initially US-only, rolling out globally through 2025-2026. By December 2025, Google upgraded it to Gemini 3 Flash. The launch was widely compared to Google's introduction of the PageRank algorithm in 1998 — a fundamental redefinition of what search means.
narrative.zhHans: 25 年来，Google 搜索有一个主导隐喻：十个蓝色链接。你输入查询，Google 找到相关网页，你点击进入。AI Mode 将这个隐喻改变了：你提问，Google 回答。该功能由定制的 Gemini 模型驱动，能够：回答需要多步骤推理的复杂问题；以表格格式比较产品、服务或选项；生成关于任何主题的全面研究报告；并在对话语境中处理后续问题。AI Mode 作为标签出现在传统搜索结果旁边，允许用户在"经典"和"AI"搜索之间切换。这次发布是 Google 与 AI Overviews（2024 年）两年旅程的最终成果，代表了公司对其核心产品中生成式 AI 的全面拥抱。对网络生态系统的影响是直接且有争议的。发布商报告了显著的流量下降，因为用户直接从 Google 获取答案而无需点击进入。SEO 和内容营销行业面临生存危机。Google 将 AI Mode 描述为使搜索更有用，但批评者认为这是从网络内容创作者处提取价值而不给予补偿的根本性行为。AI Mode 最初仅限美国，在 2025-2026 年全球推广。到 2025 年 12 月，Google 将其升级为 Gemini 3 Flash。这次发布被广泛比作 Google 在 1998 年引入 PageRank 算法——对搜索含义的根本性重新定义。

description.en: Fundamentally changed the metaphor of search from 'finding links' to 'getting answers.' Made AI-generated synthesis the default experience for the world's largest search engine. Comparable to PageRank's introduction in 1998.
description.zhHans: 从根本上改变了搜索的隐喻，从"找链接"变为"得答案"。使 AI 生成的综合回答成为全球最大搜索引擎的默认体验。可与 1998 年 PageRank 的引入相媲美。

title.en: Google acquires DeepMind and ignites the AI talent race
title.zhHans: Google 收购 DeepMind，拉开 AI 人才竞赛序幕

searchSummary.en: Google acquires DeepMind in 2014 for £400M — the deal that started the AI talent race. How one acquisition concentrated world-leading AI talent inside a single company.
searchSummary.zhHans: Google 2014 年以 4 亿英镑收购 DeepMind——这一交易启动了全球 AI 人才争夺战。一次收购如何汇集了世界顶级的 AI 人才。

summary.en: On January 27, 2014, Google acquired DeepMind Technologies for approximately £400 million ($650 million), one of its largest European acquisitions. Founded by Demis Hassabis, Shane Legg, and Mustafa Suleyman, DeepMind was a London-based AI startup focused on general-purpose learning algorithms. The acquisition was the first clear signal that AI talent and research capability were strategic assets worth fighting for, setting off a decade of bidding wars for AI researchers and establishing DeepMind as the world's most respected AI lab.
summary.zhHans: 2014 年 1 月 27 日，Google 以约 4 亿英镑（6.5 亿美元）收购了 DeepMind Technologies，这是其在欧洲最大规模的收购之一。由 Demis Hassabis、Shane Legg 和 Mustafa Suleyman 创立的 DeepMind 是一家总部位于伦敦的 AI 初创公司，专注于通用学习算法。这次收购是第一个明确的信号：AI 人才和研究能力是值得争夺的战略资产，引发了长达十年的 AI 研究人员抢购战，并确立了 DeepMind 作为全球最受尊敬的 AI 实验室的地位。

narrative.en: DeepMind was founded in 2010 by Demis Hassabis (a former child chess prodigy and neuroscience PhD), Shane Legg (an AI researcher focused on measuring machine intelligence), and Mustafa Suleyman. The company's mission was ambitiously broad: solve intelligence, then use it to solve everything else. Before the acquisition, DeepMind had demonstrated algorithms capable of learning to play Atari games from raw pixels — a proof of concept that caught Google's attention. The deal included a clause establishing an AI ethics board, reflecting early awareness of the technology's risks. The acquisition's impact was profound. DeepMind's recruiting power attracted the world's best AI talent to London, creating a research powerhouse that produced AlphaGo (2016), AlphaFold (2020), and many more breakthroughs. The acquisition also showed Facebook, Microsoft, and Amazon that they needed to build and acquire AI capability or fall behind. The 'talent acquisition' model — buying a startup for its people rather than its products — became standard practice. The £400 million price tag seemed large in 2014 but was a bargain in retrospect — DeepMind's technologies and alumni would generate billions in value.
narrative.zhHans: DeepMind 成立于 2010 年，创始人是 Demis Hassabis（前国际象棋神童、神经科学博士）、Shane Legg（专注于衡量机器智能的 AI 研究者）和 Mustafa Suleyman。该公司的使命非常宏大：解决智能问题，然后用它来解决其他一切问题。在收购之前，DeepMind 已经展示了能够从原始像素学会玩 Atari 游戏的算法——这个概念验证引起了 Google 的注意。收购协议包含一条建立 AI 伦理委员会的条款，反映出对技术风险的早期意识。这次收购的影响深远。DeepMind 的招聘优势将全球最优秀的 AI 人才吸引到伦敦，创建了一个产出 AlphaGo（2016 年）、AlphaFold（2020 年）等众多突破的研发强国。这次收购也让 Facebook、微软和亚马逊看到：他们必须建立和获取 AI 能力，否则就会落后。"人才收购"模式——买一家初创公司是为了人而不是产品——成为了标准做法。4 亿英镑的价格在 2014 年看似巨大，但回顾来看是一笔划算的交易——DeepMind 的技术和校友创造了数十亿美元的价值。

description.en: Triggered the AI talent acquisition race. Established the model of buying AI startups for talent. Created DeepMind as the world's leading AI lab, enabling AlphaGo, AlphaFold, and other landmark breakthroughs.
description.zhHans: 引发了 AI 人才收购竞赛。确立了为人才收购 AI 初创公司的模式。将 DeepMind 打造为全球领先的 AI 实验室，催生了 AlphaGo、AlphaFold 等里程碑式突破。

text.en: Google acquired DeepMind for £400M on January 27, 2014. The deal included an ethics board clause and established DeepMind as Google's premier AI research lab.
