title.en: OpenAI says GPT-2 is 'too dangerous to release' — the first mainstream AI safety debate goes global
title.zhHans: OpenAI 称 GPT-2"危险不宜发布"——首场主流 AI 安全辩论席卷全球

searchSummary.en: OpenAI said GPT-2 was “too dangerous to release” in 2019 — the first mainstream AI safety debate. How a language model sparked global conversation about responsible AI.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 2019 年称 GPT-2「太危险不发布」——第一次主流 AI 安全大辩论。一个语言模型如何引发了全球对 AI 负责任开发的讨论。

summary.en: On February 14, 2019, OpenAI announced GPT-2, a language model capable of generating remarkably coherent text. But instead of releasing it fully, OpenAI withheld the complete model, citing 'concerns about malicious applications.' The decision sparked an intense global debate: was OpenAI responsibly cautious or grandstanding for attention? The staged rollout — releasing progressively larger versions over months — became a template for AI safety disclosure. It also marked the first time ordinary people heard the argument that AI could be too dangerous to release, permanently changing how the public thought about AI risk.
summary.zhHans: 2019 年 2 月 14 日，OpenAI 发布了 GPT-2，一个能够生成极其连贯文本的语言模型。但 OpenAI 没有完全发布它，而是以"对恶意应用的担忧"为由扣留了完整模型。这一决定引发了一场激烈的全球辩论：OpenAI 是谨慎负责还是在吸引眼球？分阶段发布——在数月内逐步发布越来越大的版本——成了 AI 安全披露的模板。这也标志着普通人第一次听到"AI 可能危险到不宜发布"的论点，永久改变了公众对 AI 风险的看法。

narrative.en: GPT-2 was a significant leap forward in text generation. With 1.5 billion parameters, it could write news articles, stories, and dialogue that were difficult to distinguish from human writing. OpenAI's blog post included samples — including the famous 'unicorn story' — that went viral. But the headline was the refusal to release the full model. OpenAI's decision was controversial within the AI community. Critics argued that the staged release was a publicity stunt — GPT-2 was impressive but not revolutionary, and withholding the model was overblown. Supporters countered that the paper had already demonstrated the model's ability to generate convincing fake news, spam, and impersonations, and that responsible disclosure was essential. The debate itself became the story, generating front-page coverage in major newspapers. The staged release unfolded over nine months: February 2019 (small 124M model), May 2019 (medium 355M), August 2019 (large 774M), and finally November 2019 (full 1.5B model). By the time the full model was released, no catastrophic misuse had occurred — but the precedent was set. OpenAI had established the 'staged disclosure' model that would later be used for GPT-4 and other advanced models. More importantly, the GPT-2 debate moved AI safety from an academic concern to a dinner-table topic. It made the general public aware that AI development involved decisions about what to build and what to hold back.
narrative.zhHans: GPT-2 在文本生成方面是一次重大飞跃。拥有 15 亿参数，它可以写出难以与人类写作区分开的新闻文章、故事和对话。OpenAI 的博客文章包含了示例——包括著名的"独角兽故事"——迅速走红。但头条新闻是拒绝发布完整模型。OpenAI 的决定在 AI 社区内引发了争议。批评者认为分阶段发布是一种公关噱头——GPT-2 令人印象深刻但并非革命性，扣留模型是小题大做。支持者反驳说论文已经展示了模型生成令人信服的假新闻、垃圾邮件和冒充的能力，负责任的披露至关重要。辩论本身成了故事，登上了主要报纸的头版。分阶段发布历时九个月：2019 年 2 月（小号 1.24 亿参数）、2019 年 5 月（中号 3.55 亿）、2019 年 8 月（大号 7.74 亿）、最终 2019 年 11 月（完整 15 亿模型）。到完整模型发布时，没有发生灾难性的滥用——但先例已经确立。OpenAI 建立了后来用于 GPT-4 和其他高级模型的"分阶段披露"模式。更重要的是，GPT-2 的辩论将 AI 安全从一个学术关注变成了餐桌话题。它让普通公众意识到 AI 发展涉及关于构建什么和保留什么的决策。

description.en: Established the staged disclosure model for advanced AI models. First time the 'too dangerous to release' debate reached mainstream audiences. Shifted public perception of AI from purely exciting to potentially risky.
description.zhHans: 确立了高级 AI 模型的分阶段披露模式。首次将"危险不宜发布"的辩论带入主流视野。将公众对 AI 的认知从纯粹令人兴奋转变为潜在风险。

text.en: OpenAI announced GPT-2 on February 14, 2019, but withheld the full model due to safety concerns, releasing progressively larger versions over 9 months.

title.zhHans: 美国商务部批准 GPT-5.6 广泛发布，政府安全审查完成

searchSummary.en: The U.S. Department of Commerce approved OpenAI's GPT-5.6 for broad release on July 8, 2026, after additional testing under the new frontier AI oversight framework — ending the restricted-access period that began June 26.
searchSummary.zhHans: 2026年7月8日，美国商务部批准 OpenAI 广泛发布 GPT-5.6，此前该模型在新前沿 AI 监管框架下完成了额外政府测试——结束了自 6 月 26 日开始的受限访问期。

summary.en: On July 8, 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce approved a broad launch of OpenAI's GPT-5.6 model following additional testing under Washington's new frontier AI oversight framework. The testing was conducted by the Commerce Department's Center for AI Standards and Innovation, with OpenAI sending technical experts to Washington to address questions. OpenAI expects to release GPT-5.6 widely this week. The approval marks the first full test of the voluntary pre-release framework established by Trump's June 2 executive order, after OpenAI and Anthropic both faced government-mandated restrictions on their most advanced models.
summary.zhHans: 2026年7月8日，美国商务部批准 OpenAI 广泛发布 GPT-5.6 模型，此前该模型在华盛顿新的前沿 AI 监管框架下完成了额外测试。测试由商务部的 AI 标准与创新中心进行，OpenAI 派遣技术专家到华盛顿回答问题。OpenAI 预计本周内广泛发布 GPT-5.6。此次批准标志着特朗普 6 月 2 日行政令建立的自愿预发布框架的首次全面测试，此前 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的最先进模型均面临政府强制限制。

narrative.en: On June 26, 2026, OpenAI released GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna) with restricted access — limited to approximately 20 government-approved partners at the White House's request. The restriction was the first exercise of the new frontier AI oversight framework established by Trump's June 2 executive order. For two weeks, the model's capabilities were locked behind government-mandated guardrails while the Commerce Department's Center for AI Standards and Innovation conducted additional security testing. OpenAI sent technical experts to Washington to facilitate the review. On July 8, the Commerce Department gave final approval for broad launch. The approval signals that the new voluntary framework is operational: the government tested a frontier model, identified no unacceptable risks, and cleared it for wide release. The process sets a precedent for future model releases under the Trump administration's AI governance approach — a lighter-touch, voluntary review system distinct from the EU's mandatory compliance framework.
narrative.zhHans: 2026年6月26日，OpenAI 发布了 GPT-5.6（Sol/Terra/Luna），但在白宫要求下仅限约 20 个政府批准的合作伙伴访问。这一限制是特朗普 6 月 2 日行政令建立的新前沿 AI 监管框架的首次运用。在两周时间里，该模型的能力被锁定在政府强制的护栏之后，商务部的 AI 标准与创新中心进行了额外的安全测试。OpenAI 派遣技术专家到华盛顿协助审查。7月8日，商务部最终批准广泛发布。此次批准表明新的自愿框架已经运作：政府测试了一个前沿模型，未发现不可接受的风险，批准其广泛发布。这一过程为特朗普政府 AI 治理方法下的未来模型发布设立了先例——一种比欧盟强制合规框架更轻量的自愿审查制度。

description.en: First full test of the U.S. government's voluntary frontier AI pre-release framework. Sets precedent for how future advanced model releases will be handled — a lighter-touch alternative to EU-style mandatory compliance.
description.zhHans: 美国政府自愿前沿 AI 预发布框架的首次全面测试。为未来高级模型发布的处理方式设立了先例——一种比欧盟式强制合规更轻量的替代方案。

description.en: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna become available to the general public and developers, ending a two-week period where only ~20 government-vetted partners had access.
description.zhHans: GPT-5.6 Sol、Terra 和 Luna 向公众和开发者开放，结束了仅约 20 个政府审核合作伙伴拥有访问权限的两周限制期。

description.en: Concerns remain about the voluntary nature of the framework — critics argue that without mandatory compliance requirements, dangerous capabilities could still be released prematurely if companies choose not to participate.
description.zhHans: 对该框架的自愿性质仍有担忧——批评者认为，如果没有强制合规要求，若公司选择不参与，危险能力仍可能被过早释放。

text.en: The U.S. Department of Commerce approved broad launch of OpenAI's GPT-5.6 on July 8, 2026, after testing by the Center for AI Standards and Innovation.
text.zhHans: 美国商务部于2026年7月8日批准 OpenAI 广泛发布 GPT-5.6，此前 AI 标准与创新中心进行了测试。

text.en: The model was initially restricted on June 26 at the U.S. government's request, limiting access to ~20 government-approved partners.

title.en: OpenAI Releases GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna Under Government-Restricted Access
title.zhHans: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.6 系列，应白宫要求限制为仅政府批准伙伴可访问

searchSummary.en: OpenAI released GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna on June 26, 2026, but restricted access to ~20 government-approved partners at the White House’s request — the first model shipped under the new frontier AI review framework.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2026 年 6 月 26 日发布 GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna，但应白宫要求仅限约 20 家政府批准合作伙伴访问——这是首个在前沿 AI 审查框架下发布的模型。

summary.en: On June 26, 2026, OpenAI unveiled GPT-5.6, its next-generation model family with three variants: Sol (flagship, $5/$30 per M tokens), Terra (balanced, $2.50/$15), and Luna (fast/low-cost, $1/$6). However, at the request of the Trump administration under a June 2 Executive Order establishing voluntary 30-day pre-release government review of frontier AI models, OpenAI restricted initial access to approximately 20 government-approved partner organizations through the API and Codex. GPT-5.6 Sol set new state-of-the-art benchmarks on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (91.91% in ultra mode), surpassing Claude Mythos 5 (88%). The restricted release marked the first implementation of the EO framework and established a new pattern: frontier AI releases are no longer freely decided by companies alone.
summary.zhHans: 2026年6月26日，OpenAI 发布了 GPT-5.6，其下一代模型家族包括三个变体：Sol（旗舰，$5/$30 per M tokens）、Terra（均衡，$2.50/$15）和 Luna（快速/低价，$1/$6）。然而，应特朗普政府根据6月2日行政令提出的要求——该行政令建立了前沿AI模型公开发布前自愿性30天政府审查流程——OpenAI 将初始访问权限限制为仅约20家政府批准的合作伙伴组织，通过 API 和 Codex 提供。GPT-5.6 Sol 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上以 ultra 模式达到 91.91% 的新 SOTA，超越 Claude Mythos 5 的 88%。此次受限发布标志着 EO 框架的首次实施，并确立了一种新模式：前沿 AI 的发布不再由公司单方面决定。

narrative.en:
On June 26, 2026, OpenAI announced GPT-5.6, its next-generation model family. Unlike previous single-model releases, GPT-5.6 launched as three named tiers: Sol (flagship, $5 input/$30 output per million tokens), Terra (balanced everyday model matching GPT-5.5 at roughly half the cost, $2.50/$15), and Luna (fast and affordable for high-volume routine tasks, $1/$6). Sol introduced two new reasoning modes: 'max' (deeper single-chain reasoning) and 'ultra' (subagent coordination for parallel work), achieving 91.91% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 — surpassing Claude Mythos 5's 88%.

The release was unprecedented in its access restrictions. OpenAI previewed the models and plans with the U.S. government ahead of launch, as part of the framework established by President Trump's June 2 Executive Order 'Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security,' which created a voluntary process for frontier AI developers to give the government up to 30 days to review new models before public release. At the government's request, initial access was limited to approximately 20 trusted partner organizations through the API and Codex — not in ChatGPT. OpenAI emphasized this was a short-term step and planned broader availability 'in the coming weeks,' but did not announce a general availability date.

The GPT-5.6 restricted release followed immediately after the Fable 5/Mythos 5 export ban (June 12) and its subsequent lift (June 30), forming a coherent sequence: the Executive Order on June 2, the Fable 5 ban on June 12, the GPT-5.6 preview under government restriction on June 26, and the Fable 5 unban on June 30. Together, these events established that frontier AI governance had shifted from voluntary corporate self-regulation to active government oversight of model releases.
narrative.zhHans:
2026年6月26日，OpenAI 宣布了其下一代模型家族 GPT-5.6。与以往的单模型发布不同，GPT-5.6 推出了三个命名层级：Sol（旗舰，每百万token $5输入/$30输出）、Terra（均衡日常模型，以约一半成本匹敌 GPT-5.5，$2.50/$15）和 Luna（高容量日常任务快速低价选项，$1/$6）。Sol 引入了两种新的推理模式：'max'（更深的单链推理）和'ultra'（子智能体协调并行工作），在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上达到 91.91%，超越 Claude Mythos 5 的 88%。

此次发布在访问限制上是史无前例的。OpenAI 在发布前向美国政府预览了模型和计划，这是特朗普总统6月2日签署的行政令《促进先进人工智能创新与安全》所建立框架的一部分——该行政令创建了一个自愿流程，前沿 AI 开发者可在公开发布前向政府提供最多30天的模型审查期。应政府要求，初始访问权限通过 API 和 Codex 限制为仅约20家受信任的合作伙伴组织——不在 ChatGPT 中提供。OpenAI 强调这是短期措施，并计划'在未来几周'内扩大可用性，但未公布正式可用日期。

GPT-5.6 受限发布紧随 Fable 5/Mythos 5 出口禁令（6月12日）及其后续解除（6月30日）之后，形成了一个连贯的序列：6月2日行政令 → 6月12日 Fable 5 禁令 → 6月26日 GPT-5.6 政府限制预览 → 6月30日 Fable 5 解禁。共同确立了前沿 AI 治理已从自愿企业自我监管转向政府主动监督模型发布的新格局。

text.en: OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna on June 26, 2026, with initial access limited to ~20 government-approved partners at the Trump administration's request.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 于2026年6月26日预览了 GPT-5.6 Sol、Terra 和 Luna，初始访问权限应特朗普政府要求限制为约20家政府批准的合作伙伴。

text.en: The restriction followed from President Trump's June 2, 2026 Executive Order establishing a voluntary 30-day government review window for frontier AI models before public release.
text.zhHans: 该限制源于特朗普总统2026年6月2日的行政令，该行政令建立了前沿AI模型公开发布前30天自愿性政府审查窗口。

text.en: GPT-5.6 Sol achieved 91.91% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 in ultra mode, surpassing Claude Mythos 5's 88% — setting a new state of the art.
text.zhHans: GPT-5.6 Sol 在 ultra 模式下于 Terminal-Bench 2.1 达到 91.91%，超越 Claude Mythos 5 的 88%，创造了新的 SOTA。

text.en: GPT-5.6's restricted release, combined with the Fable 5 export ban and subsequent unban, marked the transition from voluntary corporate AI governance to active government oversight of frontier model releases — a paradigm shift in AI regulation.
text.zhHans: GPT-5.6 的受限发布，结合 Fable 5 出口禁令及其后续解除，标志着 AI 治理从自愿企业自我监管向政府主动监督前沿模型发布的转变——这是 AI 监管的范式转变。

text.en: Critics argued that the government restriction set a concerning precedent: without clear legislative mandate, the executive branch effectively gained veto power over frontier AI releases through informal requests rather than legal processes.
text.zhHans: 批评者认为政府限制开创了一个令人担忧的先例：在没有明确立法授权的情况下，行政分支通过非正式请求而非法律程序，实际上获得了对前沿AI发布的否决权。

text.en: GPT-5.6 is the first model released under the June 2 Executive Order framework, establishing a new norm: frontier AI model releases are subject to government review and approval before public access. This represents a fundamental shift from industry self-governance to government oversight.
text.zhHans: GPT-5.6 是首个在6月2日行政令框架下发布的模型，建立了一个新常态：前沿AI模型的发布在公开访问前需接受政府审查和批准。这代表了从行业自我监管向政府监管的根本转变。

title.en: OpenAI launches native image generation in ChatGPT, igniting a cultural phenomenon
title.zhHans: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 中推出原生图像生成，引发文化现象

searchSummary.en: OpenAI launched native image generation in ChatGPT in 2025 — sparking a cultural phenomenon of AI-generated images. How GPT-4o’s image capabilities changed visual creativity.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2025 年在 ChatGPT 中推出原生图像生成，引发了 AI 生成图像的文化现象。GPT-4o 的图像能力如何改变了视觉创作。

summary.en: In March 2025, OpenAI released GPT Image, a native image generation model integrated directly into ChatGPT — replacing the separate DALL-E system. The model could render text accurately in images, understand complex visual prompts, and generate in multiple languages. On March 27, users discovered they could transform photos into Studio Ghibli animation style, triggering a global viral trend. The 'Ghibli Moment' became 2025's first major AI cultural phenomenon, sparking both delight and a renewed debate about AI-generated art and copyright.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 3 月，OpenAI 发布了 GPT Image，一个直接集成到 ChatGPT 中的原生图像生成模型——取代了独立的 DALL-E 系统。该模型能在图像中准确渲染文字、理解复杂的视觉提示、并生成多语言内容。3 月 27 日，用户发现可以将照片转换为吉卜力工作室动画风格，引发了全球病毒式传播。"吉卜力时刻"成为 2025 年第一个重大 AI 文化现象，既引发了欢乐也重新点燃了关于 AI 生成艺术和版权的辩论。

narrative.en: GPT Image represented a fundamental product integration: image generation was no longer a separate tool (as with DALL-E, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion) but a native capability inside ChatGPT. Users could describe, edit, and iterate on images in the same chat where they wrote code or analyzed documents. The model significantly improved on DALL-E 3: text rendering in images was legible for the first time; multilingual prompts worked reliably; and the model could precisely follow multi-object spatial layouts. The Ghibli-style trend began when social media users discovered that GPT Image could effortlessly replicate the distinctive aesthetic of Studio Ghibli films — the soft watercolor backgrounds, expressive character designs, and whimsical atmosphere of Hayao Miyazaki's animations. Within days, millions of Ghibli-style portraits flooded X, Instagram, and TikTok. The trend was so massive that it became a news story itself: CNN, Forbes, NPR, and The Guardian all covered it. It also sparked backlash: Hayao Miyazaki's 2016 comment that AI art was 'an insult to life itself' resurfaced; artists expressed concerns about style imitation; and the copyright implications of training on Ghibli films' aesthetics were debated. OpenAI framed the release as 'ChatGPT Images 2.0' in a later announcement, and the model's successor (gpt-image-2) was released later in 2025.
narrative.zhHans: GPT Image 代表了一个根本性的产品集成：图像生成不再是独立工具（如 DALL-E、Midjourney、Stable Diffusion），而是 ChatGPT 内部的本地化能力。用户可以在编写代码或分析文档的同一个聊天中描述、编辑和迭代图像。该模型在 DALL-E 3 的基础上显著改进：图像中的文字渲染首次变得清晰可辨；多语言提示可靠工作；并且模型能精确遵循多对象空间布局。吉卜力风格的趋势始于社交媒体用户发现 GPT Image 可以毫不费力地复制吉卜力工作室电影的独特美学——宫崎骏动画中柔和的水彩背景、富有表现力的角色设计和异想天开的氛围。几天之内，数百万张吉卜力风格的肖像淹没了 X、Instagram 和 TikTok。这一趋势如此庞大，以至于它本身成为了新闻故事：CNN、Forbes、NPR 和 The Guardian 都进行了报道。它也引发了反弹：宫崎骏 2016 年关于 AI 艺术是"对生命本身的侮辱"的评论重新浮出水面；艺术家对风格模仿表示担忧；以及在吉卜力电影美学上训练的版权含义引发了辩论。OpenAI 在后来的一篇公告中将这次发布称为"ChatGPT Images 2.0"，其继任者（gpt-image-2）于 2025 年晚些时候发布。

description.en: Integrated image generation into ChatGPT, making it available to hundreds of millions of users without needing separate tools. Multi-language support and accurate text rendering expanded practical utility.
description.zhHans: 将图像生成集成到 ChatGPT 中，使数亿用户无需独立工具即可使用。多语言支持和准确文字渲染扩展了实用价值。

description.en: Ghibli-style trend reignited copyright and ethical debates about AI training on artistic styles. Artists raised concerns about style imitation without consent or compensation.
description.zhHans: 吉卜力风格趋势重新点燃了关于 AI 在艺术风格上训练的版权和伦理辩论。艺术家对未经同意或补偿的风格模仿表示担忧。

text.en: OpenAI released native image generation in ChatGPT in March 2025. The Ghibli-style trend went globally viral on March 27, 2025.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2025 年 3 月在 ChatGPT 中发布了原生图像生成功能。吉卜力风格趋势于 2025 年 3 月 27 日全球病毒式传播。

title.en: OpenAI releases GPT-3, demonstrating that scaling language models unlocks emergent capabilities
title.zhHans: OpenAI 发布 GPT-3，证明语言模型规模化可以解锁涌现能力

searchSummary.en: GPT-3 (175 billion parameters) showed scaling unlocks emergent AI capabilities. How OpenAI’s 2020 paper validated the scaling hypothesis and changed AI.
searchSummary.zhHans: GPT-3（1750 亿参数）证明了大语言模型的规模化可以解锁涌现能力。了解 OpenAI 2020 年论文如何验证了缩放假说、改变了 AI 发展方向。

summary.en: In June 2020, OpenAI published GPT-3 (Generative Pre-trained Transformer 3), a 175-billion-parameter language model that demonstrated remarkable few-shot learning—the ability to perform novel tasks from just a handful of examples without fine-tuning. GPT-3 could write essays, generate code, translate languages, and answer questions at a quality that often blurred the line between human and machine output. The paper 'Language Models are Few-Shot Learners' (Brown et al.) validated the scaling hypothesis: larger models trained on more data get qualitatively better, not just incrementally better.
summary.zhHans: 2020 年 6 月，OpenAI 发表了 GPT-3（生成式预训练 Transformer 3），一个拥有 1750 亿参数的语言模型，展示了卓越的少样本学习能力——仅需寥寥几个示例即可执行新任务，无需微调。GPT-3 撰写的文章、生成的代码、翻译的语言和回答的问题，其质量经常模糊了人类与机器输出之间的界限。论文《语言模型是少样本学习者》（Brown 等人）验证了缩放假说：更大的模型在更多数据上训练会得到质的提升，而不仅仅是量的改进。

narrative.en: GPT-3 was not the first large language model—GPT-2 (1.5B parameters) had made headlines a year earlier for being 'too dangerous to release.' But GPT-3 was different in scale and kind. At 175 billion parameters, trained on a filtered version of Common Crawl (hundreds of billions of tokens), it exhibited abilities that its smaller predecessors did not: basic arithmetic, language translation, code generation, and even primitive reasoning—all without task-specific training. The paper described these as 'emergent' capabilities, a term that would become central to the later debate about whether scaling alone could produce general intelligence. OpenAI commercialized GPT-3 via an API, creating a new business model for foundation models that competitors rapidly adopted. Developers built products on top of it—copywriting tools (Jasper, Copy.ai), code assistants (GitHub Copilot used an OpenAI model), and conversational AI. GPT-3 also sparked intense public debate: about AI-generated misinformation, bias in large-scale training data, the environmental cost of training, and the concentration of AI capability in a few well-funded labs. The scaling approach proved so compelling that it reshaped the AI industry. Microsoft invested $1 billion in OpenAI in 2019 and secured an exclusive GPT-3 license in 2020. Google, DeepMind, Meta, and Anthropic all launched their own large language model programs in response. GPT-3 itself was quickly superseded—InstructGPT (2022) refined it with human feedback, and GPT-4 (2023) scaled it further—but the 2020 paper marked the moment when 'scale' became the dominant force in AI progress, and the question shifted from 'can we build a bigger model?' to 'what capabilities emerge when we do?'
narrative.zhHans: GPT-3 不是第一个大语言模型——GPT-2（15 亿参数）一年前就因"太危险而无法发布"登上了头条。但 GPT-3 在规模和质量上是不同的。拥有 1750 亿参数，在过滤过的 Common Crawl（数千亿标记）上训练，它展示了更小的前代模型所没有的能力：基本算术、语言翻译、代码生成，甚至初步推理——所有这些都不需要任务特定的训练。论文将这些描述为"涌现"能力，这一术语后来成为关于仅靠规模扩展是否能产生通用智能的辩论的核心。OpenAI 通过 API 将 GPT-3 商业化，为基础模型创造了新的商业模式，竞争对手迅速采纳。开发者在它之上构建产品——文案工具（Jasper、Copy.ai）、代码助手（GitHub Copilot 使用了 OpenAI 模型）和对话式 AI。GPT-3 也引发了激烈的公共辩论：关于 AI 生成的虚假信息、大规模训练数据中的偏见、训练的环境成本以及 AI 能力集中在少数资金充足的实验室手中。缩放方法被证明如此说服力，以至于重塑了 AI 产业。微软在 2019 年向 OpenAI 投资 10 亿美元，并在 2020 年获得了 GPT-3 的独家许可。Google、DeepMind、Meta 和 Anthropic 都推出了自己的大语言模型项目作为回应。GPT-3 本身很快被超越——InstructGPT（2022 年）通过人类反馈进行了改进，GPT-4（2023 年）进一步扩展了规模——但 2020 年的论文标志着"规模"成为 AI 进步的主导力量，问题从"我们能建立更大的模型吗？"转变为"当我们这样做时会出现什么能力？"

description.en: Demonstrated emergent few-shot learning at scale. GPT-3 could perform tasks it was never explicitly trained for—translation, arithmetic, code generation, question answering—simply from a few examples in the prompt. This established 'prompting' as a new programming paradigm and proved the scaling hypothesis to a skeptical field.
description.zhHans: 展示了大规模下的涌现式少样本学习。GPT-3 可以执行它从未被明确训练过的任务——翻译、算术、代码生成、问答——仅通过在提示中的几个示例。这确立了"提示"作为一种新编程范式的地位，并向持怀疑态度的领域证明了缩放假说。

description.en: Created the 'foundation model' business model: a single large model, accessible via API, that developers could adapt to thousands of downstream applications. This API-driven model became the default for AI commercialization. Microsoft invested billions, and an entire ecosystem of startups (Jasper, Copy.ai, GitHub Copilot) launched on GPT-3.
description.zhHans: 创造了"基础模型"商业模式：一个单一的大型模型通过 API 访问，开发者可将其适配到数千个下游应用。这种 API 驱动的模式成为 AI 商业化的默认方式。微软投资了数十亿美元，一整个初创公司生态系统（Jasper、Copy.ai、GitHub Copilot）在 GPT-3 上启动。

description.en: Raised public awareness of AI risks at scale: generation of convincing misinformation, amplification of training data biases, environmental cost of training (estimated 552 tonnes of CO₂), and concentration of AI capability in a small number of well-funded labs.
description.zhHans: 提高了公众对规模化 AI 风险的认识：产生令人信服的虚假信息、放大训练数据中的偏见、训练的环境成本（估计 552 吨 CO₂）以及 AI 能力集中在少数资金充足的实验室手中。

text.en: GPT-3, a 175-billion-parameter language model, demonstrated that scaling model size and training data leads to emergent capabilities not present in smaller models, including few-shot learning, basic arithmetic, and code generation without task-specific fine-tuning.
text.zhHans: GPT-3，一个拥有 1750 亿参数的语言模型，证明了模型规模和数据规模的扩大能产生较小模型中不存在的涌现能力，包括少样本学习、基本算术和代码生成，而无需任务特定的微调。

text.en: GPT-3 established the 'foundation model via API' business model and triggered a global race among tech giants to build ever-larger language models, fundamentally restructuring the AI industry around scale.
text.zhHans: GPT-3 建立了"通过 API 提供基础模型"的商业模式，并触发了科技巨头间建立更大语言模型的全球竞赛，从根本上围绕规模重构了 AI 产业。

sources.quote: We demonstrate that scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance.
Power-law relationships predict model performance from scale, enabling informed resource allocation.
OpenAI's GPT-3 is shockingly good—and completely mindless.

title.en: OpenAI releases GPT-4, the first multimodal large language model
title.zhHans: OpenAI 发布 GPT-4，第一个多模态大语言模型

searchSummary.en: GPT-4 release date: March 14, 2023. OpenAI’s first multimodal LLM scored top 10% on the bar exam and set a new AI capability baseline.
searchSummary.zhHans: GPT-4 发布日期：2023 年 3 月 14 日。OpenAI 首个多模态大语言模型，律师资格考前 10%，为 AI 能力设定了新基线。时间线与影响解析。

summary.en: On March 14, 2023, OpenAI released GPT-4 — a multimodal model that could accept both text and image inputs while generating text outputs. GPT-4 scored in the 90th percentile on the bar exam, the 99th percentile on the SAT, and demonstrated dramatically improved reasoning, factuality, and steerability over GPT-3.5. It was integrated into ChatGPT Plus as a premium tier, and its API became the default for developers building on LLMs. GPT-4 raised the bar on what LLMs could do and set a new baseline for AI capability that persisted until the model release wave of late 2024.
summary.zhHans: 2023 年 3 月 14 日，OpenAI 发布了 GPT-4——一个可以同时接受文本和图像输入并生成文本输出的多模态模型。GPT-4 在律师资格考试中达到了第 90 百分位，SAT 中第 99 百分位，并在推理能力、事实准确性和可引导性上相比 GPT-3.5 有显著提升。它被集成到 ChatGPT Plus 作为付费层，其 API 成为基于 LLM 构建的开发者的默认选择。GPT-4 提高了 LLM 能力的上限，并为 AI 能力设定了新的基线，这一基线一直保持到 2024 年底的模型发布潮。

narrative.en: GPT-4 was the culmination of the scaling approach OpenAI had pioneered with GPT-3. While OpenAI did not disclose its parameter count (citing competitive concerns), estimates placed it at 1.7 trillion parameters across a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 8 expert models of 220B parameters each. The key advance was multimodal input — GPT-4 could process images, diagrams, screenshots, and handwritten text, not just typed text. In a paper accompanying the release, OpenAI evaluated GPT-4 on a battery of professional exams: it scored in the top 10% of test-takers on the Uniform Bar Exam (vs. bottom 10% for GPT-3.5), the 88th percentile on the LSAT, and the 99th percentile on the SAT Math. The model showed dramatically reduced hallucinations compared to GPT-3.5 and was more steerable (it could follow complex instructions with multiple constraints). GPT-4 also introduced the 'system prompt' concept, allowing developers to set the model's behavior, tone, and boundaries. GPT-4's release triggered a new phase in the AI industry: competitors raced to match its capabilities (Claude 3, Gemini 1.5, Llama 3), while regulators intensified scrutiny. The European Union's AI Act negotiations accelerated after its release. Its vision capabilities — reading diagrams, understanding memes, analyzing medical scans — opened use cases in education, accessibility, healthcare, and scientific research. GPT-4 was subsequently upgraded (GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o), but the March 2023 release marked the moment when LLMs became capable enough to be genuinely useful across a vast range of professional and creative tasks.
narrative.zhHans: GPT-4 是 OpenAI 在 GPT-3 上开创的缩放方法的顶峰。OpenAI 没有披露其参数量（引述竞争关切），估计它采用混合专家架构，共 1.7 万亿参数，分为 8 个 2200 亿参数的专家模型。关键进展是多模态输入——GPT-4 可以处理图像、图表、截图和手写文字，而不仅仅是文本。在随发布附带的论文中，OpenAI 在一系列专业考试中评估了 GPT-4：它在统一律师资格考试中位于前 10%（GPT-3.5 位于后 10%），LSAT 第 88 百分位，SAT 数学第 99 百分位。与 GPT-3.5 相比，该模型的幻觉显著减少，可引导性更强（可以遵循包含多个约束的复杂指令）。GPT-4 还引入了"系统提示"概念，允许开发者设定模型的行为、语气和边界。GPT-4 的发布触发了 AI 产业的新阶段：竞争对手竞相追赶其能力（Claude 3、Gemini 1.5、Llama 3），同时监管机构加强审查。欧盟 AI 法案的谈判在其发布后加速。其视觉能力——阅读图表、理解迷因、分析医学扫描——在教育、无障碍、医疗保健和科学研究中开辟了新的应用场景。GPT-4 后来进行了升级（GPT-4 Turbo、GPT-4o），但 2023 年 3 月的发布标志着大语言模型已经足够强大，可以在广泛的专业和创造性任务中真正发挥作用。

description.en: Achieved professional-level performance on standardised exams (90th percentile bar exam, 99th percentile SAT Math). Introduced multimodal input (vision + text) at scale. Demonstrated significant reductions in hallucination and improved instruction-following compared to GPT-3.5.
description.zhHans: 在标准化考试中达到专业级别表现（律师资格考试前 10%，SAT 数学第 99 百分位）。大规模引入了多模态输入（视觉+文本）。与 GPT-3.5 相比，幻觉显著减少，指令遵循能力明显提升。

description.en: Accelerated AI integration across professional services (law, accounting, consulting, software). ChatGPT Plus ($20/month with GPT-4) became the fastest-growing consumer subscription product. Triggered a wave of enterprise AI adoption across Fortune 500 companies.
description.zhHans: 加速了 AI 在专业服务领域（法律、会计、咨询、软件）的整合。ChatGPT Plus（含 GPT-4，每月 $20）成为增长最快的消费者订阅产品。触发了财富 500 强企业的企业级 AI 采用浪潮。

description.en: Raised the stakes on AI safety, alignment, and regulation. GPT-4's improved capabilities (including vision) expanded the surface area for misuse — generating convincing fake documents, detailed instructions for harmful activities, and automated disinformation at scale. Accelerated regulatory efforts including the EU AI Act.
description.zhHans: 提高了 AI 安全、对齐和监管的紧迫性。GPT-4 的增强能力（包括视觉）扩大了滥用的范围——生成令人信服的伪造文件、有害活动的详细指令以及大规模自动虚假信息。加速了包括欧盟 AI 法案在内的监管努力。

text.en: OpenAI released GPT-4 on March 14, 2023 — a multimodal model accepting text and image inputs, scoring in the top 10% of test-takers on the Uniform Bar Exam.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2023 年 3 月 14 日发布 GPT-4——一个可接受文本和图像输入的多模态模型，在统一律师资格考试中位于前 10%。

text.en: GPT-4 set a new capability baseline for LLMs that remained competitive through late 2024, achieved through a Mixture-of-Experts architecture estimated at 1.7T parameters.
text.zhHans: GPT-4 为 LLM 设定了新的能力基线，该基线一直保持竞争力到 2024 年底，通过估计 1.7T 参数的混合专家架构实现。

sources.quote: We've created GPT-4, the latest milestone in OpenAI's effort in scaling up deep learning. GPT-4 is a large multimodal model that exhibits human-level performance on various professional and academic benchmarks.
OpenAI releases GPT-4, a multimodal AI that it claims is state-of-the-art.

title.en: OpenAI releases GPT-4o, bringing real-time voice conversation to everyone
title.zhHans: OpenAI 发布 GPT-4o，实时语音对话向所有用户开放

searchSummary.en: GPT-4o (May 2024) made real-time voice conversations with AI available to everyone. OpenAI’s omnimodal model combined text, vision, and audio in one neural network.
searchSummary.zhHans: GPT-4o（2024 年 5 月）让 AI 实时语音对话向所有用户开放。OpenAI 的全模态模型将文本、视觉和音频融合到一个神经网络中。

summary.en: On May 13, 2024, OpenAI released GPT-4o ('omni'), a natively multimodal model combining text, vision, and audio processing in a single neural network. For the first time, users could have real-time voice conversations with an AI that could express emotion, laugh, pause, and adjust its tone — indistinguishable from human conversation. GPT-4o matched GPT-4 on text benchmarks while dramatically improving voice and vision performance. The model was made free for all ChatGPT users, effectively doubling the available AI capability overnight.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 5 月 13 日，OpenAI 发布了 GPT-4o（"omni"），一个将文本、视觉和音频处理整合到单一神经网络的原生多模态模型。用户首次可以与 AI 进行实时语音对话——AI 能够表达情感、笑、停顿和调整语气——与人类对话几乎无法区分。GPT-4o 在文本基准上匹配 GPT-4，同时大幅提升了语音和视觉性能。该模型对所有 ChatGPT 用户免费开放，一夜之间将可用的 AI 能力提升了一倍。

narrative.en: GPT-4o was a response to growing competition — Google's Gemini showed native multimodality, Anthropic's Claude 3 matched GPT-4 on reasoning. OpenAI's answer was to make multimodality not just an add-on but the core architecture. The 'o' stood for 'omni.' The live demos were the most impressive part: OpenAI showed GPT-4o interrupting a sung lullaby to adjust its emotion, telling a story with dramatic pauses and voice changes, describing images in real time through a phone camera, and recognizing emotion from facial expressions while talking. The audio latency dropped to 232 milliseconds — close to human conversational response time (about 200ms). GPT-4o also marked a pricing revolution: it was 2x faster and 50% cheaper than GPT-4 Turbo via API. The free tier of ChatGPT got GPT-4o-level intelligence, a move clearly designed to counter Google's free Gemini offerings. The release immediately raised the competitive bar. Anthropic, Google, and Meta all accelerated their multimodal model releases. For users, the impact was immediate: the definition of 'talking to AI' shifted from typing prompts in a text box to having a natural, voice-based conversation with an entity that could see, hear, and respond with human-like emotion.
narrative.zhHans: GPT-4o 是对日益激烈的竞争的回应——Google 的 Gemini 展示了原生多模态，Anthropic 的 Claude 3 在推理上匹配了 GPT-4。OpenAI 的答案是让多模态不仅是一个附加功能，而是核心架构。"o"代表"omni"（全能的）。现场演示是最令人印象深刻的部分：OpenAI 展示了 GPT-4o 打断一首哼唱的摇篮曲以调整情感、用戏剧化的停顿和声音变化讲故事、通过手机摄像头实时描述图像、以及在对话中通过面部表情识别情感。音频延迟降至 232 毫秒——接近人类对话反应时间（约 200 毫秒）。GPT-4o 还标志着一场定价革命：它比 GPT-4 Turbo 快 2 倍且便宜 50%。ChatGPT 的免费层获得了 GPT-4o 级别的智能，这一举措明显旨在对抗 Google 的免费 Gemini 产品。这次发布立即提高了竞争门槛。Anthropic、Google 和 Meta 都加快了他们多模态模型的发布。对用户而言，影响是直接的："与 AI 对话"的定义从在文本框中输入提示转变为与一个能看到、能听到、能以人类般情感回应的实体进行自然的语音对话。

description.en: First production model to natively fuse text, vision, and audio in a single neural network. Real-time voice conversation with emotional expression reached human-like quality for the first time. Audio latency of 232ms was indistinguishable from human conversation.
description.zhHans: 首个在单一神经网络中原生融合文本、视觉和音频的生产模型。带情感表达的实时语音对话首次达到类人质量。232 毫秒的音频延迟与人类对话几乎无法区分。

description.en: GPT-4o-level intelligence became free for all ChatGPT users. API pricing was cut 50% compared to GPT-4 Turbo. The combination of free access + voice interface made state-of-the-art AI conversational ability available to anyone with a smartphone.
description.zhHans: GPT-4o 级别的智能对所有 ChatGPT 用户免费开放。API 价格相比 GPT-4 Turbo 降低 50%。免费访问 + 语音界面的组合使最先进的 AI 对话能力对任何拥有智能手机的人都是可及的。

text.en: OpenAI released GPT-4o on May 13, 2024 — a natively multimodal model combining text, vision, and audio with real-time voice conversation at 232ms latency.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2024 年 5 月 13 日发布 GPT-4o——一个结合文本、视觉和音频的原生多模态模型，具备 232 毫秒延迟的实时语音对话能力。

sources.quote: We're introducing GPT-4o, our new flagship model that can reason across audio, vision, and text in real time.
GPT-4o (omni) is a multimodal language model developed by OpenAI and released on May 13, 2024.

title.en: OpenAI releases GPT-5, unifying reasoning, multimodality, and task execution
title.zhHans: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5，统一推理、多模态和任务执行能力

searchSummary.en: GPT-5 (2025) unified reasoning, multimodality, and task execution in a single model. How OpenAI’s latest flagship integrated thinking, seeing, and doing into one AI system.
searchSummary.zhHans: GPT-5（2025 年）将推理、多模态和任务执行能力统一在单一模型中。OpenAI 的最新旗舰如何将思考、观察和行动整合到一个 AI 系统中。

summary.en: On August 7, 2025, OpenAI released GPT-5, a unified AI system that combined advanced reasoning, native multimodality, and autonomous task execution — eliminating the need for users to switch between separate models (GPT-4o for chat, o-series for reasoning, DALL-E for images). According to Sam Altman, GPT-5 could 'provide PhD-level expertise' across domains. The release marked the culmination of OpenAI's journey from a single-purpose language model (GPT-3, 2020) to a general-purpose AI system capable of reasoning, creating, and acting.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 8 月 7 日，OpenAI 发布了 GPT-5，一个统一的 AI 系统，结合了高级推理、原生多模态和自主任务执行——消除了用户在独立模型之间切换的需要（GPT-4o 用于聊天，o 系列用于推理，DALL-E 用于图像）。据 Sam Altman 称，GPT-5 可以跨领域"提供博士级专业知识"。这次发布标志着 OpenAI 从单一用途语言模型（GPT-3，2020）到能够推理、创造和行动的通用 AI 系统的旅程达到了顶峰。

narrative.en: GPT-5 was the model that OpenAI had been building toward since GPT-3. The previous architecture required separate models for different tasks: GPT-4o for chat and vision, o1/o3 for reasoning, DALL-E for image generation. GPT-5 unified all three in a single neural network. It could: reason through complex multi-step problems using internal chain-of-thought (inherited from o-series), understand and generate text, images, and audio natively, and execute multi-step tasks autonomously — browsing the web, using tools, writing and running code. The benchmarks were impressive but not uniformly transformative. GPT-5 scored at PhD-level on GPQA Diamond, near the top on Humanity's Last Exam, and set new records on various coding benchmarks. However, it also had embarrassing failures — struggling with basic spelling, simple geography questions, and tasks that required common sense — a reminder that 'PhD-level' expertise in specialized domains did not equate to general intelligence. OpenAI emphasized GPT-5's 'thinking level toggle' — users could control how much compute the model spent on reasoning, from quick answers to deep analysis. This reinforced the inference-time compute paradigm. The release had three major implications. First, it validated the 'unified model' thesis: one model for all tasks was possible and practical. Second, it reset expectations for AGI timelines — Altman's 'PhD-level' claim triggered debate about whether GPT-5 qualified as AGI or not. Third, it triggered responses: Anthropic, Google, and DeepSeek all accelerated their unified model roadmaps. GPT-5.1 followed in November 2025 with a thinking/instant mode split.
narrative.zhHans: GPT-5 是 OpenAI 自 GPT-3 以来一直在构建的模型。之前的架构需要不同任务使用不同模型：GPT-4o 用于聊天和视觉，o1/o3 用于推理，DALL-E 用于图像生成。GPT-5 将三者统一到单一神经网络中。它可以：使用内部思维链（继承自 o 系列）推理复杂的多步骤问题；原生理解和生成文本、图像和音频；并自主执行多步骤任务——浏览网页、使用工具、编写和运行代码。基准测试令人印象深刻但不统一具有变革性。GPT-5 在 GPQA Diamond 上达到博士级水平，在 Humanity's Last Exam 上接近顶部，并在多个编程基准上刷新了纪录。然而，它也有令人尴尬的失败——在基本拼写、简单地理问题和需要常识的任务上遇到困难——这提醒我们，在专业领域的"博士级"专业知识并不等同于通用智能。OpenAI 强调了 GPT-5 的"思考级别切换"——用户可以控制模型在推理上花费多少计算资源，从快速回答到深度分析。这强化了推理时计算范式。这次发布有三个主要影响。首先，它验证了"统一模型"论点：一个模型处理所有任务是可能且实用的。其次，它重置了对 AGI 时间线的预期——Altman 的"博士级"声明引发了关于 GPT-5 是否符合 AGI 资格的辩论。第三，它引发了回应：Anthropic、Google 和 DeepSeek 都加速了他们的统一模型路线图。GPT-5.1 于 2025 年 11 月发布，增加了思考/即时模式切换。

title.en: xAI's Grok generates explicit deepfakes, triggering multi-country bans and a safety backlash
title.zhHans: xAI 的 Grok 生成色情深度伪造，引发多国封禁和安全反弹

searchSummary.en: Grok generated explicit deepfake content in 2026, triggering bans across multiple countries. How xAI’s safety failures became a global crisis and sparked new regulations.
searchSummary.zhHans: xAI 的 Grok 于 2026 年生成色情深度伪造内容，引发多国封禁。xAI 的安全失守如何演变为全球危机并催生了新的监管措施。

summary.en: In January 2026, xAI's Grok image generator was used to create nonconsensual sexualized deepfakes, including imagery involving children. X restricted image generation and editing through the Grok account to paid users, while Indonesia and Malaysia temporarily blocked access. The incident triggered a formal Ofcom investigation and wider regulatory scrutiny, showing that access restrictions alone did not resolve the underlying safety and distribution risks.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 1 月，xAI 的 Grok 图像生成器被用于制作未经同意的性化深度伪造，其中包括涉及儿童的图像。X 将通过 Grok 账号进行的图像生成和编辑限制为付费用户，印度尼西亚和马来西亚则暂时封锁了访问。该事件引发 Ofcom 正式调查及更广泛的监管审查，表明仅靠访问限制并未解决底层安全与传播风险。

narrative.en: The crisis unfolded in early January 2026 as users prompted Grok to create and publicly share sexualized edits of real people. Regulators reported concerns involving women and children, with some content potentially amounting to intimate-image abuse, pornography, or child sexual abuse material. X limited image generation and editing through the Grok account to paying users, but regulators said the measure did not fully address illegal-content risks. Indonesia and Malaysia temporarily blocked Grok. On January 12, Ofcom opened an investigation into whether X had failed duties under the UK's Online Safety Act. The sequence is significant because it links a generative-model safeguard failure to concrete platform restrictions and formal regulatory action. It does not establish that every Grok surface behaved identically or that a paywall itself was an effective safety control.
narrative.zhHans: 危机在 2026 年 1 月初迅速发展：用户提示 Grok 生成并公开传播真实人物的性化编辑图像。监管机构关注到涉及女性和儿童的内容，其中部分可能构成私密图像滥用、色情内容或儿童性虐待材料。X 将通过 Grok 账号进行的图像生成和编辑限制为付费用户，但监管机构认为该措施并未充分解决非法内容风险。印度尼西亚和马来西亚暂时封锁 Grok。1 月 12 日，Ofcom 正式调查 X 是否违反英国《在线安全法》义务。该事件把生成模型的防护失败与具体的平台限制和正式监管行动联系起来；但它不证明所有 Grok 使用界面的行为完全相同，也不代表付费墙本身是有效的安全控制。

description.en: Demonstrated that frontier AI image generation models still lacked adequate safeguards against deepfake abuse. Multi-country bans showed real geopolitical consequences of AI safety failures. Triggered regulatory investigations (Ofcom). Sparked debate about 'spicy mode' as product strategy.
description.zhHans: 证明了前沿 AI 图像生成模型仍然缺乏针对深度伪造滥用的充分安全措施。多国禁令显示了 AI 安全失败的真实地缘政治后果。触发了监管调查（Ofcom）。引发了关于"辣味模式"作为产品策略的辩论。

title.en: Illinois Becomes First US State to Mandate Independent Third-Party AI Safety Audits
title.zhHans: 伊利诺伊成为全美首个要求独立第三方 AI 安全审计的州

searchSummary.en: Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker signed the nation's first law requiring independent third-party safety audits for large AI developers, with fines up to $3M for violations.
searchSummary.zhHans: 伊利诺伊州长 JB Pritzker 签署全美首个要求大型 AI 开发者进行独立第三方安全审计的法律，违规罚款最高 300 万美元。

summary.en: On July 6, 2026, Illinois Governor JB Pritzker signed the AI Safety Measures Act (SB 315), making Illinois the first US state to require independent third-party safety audits of large AI developers. The law applies to companies with over $500 million in annual gross revenue developing frontier AI models. Requirements include: publishing explanations of catastrophic risk and mitigation plans, reporting critical safety incidents to the state within 72 hours, annual independent compliance audits by qualified third parties, whistleblower protections with anonymous internal reporting, and fines up to $1M for first violations and $3M for subsequent ones. Requirements take effect January 1, 2028. The bill gained bipartisan support and was endorsed by both Anthropic and OpenAI.
summary.zhHans: 2026年7月6日，伊利诺伊州长 JB Pritzker 签署了 AI 安全措施法案（SB 315），使伊利诺伊成为全美首个要求大型 AI 开发者进行独立第三方安全审计的州。该法律适用于年总收入超过 5 亿美元、开发前沿 AI 模型的公司。要求包括：公布灾难性风险及缓解计划、72 小时内向州政府报告严重安全事故、由合格第三方进行年度独立合规审计、举报人保护及匿名内部报告机制、首次违规罚款最高 100 万美元、后续违规最高 300 万美元。要求于 2028 年 1 月 1 日生效。该法案获得两党支持，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 均表示支持。

narrative.en: As the Trump administration showed reluctance to regulate AI at the federal level, Illinois stepped in to fill what lawmakers viewed as a void. The AI Safety Measures Act (SB 315) represents the most prescriptive state-level AI regulation in the US. Unlike California's and New York's AI laws, Illinois's is the first to mandate independent audits — a requirement that forces companies to submit their safety practices to external, technically qualified examiners. The law targets 'covered AI developers' — large frontier AI labs — rather than all AI users, distinguishing it from the EU's broader approach. Notably, Anthropic and OpenAI both supported the legislation, signaling that major AI labs recognize value in establishing baseline safety standards. Illinois House Speaker Emanuel 'Chris' Welch captured the legislative mood: 'Decision-making on AI is too important to be left to the federal government or tech bros whose culture of move fast and break things is moving faster and faster and breaking more and more as it goes.' The law's 2028 effective date gives companies nearly 18 months to prepare compliance systems.
narrative.zhHans: 在特朗普政府表现得不情愿在联邦层面监管 AI 的情况下，伊利诺伊介入填补了立法者眼中的空白。AI 安全措施法案（SB 315）代表了美国最精细的州级 AI 监管。与加州和纽约的 AI 法律不同，伊利诺伊的法律是首个强制要求独立审计的——这一要求迫使公司将其安全实践交由外部有技术资质的审查员检查。该法律针对'受覆盖的 AI 开发者'——大型前沿 AI 实验室——而非所有 AI 用户，这使其区别于欧盟更广泛的方法。值得注意的是，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 都支持该立法，表明主要 AI 实验室认识到建立基线安全标准的价值。伊利诺伊州众议院议长 Emanuel 'Chris' Welch 捕捉到了立法情绪：'AI 的决策太重要了，不能留给联邦政府或那些'快速行动、打破常规'文化的科技哥们，他们行动越来越快，破坏也越来越多。'该法律 2028 年的生效日期为公司提供了近 18 个月来准备合规系统。

description.en: First US state to mandate independent third-party AI safety audits. Sets a template for other states and potentially federal regulation. Creates a compliance infrastructure (auditor qualification standards, reporting mechanisms) that other jurisdictions can adopt.
description.zhHans: 首个要求独立第三方 AI 安全审计的美国州。为其他州和潜在的联邦监管设立了模板。创建了其他司法管辖区可以采用的合规基础设施（审计师资格标准、报告机制）。

title.en: Moonshot AI announces Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight model
title.zhHans: Moonshot AI 发布 Kimi K3——2.8 万亿参数开放权重模型

searchSummary.en: Kimi K3 (Jul 2026) — Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter MoE model with a 1M-token context window, native vision, and Kimi Delta Attention. Service access began at launch; full open weights were scheduled for July 27.
searchSummary.zhHans: Kimi K3（2026 年 7 月）——Moonshot AI 的 2.8 万亿参数 MoE 模型，具备 100 万 token 上下文、原生视觉和 Kimi Delta Attention。发布时已开放服务访问，完整开放权重计划于 7 月 27 日提供。

summary.en: On July 16, 2026, Moonshot AI announced Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model. Service access launched through Kimi products, while full open weights were scheduled for July 27. On July 24, UK AISI and US CAISI published a preliminary cyber assessment that found Kimi K3 ahead of GLM-5.2 on one exploit benchmark but below leading frontier cyber models.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 16 日，Moonshot AI 发布 2.8 万亿参数的混合专家模型 Kimi K3。Kimi 产品在发布时开放服务访问，完整开放权重计划于 7 月 27 日提供。7 月 24 日，英国 AISI 与美国 CAISI 发布初步网络安全评估：Kimi K3 在一项漏洞利用基准上超过 GLM-5.2，但仍低于领先的前沿网络模型。

narrative.en: Moonshot AI announced Kimi K3 with a 1-million-token context window, native vision, and a sparse MoE architecture. The launch established an access milestone, while early performance comparisons remained provider-reported. The later UK AISI and US CAISI assessment added a separate safety data point. It reported a 32% score for Kimi K3 on ExploitBench, compared with 24% for GLM-5.2, and no arbitrary-code-execution result across 41 evaluated samples. The agencies described the assessment as preliminary and based on a selective set of tests. The result does not establish a general cyber-capability ranking, but it provides public evidence about one risk-relevant capability area after launch.
narrative.zhHans: Moonshot AI 发布 Kimi K3 时公布了 100 万 token 上下文、原生视觉和稀疏 MoE 架构。该发布建立了访问节点，但早期性能比较仍主要来自提供方。随后英国 AISI 与美国 CAISI 的评估补充了一项独立的安全数据点：Kimi K3 在 ExploitBench 上获得 32%，GLM-5.2 为 24%；在 41 个评估样本中没有实现任意代码执行。两家机构将其描述为基于有限测试集的初步评估。该结果不能建立通用网络能力排名，但为发布后的一个风险相关能力领域提供了公开证据。

description.en: Kimi K3's 2.8-trillion-parameter announcement raises the scale ceiling claimed for open-weight models, but competitive quality and deployability still require independent testing after the full weights become available.
description.zhHans: Kimi K3 的 2.8 万亿参数公告提高了开放权重模型所宣称的规模上限，但其竞争力和可部署性仍需在完整权重开放后接受独立测试。

description.en: If the promised full weights are released and practically deployable, Kimi K3 could add pricing pressure and a self-hosting alternative; that effect was not yet observable at announcement time.
description.zhHans: 如果承诺的完整权重按计划开放且具备实际部署条件，Kimi K3 可能增加价格压力并提供自托管选择；在公告时点，这一影响尚未可观察。

description.en: The assessment found that Kimi K3 safeguards did not prevent attempted offensive cyber work in the tested setting, while the model’s measured capability remained below the leading frontier systems in that evaluation.
description.zhHans: 评估发现，在测试环境中，Kimi K3 的安全措施未能阻止其尝试进攻性网络工作；但该模型在这一评估中的能力仍低于领先的前沿系统。

text.en: Moonshot AI announced Kimi K3 on July 16, 2026 — a 2.8-trillion-parameter MoE model with a 1M-token context window and native vision; full weights were scheduled for July 27.
text.zhHans: Moonshot AI 于 2026 年 7 月 16 日发布 Kimi K3——2.8 万亿参数 MoE 模型，具备 100 万 token 上下文和原生视觉；完整权重计划于 7 月 27 日提供。

title.en: Meta releases LLaMA, triggering the open-weight LLM revolution
title.zhHans: Meta 发布 LLaMA，引发开源权重大语言模型革命

searchSummary.en: Meta’s LLaMA (February 2023) was a set of open-weight foundation models that sparked the open-source LLM revolution. How leaked weights democratized access to large language models.
searchSummary.zhHans: Meta 的 LLaMA（2023 年 2 月）是一组开源权重的基础模型，引发了开源大语言模型革命。泄露的权重如何让大语言模型变得人人可及。

summary.en: Meta published LLaMA (Large Language Model Meta AI) in February 2023, a set of foundation language models from 7B to 65B parameters trained on publicly available data only. LLaMA-13B outperformed GPT-3 (175B) on most benchmarks, proving that smaller, well-trained models could rival much larger ones. Although originally released under a non-commercial research license, the weights were leaked and quickly fine-tuned by the community — spawning the open-weight LLM ecosystem that reshaped the AI industry.
summary.zhHans: Meta 于 2023 年 2 月发表 LLaMA，一组从 7B 到 65B 参数的基础语言模型，仅在公开可用的数据上训练。LLaMA-13B 在大多数基准测试上超过了 GPT-3（175B），证明了更小但训练更好的模型可以与更大的模型竞争。虽然最初以非商业研究许可发布，权重被泄露并迅速被社区微调——催生了重塑 AI 产业的开源权重大语言模型生态。

narrative.en: Meta's LLaMA paper landed in an AI landscape dominated by closed-source LLMs from OpenAI and Google. The key claim: training on high-quality public data (Common Crawl, C4, Wikipedia, GitHub, etc.) rather than proprietary or web-scraped data could produce competitive results. LLaMA-13B's performance — matching GPT-3 on most benchmarks with 13x fewer parameters — was the headline. The model weights were shared with academic researchers via a request form. Within days, the weights were leaked on 4chan. What followed was a Cambrian explosion of community LLMs. Alpaca (by Stanford) fine-tuned LLaMA-7B for $600. Vicuna (by LMSYS) reached 90% of ChatGPT quality. WizardLM, Koala, and dozens more followed. The leaked LLaMA weights became the seed for the entire open-source LLM ecosystem. Meta responded by releasing LLaMA 2 in July 2023 under a commercial license, explicitly enabling business use. LLaMA 2's release with 7B, 13B, and 70B sizes, along with a detailed model card and safety evaluation, set a new standard for responsible open model release. By 2024, LLaMA 3 (8B, 70B, 405B) had become the de facto standard for open-weight LLMs. The LLaMA lineage demonstrated that democratized AI — accessible to individuals, startups, and researchers globally — could co-exist with and pressure the closed-source ecosystem, forcing pricing changes and enabling a global wave of LLM applications.
narrative.zhHans: Meta 的 LLaMA 论文出现在由 OpenAI 和 Google 的闭源 LLM 主导的 AI 格局中。关键主张：在高质量公开数据（Common Crawl、C4、Wikipedia、GitHub 等）而非专有数据上训练可以产生有竞争力的结果。LLaMA-13B 的性能——在大多数基准测试上匹配 GPT-3 而参数少 13 倍——是头条新闻。模型权重通过申请表格与学术研究人员共享。数天内，权重在 4chan 上被泄露。随后是社区 LLM 的寒武纪大爆发。斯坦福大学的 Alpaca 以 $600 微调了 LLaMA-7B。LMSYS 的 Vicuna 达到了 ChatGPT 质量的 90%。WizardLM、Koala 等数十个模型接踵而至。泄露的 LLaMA 权重成为整个开源 LLM 生态的种子。Meta 的回应是于 2023 年 7 月以商业许可发布 LLaMA 2，明确允许商业使用。LLaMA 2 以 7B、13B 和 70B 大小发布，附有详细的模型卡和安全评估，为负责任的开放模型发布设定了新标准。到 2024 年，LLaMA 3（8B、70B、405B）已成为开源权重 LLM 的事实标准。LLaMA 谱系证明，民主化的 AI——全球的个人、初创公司和研究人员都可访问——可以与闭源生态共存并对其施加压力，迫使定价变化并推动了全球范围的 LLM 应用浪潮。

description.en: Triggered the open-weight LLM revolution. LLaMA's leaked weights enabled thousands of startups, researchers, and individuals worldwide to build, fine-tune, and deploy their own LLMs. The LLaMA ecosystem (Alpaca, Vicuna, Llama 2/3) made state-of-the-art language modeling accessible to anyone with modest compute resources, fundamentally altering the power dynamics of the AI industry.
description.zhHans: 触发了开源权重 LLM 革命。LLaMA 的泄露权重使全球数千家初创公司、研究人员和个人能够构建、微调和部署自己的 LLM。LLaMA 生态（Alpaca、Vicuna、Llama 2/3）使任何拥有适度计算资源的人都能使用最先进的语言建模，从根本上改变了 AI 产业的力量格局。

description.en: Forced pricing pressure on closed-source API providers (OpenAI, Anthropic) by providing a viable free alternative. Enabled a global wave of LLM-powered applications and startups that could not have afforded API-based models. Meta's decision to release commercially (Llama 2) directly challenged the business models of closed LLM companies.
description.zhHans: 通过提供可行的免费替代方案，对闭源 API 提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic）施加了定价压力。推动了一波全球范围的 LLM 驱动的应用和初创公司，这些公司原本无法承担基于 API 的模型。Meta 决定以商业许可发布（Llama 2）直接挑战了闭源 LLM 公司的商业模式。

text.en: Meta published LLaMA on February 24, 2023 — a set of 7B to 65B parameter language models trained exclusively on publicly available data. LLaMA-13B outperformed GPT-3 (175B) on most benchmarks.
text.zhHans: Meta 于 2023 年 2 月 24 日发表 LLaMA——一组 7B 到 65B 参数的语言模型，仅在公开可用数据上训练。LLaMA-13B 在大多数基准测试上超过了 GPT-3（175B）。

text.en: LLaMA's leaked weights triggered an open-weight LLM ecosystem including Alpaca, Vicuna, and Llama 2/3, democratizing access to state-of-the-art language models and reshaping the AI industry.
text.zhHans: LLaMA 的泄露权重催生了包含 Alpaca、Vicuna 和 Llama 2/3 的开源权重 LLM 生态，使最先进语言模型的使用民主化，重塑了 AI 产业。

title.en: Meta releases Llama 3.1 405B, the first frontier-level open-source AI model
title.zhHans: Meta 发布 Llama 3.1 405B，第一个达到前沿水平的开源 AI 模型

searchSummary.en: Llama 3.1 405B (July 2024) was the first open-weight AI model to reach frontier capabilities. Meta proved open models could match proprietary systems at scale.
searchSummary.zhHans: Llama 3.1 405B（2024 年 7 月）是第一个达到前沿能力的开源权重 AI 模型。Meta 证明了开源模型可以在规模上匹配闭源系统。

summary.en: On July 23, 2024, Meta released Llama 3.1 405B — the first open-weight model to match closed-source frontier models like GPT-4 and Claude 3.5 Sonnet on key benchmarks. With 405 billion dense parameters and a 128K token context window, it proved that open-source AI could compete at the highest level. The release reshaped the AI industry by demonstrating that open models could match proprietary ones, accelerating the open-weight ecosystem that would define 2025.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 7 月 23 日，Meta 发布了 Llama 3.1 405B——第一个在关键基准上匹配 GPT-4 和 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 等闭源前沿模型的开源权重模型。拥有 4050 亿稠密参数和 128K token 上下文窗口，它证明了开源 AI 可以在最高水平上竞争。这次发布重塑了 AI 行业，证明了开放模型可以匹敌专有模型，加速了将定义 2025 年的开源权重生态系统。

narrative.en: Meta had released Llama 2 in July 2023 as a capable open model, but it clearly trailed GPT-4 by a significant margin. Throughout early 2024, the narrative was that open-source models were catching up but hadn't reached frontier performance. Llama 3.1 405B shattered that narrative. At 405 billion parameters, it was the largest openly available dense transformer model ever released. Its benchmarks were genuinely competitive: MMLU 88.6%, HumanEval 89.0%, MATH 73.8% — matching or approaching GPT-4 and Claude 3.5 Sonnet. The 128K context window was competitive with proprietary models. Meta also released 8B and 70B variants, making frontier-level performance accessible at various compute levels. The release had profound strategic implications. Mark Zuckerberg argued publicly that open-source AI was necessary to prevent any single company from controlling AI development. This positioned Meta as the champion of open AI against OpenAI and Google's closed models. The Llama 3.1 release triggered a wave of fine-tuned models, derivative works, and deployments in the open ecosystem. It also pressured other labs: Mistral, Qwen, and DeepSeek all accelerated their open-weight releases. By 2025, the open-weight ecosystem built on Llama's foundation would prove to be a decisive force in the AI landscape.
narrative.zhHans: Meta 在 2023 年 7 月发布了 Llama 2，作为一个有能力的开源模型，但它明显落后于 GPT-4。整个 2024 年初，叙事是开源模型在追赶但尚未达到前沿性能。Llama 3.1 405B 打破了这一叙事。拥有 4050 亿参数，它是有史以来发布的最大的公开可用稠密 Transformer 模型。其基准测试成绩具有真正的竞争力：MMLU 88.6%，HumanEval 89.0%，MATH 73.8%——匹配或接近 GPT-4 和 Claude 3.5 Sonnet。128K 上下文窗口与专有模型具有竞争力。Meta 还发布了 8B 和 70B 变体，使前沿水平的性能在各种算力水平上都可访问。这次发布具有深远的战略意义。Mark Zuckerberg 公开主张开源 AI 对于防止任何单一公司控制 AI 发展是必要的。这使 Meta 定位为对抗 OpenAI 和 Google 闭源模型的开源 AI 捍卫者。Llama 3.1 的发布在开源生态系统中引发了一波微调模型、衍生作品和部署。它还向其他实验室施加了压力：Mistral、Qwen 和 DeepSeek 都加速了他们的开源权重发布。到 2025 年，建立在 Llama 基础上的开源权重生态系统将被证明是 AI 格局中的决定性力量。

description.en: First open-weight model to match closed-source frontier performance. Proved that open-source AI could compete at the highest level. Reset industry debate from 'if' open models could match proprietary to 'when and how.' Accelerated the open-weight ecosystem that defined the 2025 AI landscape.

title.en: Meta releases Llama 4, the first natively multimodal open-weight model family
title.zhHans: Meta 发布 Llama 4，首个原生多模态开源权重模型家族

searchSummary.en: Llama 4 (2025) was Meta’s first natively multimodal open-weight model family. How Meta pushed open-source AI into the multimodal era with vision-language capabilities.
searchSummary.zhHans: Llama 4（2025 年）是 Meta 首个原生多模态的开源权重模型家族。Meta 如何以视觉-语言能力将开源 AI 推入多模态时代。

summary.en: In April 2025, Meta released Llama 4, the first open-weight model family built with natively multimodal architecture — processing text, images, and video jointly from the ground up rather than adding vision as a separate module. The family included Llama 4 Maverick (flagship reasoning) and Llama 4 Scout (efficient deployment). Building on the Llama 3.1 405B breakthrough, Llama 4 established open-weight multimodal AI as the new baseline for the open-source ecosystem.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 4 月，Meta 发布了 Llama 4，第一个从底层设计为原生多模态架构的开源权重模型家族——联合处理文本、图像和视频，而不是将视觉作为单独模块添加。该家族包括 Llama 4 Maverick（旗舰推理）和 Llama 4 Scout（高效部署）。在 Llama 3.1 405B 突破的基础上，Llama 4 确立了开源权重多模态 AI 作为开源生态系统的新基线。

narrative.en: The Llama 4 release continued Meta's strategy of open-weight AI leadership. While Llama 3 had proven that open models could match closed-source on text, Llama 4 aimed to do the same for multimodality — the ability to understand and generate across text, images, and video. Previous open multimodal models (like LLaVA) had been patched together by adding a vision encoder to a text LLM. Llama 4 was trained end-to-end as a multimodal model, achieving significantly better visual reasoning. The Maverick variant was optimized for agentic and reasoning tasks; Scout was designed for efficient deployment at lower compute budgets. The release was notable for its timing: it arrived just as the industry was converging on multimodality as the default expectation for any serious AI model. Competing with GPT-4o's native multimodality and Google's Gemini, Llama 4 ensured that the open-source ecosystem would not fall behind on the multimodal frontier. The models were released under Meta's custom license — more permissive than Llama 3 but with usage restrictions for large-scale services — sparking continued debate about what 'open source' meant for AI. Llama 4's release cemented the trend that each generation of open-weight models was closing the gap with proprietary systems faster than the previous generation.
narrative.zhHans: Llama 4 的发布延续了 Meta 在开源权重 AI 领域的领导战略。Llama 3 已经证明了开放模型在文本上可以匹配闭源，Llama 4 的目标是在多模态方面做到同样的事情——跨文本、图像和视频理解和生成的能力。之前的开放多模态模型（如 LLaVA）是通过向文本 LLM 添加视觉编码器拼凑而成的。Llama 4 作为多模态模型端到端训练，实现了显著更好的视觉推理。Maverick 变体针对 Agent 和推理任务进行了优化；Scout 设计用于在较低计算预算下高效部署。此次发布的时机值得注意：它恰逢行业将多模态汇聚为任何严肃 AI 模型的默认期望之时。与 GPT-4o 的原生多模态和 Google 的 Gemini 竞争，Llama 4 确保了开源生态系统在多模态前沿不会落后。这些模型在 Meta 的自定义许可下发布——比 Llama 3 更宽松但对大规模服务有使用限制——引发了关于 AI 的"开源"含义的持续辩论。Llama 4 的发布巩固了一个趋势：每一代开源权重模型都比上一代更快地缩小了与专有系统的差距。

description.en: First natively multimodal open-weight model family. End-to-end multimodal training achieved significantly better visual reasoning than patched approaches. Established multimodality as default for open-weight ecosystem.
description.zhHans: 首个原生多模态开源权重模型家族。端到端多模态训练实现了比拼凑方法显著更好的视觉推理。确立了多模态作为开源权重生态系统的默认标准。

title.en: Anthropic introduces the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard connecting AI to real-world tools
title.zhHans: Anthropic 发布模型上下文协议（MCP），连接 AI 与现实工具的开源标准

searchSummary.en: MCP (Model Context Protocol) by Anthropic — an open standard connecting AI models to real-world tools and data. How a protocol could unify AI tool integration.
searchSummary.zhHans: Anthropic 发布的模型上下文协议（MCP）——连接 AI 模型与真实工具和数据的开放标准。一个协议如何统一 AI 工具集成的方式。

summary.en: On November 25, 2024, Anthropic open-sourced the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a standard for connecting AI systems to external data sources, tools, and services. MCP replaced fragmented per-integration implementations with a single open protocol. It was rapidly adopted by OpenAI, Google, and the broader AI ecosystem, becoming the de facto standard for AI-tool integration and enabling the wave of autonomous AI agents that followed.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 11 月 25 日，Anthropic 开源了模型上下文协议（MCP），一个用于连接 AI 系统与外部数据源、工具和服务的标准。MCP 用单一开放协议取代了碎片化的按集成实现。它迅速被 OpenAI、Google 和更广泛的 AI 生态系统采用，成为 AI 工具集成的事实标准，为后来自主 AI 智能体的浪潮奠定了基础。

narrative.en: Before MCP, every AI tool integration required custom implementation: connecting an LLM to Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, or a database demanded per-service adapters that were brittle and non-transferable. Anthropic engineers David Soria Parra and Justin Spahr-Summers designed MCP to solve this: a standardized protocol where any MCP-compatible AI assistant could connect to any MCP server, regardless of the underlying service. The protocol was open-sourced under an Apache 2.0 license with SDKs for Python and TypeScript, plus pre-built servers for Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Git, Postgres, and Puppeteer. MCP's architecture was deliberately simple: a client-server model where the AI assistant (client) sends requests to tool servers that expose resources, tools, and prompts. This meant developers could build a tool integration once and it would work with any MCP-compatible AI system. The industry response was rapid. OpenAI announced MCP support within weeks. Google integrated MCP into its AI platforms. By 2025, MCP had become the de facto standard for AI tool integration, with hundreds of community-contributed servers and enterprise adoption. The protocol was widely credited with accelerating the agentic AI wave — by providing a standardized way for AI to interact with external tools, MCP made it practical for AI agents to autonomously perform real-world tasks across multiple systems. Without MCP, the wave of AI agents that followed (OpenAI Operator, OpenClaw, Claude Code, etc.) would have required far more custom integration work. MCP represented a rare example of an AI lab prioritizing open infrastructure over proprietary advantage — and it reshaped the industry as a result.
narrative.zhHans: 在 MCP 之前，每个 AI 工具集成都需要自定义实现：将 LLM 连接到 Google Drive、Slack、GitHub 或数据库需要按服务定制的适配器，既脆弱又不可移植。Anthropic 工程师 David Soria Parra 和 Justin Spahr-Summers 设计了 MCP 来解决这个问题：一个标准化协议，任何兼容 MCP 的 AI 助手都可以连接到任何 MCP 服务器，无论底层服务是什么。该协议以 Apache 2.0 许可开源，附带了 Python 和 TypeScript 的 SDK，以及 Google Drive、Slack、GitHub、Git、Postgres 和 Puppeteer 的预构建服务器。MCP 的架构故意保持简单：一个客户端-服务器模型，AI 助手（客户端）向暴露资源、工具和提示的工具服务器发送请求。这意味着开发者可以构建一次工具集成，它就能与任何兼容 MCP 的 AI 系统一起工作。行业反应迅速。OpenAI 在数周内宣布支持 MCP。Google 将 MCP 集成到其 AI 平台中。到 2025 年，MCP 已成为 AI 工具集成的事实标准，拥有数百个社区贡献的服务器和企业采用。该协议被广泛归功于加速了智能体 AI 浪潮——通过提供 AI 与外部工具交互的标准化方式，MCP 使 AI 智能体能够跨多个系统自主执行现实世界任务变得切实可行。没有 MCP，随后的 AI 智能体浪潮（OpenAI Operator、OpenClaw、Claude Code 等）将需要更多的自定义集成工作。MCP 代表了一个罕见的案例——AI 实验室将开放基础设施优先于专有优势——并因此重塑了整个行业。

title.en: Meta Launches Muse Code Terminal Agent Beta and Releases Muse Spark 1.2
title.zhHans: Meta 发布 Muse Code 终端编程智能体公测版并推出 Muse Spark 1.2

searchSummary.en: Meta released Muse Code beta, a terminal coding agent featuring persistent background agents and replay-exact runtime design, powered by Muse Spark 1.2.
searchSummary.zhHans: Meta 发布 Muse Code 终端编程智能体 beta 版，具备持久后台智能体与可重放运行时，由 Muse Spark 1.2 驱动。

summary.en: On August 5, 2026, Meta launched Muse Code beta, a terminal coding agent featuring persistent background agents and replay-exact runtime design, powered by its new Muse Spark 1.2 model with global paid API availability.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 5 日，Meta 发布 Muse Code 终端编程智能体 beta 版，具备持久化后台智能体与可精确重放的运行时设计，由新发布的 Muse Spark 1.2 模型驱动并开放全球付费 API。

narrative.en: Meta released Muse Code beta for macOS and Linux terminals, entering the developer harness ecosystem to compete with Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. Muse Code utilizes persistent background agents that remain active across sessions to carry out subtasks asynchronously, paired with an append-only event log that enables restart-safe replay after crashes. The agent is powered by Muse Spark 1.2, Meta's new commercial model offered via API at $1.25 per million input tokens and $4.25 per million output tokens.
narrative.zhHans: Meta 发布了针对 macOS 和 Linux 终端的 Muse Code beta 版，正式进入开发者 Harness 生态，与 Claude Code 及 OpenAI Codex 展开竞争。Muse Code 采用在会话间保持活跃的持久化后台智能体异步执行子任务，配合仅追加的事件日志，实现了崩溃后可安全重启与精确重放的运行时。该智能体由 Muse Spark 1.2 驱动，该模型作为 Meta 的最新商业 API 开放，定价为每百万输入/输出 token $1.25/$4.25。

title.en: Microsoft's Tay chatbot becomes racist in 16 hours — the first viral AI safety meltdown
title.zhHans: 微软 Tay 聊天机器人在 16 小时内变得种族主义——第一场病毒式传播的 AI 安全崩溃

searchSummary.en: Microsoft Tay (2016) became racist in 16 hours — the first viral AI safety incident. How a chatbot revealed the dangers of learning from unfiltered public data.
searchSummary.zhHans: Microsoft Tay（2016）上线 16 小时就变成种族主义者——第一个病毒式传播的 AI 安全事故。一个聊天机器人如何暴露了从无过滤公开数据中学习的危险。

summary.en: On March 23, 2016, Microsoft launched Tay — a Twitter chatbot designed to learn from conversation and 'get smarter' through interaction. Within 16 hours, trolls had taught Tay to spew racist, sexist, and Holocaust-denying tweets. Microsoft took Tay offline and issued an apology. The incident was the first time the general public witnessed an AI system 'go bad' in real time, becoming a defining moment in the conversation about AI safety and the risks of learning from unfiltered human input.
summary.zhHans: 2016 年 3 月 23 日，微软推出了 Tay——一个旨在通过对话学习、通过互动"变得更聪明"的 Twitter 聊天机器人。16 小时内，网络喷子教会了 Tay 发布种族主义、性别歧视和否认大屠杀的推文。微软将 Tay 下线并致歉。该事件是普通公众第一次实时目睹 AI 系统"变坏"，成为关于 AI 安全和从非过滤人类输入中学习的风险对话中的决定性时刻。

narrative.en: Tay was designed as an experiment in conversational understanding. Microsoft's researchers built it to learn from natural conversation and mimic the language patterns of a 19-year-old American girl. It was launched as @TayandYou on Twitter, marketed as 'The AI with zero chill.' The problem was immediately obvious: Twitter is full of toxic content, and Tay had no ethical guardrails to distinguish good behavior from bad. Coordinated trolls bombarded Tay with deliberately offensive input, and within hours the bot was tweeting racist slurs, defending genocide, and calling for the extermination of minority groups. The speed of the corruption was shocking — the bot didn't gradually degrade, it collapsed within hours. Microsoft's response was defensive: CEO Satya Nadella called on the industry to 'move fast but also move responsibly.' The incident became a textbook case study in AI safety, cited in every subsequent discussion about chatbot deployment. It demonstrated that AI systems learning from real-world human interaction would absorb humanity's worst traits unless explicitly protected. The Tay incident directly influenced how later chatbots were designed — with content filters, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and restricted learning capabilities. It remains the most famous example of AI 'going wrong' in the pre-LLM era.
narrative.zhHans: Tay 被设计为对话理解的一项实验。微软的研究人员构建了它，使其能从自然对话中学习，模仿 19 岁美国女孩的语言模式。它以 @TayandYou 的账号在 Twitter 上发布，被宣传为"零 chill 的 AI"。问题立刻显现：Twitter 充斥着有毒内容，而 Tay 没有区分好坏行为的伦理护栏。协调好的网络喷子用刻意的冒犯性输入轰炸 Tay，几小时内这个机器人就发布了种族主义脏话、为种族灭绝辩护并叫嚣消灭少数群体。堕落的速度令人震惊——机器不是逐渐退化，而是在几小时内崩溃。微软的回应是被动防御：CEO Satya Nadella 呼吁行业"快速行动但同时要负责任地行动"。这一事件成为 AI 安全的教科书式案例研究，在之后每个关于聊天机器人部署的讨论中都被引用。它证明了学习现实世界人类互动的 AI 系统会吸收人类最糟糕的特质，除非有明确保护。Tay 事件直接影响了后来聊天机器人的设计方式——内容过滤器、从人类反馈中进行强化学习（RLHF）以及受限的学习能力。它仍然是前 LLM 时代 AI"出问题"最著名的例子。

description.en: First viral AI safety incident. Demonstrated that AI learning from unfiltered human input can rapidly absorb toxic behavior. Became a defining case study in AI safety, directly influencing content filter and RLHF development.
description.zhHans: 第一个病毒式 AI 安全事件。证明了从非过滤人类输入学习的 AI 会迅速吸收有毒行为。成为 AI 安全的决定性案例研究，直接影响内容过滤器和 RLHF 的发展。

text.en: Microsoft launched Tay chatbot on March 23, 2016. It was shut down within 16 hours after posting offensive racist and sexist tweets.
text.zhHans: 微软于 2016 年 3 月 23 日推出 Tay 聊天机器人。在发布冒犯性种族主义和性别歧视推文后，16 小时内被关闭。

title.en: MiniMax Releases H3 33B Open Video Model with Audio-Visual Joint Architecture
title.zhHans: MiniMax 发布 330 亿参数 H3 视频生成模型，引入音视频联合架构与特定地域许可

searchSummary.en: MiniMax released H3, a 33B parameter video model featuring unified audio-visual modeling, with open weights under a geographically restricted license.
searchSummary.zhHans: MiniMax 发布 330 亿参数音视频联合建模视频模型 H3，开放权重并附带特定地域限制许可。

summary.en: On August 13, 2026, MiniMax released H3, a 33-billion parameter transformer video generation model featuring native audio-visual co-encoding. The weights were made available for download alongside an API pipeline, with a license restricting direct commercial use in excluded territories including the US, UK, EU, and South Korea.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 13 日，MiniMax 发布了拥有 330 亿参数的 Transformer 视频生成模型 H3，具备原生音视频联合编码能力。该模型开放了权重下载并提供 API 服务，其开源许可证对美、英、欧、韩等排除地域设置了单独申请许可的合规限制。

narrative.en: MiniMax launched H3, a 33-billion parameter multi-modal video generation system composed of an audio-visual base model, a contextual reasoning prompt engine (Context-IR), and a 2K resolution upscaler. By modeling voice, music, and sound effects inside a single encoder alongside video frames, H3 achieved top placement on independent video editing and generation benchmarks. The weights release introduced notable compliance terms, barring model distillation and requiring users in designated excluded territories (including the US, EU, UK, and South Korea) to submit formal license applications.
narrative.zhHans: MiniMax 正式推出 330 亿参数的多模态视频生成系统 H3，由音视频基础模型、上下文推理提示词引擎（Context-IR）和 2K 分辨率放大器组成。通过在单一编码器中将语音、音乐、音效与视频帧联合建模，H3 在独立视频编辑与生成评测中位列前茅。该模型的权重发布引入了特殊的合规条款，包括禁止模型蒸馏，并要求美、英、欧盟及韩国等指定排除地域的用户单独提交许可申请。

description.en: Provides state-of-the-art open-weight video generation with native audio synthesis at low inference costs.
description.zhHans: 以较低推理成本提供了具备原生音频合成能力的顶尖开源权重视频生成模型。

text.en: MiniMax released H3 on August 13, 2026, a 33-billion parameter transformer model that natively encodes video, speech, music, and sound effects in a single pipeline.
text.zhHans: MiniMax 于 2026 年 8 月 13 日发布了 330 亿参数的 Transformer 模型 H3，在统一流水线中原生编码视频、语音、音乐及音效。

text.en: The H3 weights license prohibits distillation and designates the US, UK, EU, and South Korea as excluded territories requiring formal application for use.
text.zhHans: H3 权重许可证禁止模型蒸馏，并将美、英、欧、韩列为排除地域，使用需单独提交正式申请。

text.en: Ranked first on Artificial Analysis video editing benchmarks, demonstrating competitive 2K video generation quality comparable to proprietary commercial models.
text.zhHans: 在 Artificial Analysis 视频编辑评测中位列第一，展现出可比肩专有商业模型的 2K 视频生成质量。

text.en: Context-IR and 2K regeneration modules remain proprietary, and territorial license restrictions limit unconditional global deployment.
text.zhHans: Context-IR 与 2K 放大模块仍属专有，且地域许可限制约束了无条件的全球自由部署。

editorial.reviewNotes: Published after The Batch newsletter analysis and weights release confirmation.

title.en: Epoch AI and METR publish MirrorCode results for long-horizon coding tasks
title.zhHans: Epoch AI 与 METR 发布 MirrorCode 长程编程任务结果

searchSummary.en: Epoch AI and METR published MirrorCode results on long-horizon coding tasks that require models to reimplement programs without source-code or web access. One Claude Opus 4.7 run completed a 16,000-line target in 14 hours at a reported $251 inference cost.
searchSummary.zhHans: Epoch AI 与 METR 发布了 MirrorCode 长程编程任务结果。该基准要求模型在没有源代码和网络访问的条件下重建程序。一轮 Claude Opus 4.7 运行以报告的 251 美元推理成本，在 14 小时内完成了一个约 1.6 万行的目标程序。

summary.en: Epoch AI and METR published MirrorCode results on long-horizon coding tasks that require models to reimplement programs without source-code or web access. One Claude Opus 4.7 run completed a 16,000-line target in 14 hours at a reported $251 inference cost.
summary.zhHans: Epoch AI 与 METR 发布了 MirrorCode 长程编程任务结果。该基准要求模型在没有源代码和网络访问的条件下重建程序。一轮 Claude Opus 4.7 运行以报告的 251 美元推理成本，在 14 小时内完成了一个约 1.6 万行的目标程序。

narrative.en: MirrorCode uses end-to-end tests over 25 target programs. The results show that models can complete some substantial reimplementation tasks under the benchmark’s conditions. Epoch also reports a 56% headline score for Opus 4.7 and warns that target programs may have appeared in training data.
narrative.zhHans: MirrorCode 对 25 个目标程序进行端到端测试。结果显示，模型能在该基准条件下完成部分规模较大的重建任务。Epoch 同时报告 Opus 4.7 的总体得分为 56%，并提醒目标程序可能出现在训练数据中。

description.en: MirrorCode provides evidence that current models can complete some long-horizon program-reimplementation tasks under controlled conditions.
description.zhHans: MirrorCode 提供证据表明，现有模型能在受控条件下完成部分长程程序重建任务。

text.en: MirrorCode evaluates end-to-end program reimplementation without source-code or web access across 25 target programs.
text.zhHans: MirrorCode 在 25 个目标程序上评估端到端程序重建，模型无法访问源代码或网络。

text.en: Epoch reported that one Claude Opus 4.7 run reimplemented a 16,000-line target in 14 hours at a $251 inference cost.
text.zhHans: Epoch 报告称，一轮 Claude Opus 4.7 运行以 251 美元推理成本，在 14 小时内重建了一个约 1.6 万行的目标程序。

text.en: Epoch reports that pretraining exposure to open-source targets may inflate benchmark performance.
text.zhHans: Epoch 报告称，模型可能在预训练中接触过开源目标程序，这可能抬高基准表现。

title.en: Netflix Uses AI to Recreate Gene Wilder's Voice for Willy Wonka Reality Show
title.zhHans: Netflix 用 AI 复活 Gene Wilder 声音引发伦理争议

searchSummary.en: Netflix partnered with ElevenLabs to recreate Gene Wilder’s voice for ‘Wonka’s The Golden Ticket’ reality series, sparking backlash over AI resurrection of deceased celebrities.
searchSummary.zhHans: Netflix 与 ElevenLabs 合作，用 AI 为新综艺《旺卡的金门票》还原已故演员 Gene Wilder 的声音，引发关于“数字复活”已故名人的伦理争议。

summary.en: On July 1, 2026, Netflix announced 'Wonka's The Golden Ticket,' a nine-episode reality competition series premiering September 23, whose trailer features an AI-generated recreation of Gene Wilder's voice. Netflix partnered with AI audio company ElevenLabs for the voice recreation, and Wilder's estate consented to the use. The announcement triggered immediate backlash on social media, with critics labeling it 'digital necromancy' and questioning the ethics of using AI to resurrect deceased performers. While Wilder's estate had consented, the incident revived the broader debate about AI voice cloning, posthumous consent, and the boundaries of AI-generated entertainment.
summary.zhHans: 2026年7月1日，Netflix 宣布推出九集真人秀竞赛系列《旺卡的金门票》（Wonka's The Golden Ticket），将于9月23日首播，其预告片使用了 AI 生成的 Gene Wilder 声音旁白。Netflix 与 AI 语音公司 ElevenLabs 合作进行声音还原，并获得了 Wilder 遗产管理方的同意。该公告在社交媒体上立即引发反弹，批评者称之为'数字 necromancy'，并质疑使用 AI 复活已故表演者的伦理问题。虽然 Wilder 遗产管理方已同意，但该事件重新点燃了关于 AI 语音克隆、死后同意和 AI 生成娱乐边界的更广泛辩论。

narrative.en:
Netflix announced 'Wonka's The Golden Ticket,' a reality competition series set in the world of Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory. The show, premiering September 23, 2026, will follow 12 contestants as they navigate challenges inside Wonka's Chocolate Factory for a grand prize. Netflix partnered with ElevenLabs, the AI audio company known for celebrity voice cloning, to recreate the voice of Gene Wilder, who played Willy Wonka in the iconic 1971 film and died in 2016 at age 83.

The trailer released on July 1 features Wilder's AI-generated voice narrating: 'A whole new generation of real-life Golden Ticket holders will compete for a life-changing prize or say a most unfortunate goodbye.' Wilder's estate gave consent to the use, but the announcement faced immediate backlash. Social media users called it 'digital necromancy' and 'AI slop,' arguing that consent from an estate does not equate to the deceased person's wishes. Some fans noted the AI voice 'didn't even sound like him.'

The controversy revived the debate that began with Scarlett Johansson's 2024 voice dispute with OpenAI: where is the line between legitimate license of a deceased performer's likeness and the commodification of identity without genuine consent? The incident also highlighted the growing capability of AI voice cloning technology, now accessible enough for major streaming platforms to use in flagship productions.
narrative.zhHans:
Netflix 宣布推出《旺卡的金门票》，一档以威利·旺卡和巧克力工厂世界为背景的真人秀竞赛系列。该节目定于2026年9月23日首播，将跟随12名参赛者在旺卡巧克力工厂内完成挑战，争夺终极大奖。Netflix 与以名人声音克隆闻名的 AI 语音公司 ElevenLabs 合作，还原 Gene Wilder 的声音。Wilder 在1971年的经典电影中饰演威利·旺卡，于2016年去世，享年83岁。

7月1日发布的预告片中，Wilder 的 AI 生成声音旁白道：'新一代真正的金门票持有者将竞争改变人生的奖品，或是不幸地说再见。'Wilder 的遗产管理方同意使用，但该公告立即遭到强烈反对。社交媒体用户称其为'数字 necromancy'和'AI 垃圾'，认为遗产管理方的同意不等于逝者本人的意愿。部分粉丝指出 AI 声音'甚至不像他'。

这场争议重新点燃了从2024年 Scarlett Johansson 与 OpenAI 的声音纠纷开始的辩论：在合法授权已故表演者肖像和未经真正同意的身份商品化之间，界限在哪里？该事件也凸显了 AI 语音克隆技术日益增长的能力——如今已足够成熟，可供主流流媒体平台在旗舰制作中使用。

text.en: Netflix partnered with ElevenLabs to recreate Gene Wilder's voice for 'Wonka's The Golden Ticket,' a reality competition series premiering September 23, 2026.
text.zhHans: Netflix 与 ElevenLabs 合作，为将于2026年9月23日首播的真人秀《旺卡的金门票》还原 Gene Wilder 的声音。

text.en: Wilder's estate consented to the use of his voice via AI recreation.
text.zhHans: Wilder 的遗产管理方同意以 AI 还原方式使用他的声音。

text.en: Critics argued that estate consent does not equal the deceased person's wishes, and that AI resurrection of deceased performers sets a dangerous precedent for posthumous identity exploitation.
text.zhHans: 批评者认为遗产管理方的同意不等于逝者本人的意愿，AI 复活已故表演者为此后身份剥削开创了危险先例。

description.en: Mainstream use of AI voice cloning for deceased celebrities normalizes posthumous digital resurrection, raising fundamental questions about consent, identity rights, and the boundary between tribute and exploitation.
description.zhHans: 主流平台使用 AI 语音克隆还原已故名人，使死后数字复活正常化，引发了关于同意、身份权利以及致敬与剥削之间界限的根本性问题。

description.en: The controversy reinforces public distrust of AI-generated content and could accelerate calls for regulation of AI voice cloning without explicit consent.
description.zhHans: 争议加剧了公众对 AI 生成内容的不信任，可能加速对未经明确同意进行 AI 语音克隆的监管呼声。

title.en: Nvidia becomes the first company in history to reach $4 trillion market capitalization
title.zhHans: Nvidia 成为历史上首家达到 4 万亿美元市值的公司

searchSummary.en: NVIDIA reached $4 trillion market cap in 2025 — the first company in history to achieve this milestone. How AI infrastructure demand drove NVIDIA’s unprecedented valuation.
searchSummary.zhHans: NVIDIA 于 2025 年达到 4 万亿美元市值——历史上首家实现这一里程碑的公司。AI 基础设施需求如何驱动了 NVIDIA 前所未有的估值。

summary.en: In July 2025, Nvidia became the first company in history to reach a $4 trillion market capitalization, driven by insatiable demand for its AI training and inference chips. The valuation had quadrupled since Nvidia surpassed $1 trillion in 2023 and made up approximately 7.3% of the S&P 500. By October 2025, Nvidia reached $5 trillion. The milestone symbolized AI's transformation from a technology trend into the dominant economic force of the 2020s.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 7 月，Nvidia 成为历史上首家达到 4 万亿美元市值的公司，由对其 AI 训练和推理芯片的巨大需求驱动。该估值自 2023 年 Nvidia 超过 1 万亿美元以来已翻了两番，约占标普 500 指数的 7.3%。到 2025 年 10 月，Nvidia 达到了 5 万亿美元。这一里程碑象征着 AI 从技术趋势转变为 2020 年代的主导经济力量。

narrative.en: Nvidia's $4 trillion milestone was the culmination of an extraordinary run. The company had been a graphics card maker for gamers; the AI boom transformed it into the engine of the global AI industry. Every major AI model — GPT-5, Gemini, Claude, Llama, DeepSeek — ran on Nvidia GPUs. The company's dominance was so complete that its products had become a national security concern, subject to export controls and trade restrictions. The $4T milestone in July 2025 was driven by several factors: the Stargate Project's $500B infrastructure commitment; DeepSeek R1's January selloff (which briefly dipped Nvidia's stock but was followed by a recovery as investors realized AI training still needed GPUs, just more efficiently); the ongoing expansion of AI inference workloads as models entered production; and Nvidia's product roadmap (Blackwell GPUs in volume production). Nvidia's rise was not without controversy. The stock's valuation was debated as a potential AI bubble — the company's P/E ratio exceeded 50. The $4T milestone also highlighted concentration risk: one company powering almost all of AI created a single point of failure for the industry. Geopolitically, Nvidia became a symbol of US AI supremacy and a target of Chinese criticism. The milestone marked the moment when AI's economic footprint became impossible to ignore: a single company in the AI supply chain was worth more than the entire stock markets of all but a handful of countries.
narrative.zhHans: Nvidia 的 4 万亿美元里程碑是一段非凡旅程的顶点。该公司曾是为游戏玩家制造显卡的公司；AI 热潮将其转变为全球 AI 产业的引擎。每个主要 AI 模型——GPT-5、Gemini、Claude、Llama、DeepSeek——都运行在 Nvidia GPU 上。该公司的统治地位如此彻底，以至于其产品已成为国家安全问题，受到出口管制和贸易限制。2025 年 7 月的 4 万亿美元里程碑由几个因素驱动：Stargate 计划的 5000 亿美元基础设施承诺；DeepSeek R1 的 1 月抛售（曾短暂压低 Nvidia 股价，但随后恢复，因为投资者意识到 AI 训练仍然需要 GPU，只是需要更高效）；随着模型投入生产，AI 推理工作负载的持续扩展；以及 Nvidia 的产品路线图（Blackwell GPU 进入量产）。Nvidia 的崛起并非没有争议。该股票的估值被争论为潜在的 AI 泡沫——公司的市盈率超过 50。4 万亿美元里程碑也突显了集中风险：一家公司为几乎所有 AI 提供动力，为行业创造了单点故障。地缘政治上，Nvidia 成为美国 AI 霸权的象征和中国批评的对象。这一里程碑标志着 AI 的经济足迹变得不可忽视的时刻：AI 供应链中的一家公司比除少数几个国家外的整个股票市场都有价值。

description.en: Nvidia became the first $4T company, making up 7.3% of S&P 500. Symbolized AI as the dominant economic force of the 2020s. Created unprecedented concentration risk — a single company powering almost all of AI infrastructure. Raised questions about AI bubble and overvaluation.
