title.en: Siri launches on iPhone 4S — millions of ordinary people meet AI for the first time
title.zhHans: Siri 在 iPhone 4S 上亮相——亿万普通人第一次遇见 AI

searchSummary.en: Siri launched on iPhone 4S in 2011 — the first time millions of ordinary people used conversational AI. How Apple brought AI assistants into everyday life.
searchSummary.zhHans: Siri 于 2011 年在 iPhone 4S 上亮相——这是数以百万计的普通人第一次使用对话式 AI。了解 Apple 如何将 AI 助手带入日常生活。

summary.en: On October 4, 2011, Apple unveiled the iPhone 4S with Siri, the first widely available conversational AI assistant embedded in a mass-market device. For millions of people, Siri was their first direct interaction with artificial intelligence — asking about the weather, setting alarms, or getting answers by voice. Siri transformed AI from a lab concept into a daily reality, paving the way for every voice assistant that followed.
summary.zhHans: 2011 年 10 月 4 日，苹果发布了内置 Siri 的 iPhone 4S，这是首个嵌入大众市场设备的广泛可用对话式 AI 助手。对数百万人来说，Siri 是他们与人工智能的第一次直接互动——通过语音询问天气、设置闹钟或获取答案。Siri 将 AI 从实验室概念变成了日常现实，为所有后来的语音助手铺平了道路。

narrative.en: Siri began life as a standalone app spun out of SRI International's CALO project (a DARPA-funded AI initiative). Apple acquired it in April 2010, then integrated it deeply into the iPhone 4S. At the launch event, Apple executives demoed Siri checking the weather, sending texts, and finding restaurants — simple tasks, but delivered through natural conversation rather than menus and buttons. The cultural reception was immense. Late-night hosts joked about Siri, people shared screenshots of funny Siri conversations, and a new phrase — 'ask Siri' — entered everyday language. Siri had limitations: it failed at complex queries, required internet connectivity, and was easily confused by accents. But it didn't matter. Siri proved that millions of people were ready to talk to machines. It validated the entire conversational AI paradigm that would later culminate in ChatGPT, Alexa, and Google Assistant. Siri was also controversial: its voice recognition collected data back to Apple, raising early privacy questions about always-listening AI. The assistant remained a staple of Apple's ecosystem — evolving over the years with deep learning, becoming more capable but also sparking competition from Amazon's Alexa (2014) and Google Assistant (2016).
narrative.zhHans: Siri 最初是一个独立应用，源自 SRI International 的 CALO 项目（DARPA 资助的 AI 计划）。苹果于 2010 年 4 月将其收购，然后深度集成到 iPhone 4S 中。在发布会上，苹果高管演示了 Siri 查询天气、发送短信和查找餐厅——简单的任务，但通过自然对话而非菜单和按钮完成。文化反响巨大。深夜秀主持人拿 Siri 开玩笑，人们分享有趣的 Siri 对话截图，"问 Siri" 成为日常语言中的新短语。Siri 有局限：复杂查询经常失败，需要网络连接，容易混淆口音。但这并不重要。Siri 证明了数百万人已经准备好与机器对话。它验证了整个对话式 AI 范式，后来在 ChatGPT、Alexa 和 Google Assistant 中达到顶峰。Siri 也有争议：其语音识别将数据传回苹果，引发了关于始终监听 AI 的早期隐私问题。该助手一直是苹果生态系统的核心——多年来随着深度学习的发展不断进化，能力增强，但也引发了来自亚马逊 Alexa（2014 年）和 Google Assistant（2016 年）的竞争。

description.en: First mainstream conversational AI. Put AI in the pockets of millions. Validated voice as a human-AI interface. Created the consumer AI assistant category.
description.zhHans: 首个主流对话式 AI。将 AI 放进了亿万人的口袋。验证了语音作为人机交互界面。创建了消费级 AI 助手品类。

title.en: OpenAI previews Sora, the first text-to-video model that looked like it was working
title.zhHans: OpenAI 预览 Sora，第一个看起来真的能用的文本生视频模型

searchSummary.en: Sora: OpenAI’s February 2024 text-to-video model that stunned the world with realistic AI-generated videos. Timeline of how video generation entered the mainstream.
searchSummary.zhHans: Sora：OpenAI 2024 年 2 月发布的文生视频模型，以逼真的 AI 生成视频震撼了世界。了解视频生成如何进入了主流视野。

summary.en: On February 15, 2024, OpenAI unveiled Sora, a text-to-video generation model that produced strikingly coherent, photorealistic video clips up to one minute long from text prompts. Unlike previous text-to-video efforts that produced glitchy, short, and disjointed output, Sora's results demonstrated object permanence, physical consistency, and cinematic quality. The announcement was a 'GPT-1 moment for video'—the first time video generation seemed to genuinely work.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 2 月 15 日，OpenAI 公布了 Sora，一个文本生视频生成模型，可以从文本提示中生成惊人连贯、逼真的一分钟长视频片段。与此前产生闪烁、短促且脱节输出的文本生视频尝试不同，Sora 的结果展示了物体持久性、物理一致性和电影级的质量。这一宣布是"视频的 GPT-1 时刻"——第一次看起来视频生成真的能用了。

narrative.en: The Sora announcement broke with OpenAI's pattern of rolling access. Rather than putting it behind an API or waitlist, they released a curated set of demonstration videos on social media and a technical report. The videos were stunning: a photorealistic woolly mammoth moving through a snowy landscape, a cinematic tracking shot of a Tokyo street in the snow, a short fluffy monster next to a candle, and fake historical footage of the California gold rush. The quality was so far beyond existing text-to-video systems (Runway, Pika) that it triggered a new wave of both excitement and alarm. Hollywood took immediate notice. Tyler Perry halted an $800 million studio expansion, saying the technology would make physical sets obsolete. The WGA and SAG-AFTRA, fresh off their 2023 strikes, pushed for stronger AI protections. Adobe, Runway, and Google accelerated their own video generation work. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman used Sora to generate videos based on user suggestions on X (then Twitter), turning the launch into an interactive spectacle. The technical report, 'Video Generation Models as World Simulators,' revealed Sora was built on a diffusion transformer architecture—combining the diffusion models used in image generation (like DALL-E) with the Transformer architecture proven in language models. This architectural choice, treating video patches analogously to text tokens, hinted at a path toward models that understand the physical world, not just generate pixels. Sora was released publicly as 'Sora Turbo' in December 2024, at which point the novelty had already been absorbed into an accelerating landscape of AI-generated media, deepfake concerns, and debates about the future of visual truth.
narrative.zhHans: Sora 的公布打破了 OpenAI 逐步推出的模式。他们没有将其放在 API 或候补名单后，而是在社交媒体上发布了一组精心策划的演示视频和一篇技术报告。这些视频令人惊叹：一只逼真的长毛猛犸象在雪景中行走，一个东京雪街的电影级跟拍镜头，蜡烛旁的毛茸茸小怪物，以及加利福尼亚淘金热的伪造历史画面。其质量远超现有的文本生视频系统（Runway、Pika），引发了一轮新的兴奋与警觉。好莱坞立即关注。Tyler Perry 暂停了一项 8 亿美元的制片厂扩建计划，称这项技术将使实景布景过时。刚从 2023 年罢工中走出来的 WGA 和 SAG-AFTRA 推动了更强的 AI 保护。Adobe、Runway 和 Google 加速了各自的视频生成工作。OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在 X（当时是 Twitter）上使用 Sora 根据用户建议生成视频，将发布变成了一场互动盛宴。技术报告《作为世界模拟器的视频生成模型》揭示了 Sora 基于扩散 Transformer 架构——将用于图像生成的扩散模型（如 DALL-E）与在语言模型中验证过的 Transformer 架构结合起来。这一架构选择将视频区块类比于文本标记，暗示了通向理解物理世界而非仅仅生成像素的模型的道路。Sora 于 2024 年 12 月作为"Sora Turbo"公开发布，此时其新奇性已被吸收进 AI 生成媒体、深度伪造担忧以及关于视觉真相未来的辩论的加速景观中。

description.en: First text-to-video model to demonstrate object permanence, coherent motion, and cinematic quality at up to one minute length. The diffusion transformer architecture (combining diffusion with Transformers) proved transferable from image to video generation, suggesting a convergence path for generative AI architectures.
description.zhHans: 首个展示物体持久性、连贯运动和电影级质量的文本生视频模型，视频长度可达一分钟。扩散 Transformer 架构（将扩散与 Transformer 结合）证明了可以从图像生成转移到视频生成，暗示了生成式 AI 架构的融合路径。

description.en: Threatened the economics of physical film production, stock footage, and advertising video creation. Tyler Perry halted an $800M studio expansion. The visual effects and advertising industries began reassessing their cost structures. Competitors (Runway, Pika, Adobe, Google) accelerated video generation R&D.
description.zhHans: 威胁了实体电影制作、素材库和广告视频创作的经济模式。Tyler Perry 暂停了 8 亿美元的制片厂扩建。视觉特效和广告行业开始重新评估其成本结构。竞争对手（Runway、Pika、Adobe、Google）加速了视频生成研发。

description.en: Accelerated concerns about AI-generated deepfakes, misinformation through synthetic video, and the erosion of visual evidence in journalism, law, and politics. The 2024 global election year made these concerns especially acute.
description.zhHans: 加速了对 AI 生成深度伪造、通过合成视频传播虚假信息以及在新闻、法律和政治中视觉证据被侵蚀的担忧。2024 年的全球选举年使这些担忧尤为尖锐。

text.en: OpenAI previewed Sora, a text-to-video generation model, on February 15, 2024. The model generates up to one-minute videos from text prompts with photorealistic quality and object permanence.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2024 年 2 月 15 日预览了文本生视频模型 Sora。该模型从文本提示生成长达一分钟的视频，具有逼真的质量和物体持久性。

text.en: Sora represented a 'GPT-1 moment for video'—the first time video generation demonstrated coherent, usable results that suggested scaling alone could unlock further capabilities.
text.zhHans: Sora 代表了"视频的 GPT-1 时刻"——第一次视频生成展示了连贯的、可用的结果，暗示仅靠规模扩展就能解锁更多能力。

sources.quote: The original Sora model from February 2024 was in many ways the GPT‑1 moment for video—the first time video generation started to seem like it was working.

On February 15, 2024, OpenAI first announced Sora with a set of demonstration videos including an SUV driving down a mountain road, a 'short fluffy monster' next to a candle, and two people walking through Tokyo in the snow.

title.en: OpenAI discontinues Sora, marking the first major product shutdown by a frontier AI lab
title.zhHans: OpenAI 关停 Sora，前沿 AI 实验室首次关闭重要产品

searchSummary.en: OpenAI shut down Sora in 2026 — the first time a frontier AI lab killed a major product. How the text-to-video pioneer failed to find product-market fit despite massive hype.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2026 年关停 Sora——前沿 AI 实验室首次关闭重要产品。文生视频的先驱如何在巨大炒作下未能找到产品市场契合。

summary.en: On April 26, 2026, OpenAI discontinued Sora, its text-to-video generation tool, shutting down both the web and app experiences. The shutdown came just over two years after Sora's spectacular February 2024 preview, which had been hailed as a breakthrough in AI video generation. OpenAI cited the high cost of video generation inference, limited product-market fit, and the emergence of more cost-effective competitors (Google's Veo 3, open-source alternatives) as factors. Sora became the first high-profile product casualty of the AI industry's intensifying cost and competition pressures.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 4 月 26 日，OpenAI 终止了其文本生视频工具 Sora，关闭了网页和应用体验。此次关停距离 Sora 在 2024 年 2 月引起轰动的预览仅两年多，当时它被誉为 AI 视频生成的突破。OpenAI 将视频生成推理的高成本、有限的产品市场契合度以及更具成本效益的竞争对手（Google 的 Veo 3、开源替代方案）的出现列为因素。Sora 成为 AI 行业日益加剧的成本和竞争压力下的第一个高调产品牺牲品。

narrative.en: Sora's trajectory from breakthrough demo to shutdown was one of the more instructive stories of the AI boom. When OpenAI previewed Sora in February 2024, the videos were stunning — photorealistic, temporally coherent, and capable of complex scenes. The demo generated enormous hype and was widely interpreted as a paradigm shift in content creation. However, the product struggled in practice. Video generation inference was extremely expensive — each clip required minutes of GPU time. The quality was inconsistent: Sora excelled at certain scenes but produced hallucinations and artifacts unpredictably. Users found the tool hard to control precisely. By 2025, competitors had emerged: Google's Veo 3 integrated directly into YouTube Studio, and open-source video models were improving rapidly. In 2026, a rumored $150 million deal between OpenAI and Disney reportedly fell through, removing a potential lifeline. OpenAI announced Sora's discontinuation in early April, with the shutdown effective April 26. The API access continued until September 24, 2026, for existing customers. The Sora shutdown was notable for what it revealed about the AI industry: even the most hyped demos from the most well-funded lab could fail. It demonstrated that product-market fit mattered as much as technical capability, that inference costs were a real constraint on AI product viability, and that first-mover advantage was no guarantee of success. The shutdown was covered extensively as a symbol that the AI industry's 'everything is possible' phase was giving way to a more disciplined, economics-driven approach.
narrative.zhHans: Sora 从突破性演示到关停的轨迹是 AI 热潮中更有启发性的故事之一。当 OpenAI 在 2024 年 2 月预览 Sora 时，视频令人惊叹——照片般逼真、时间上连贯、能够处理复杂场景。这次演示引发了巨大的炒作，被广泛解释为内容创作的范式转变。然而，该产品在实践中遇到了困难。视频生成推理极其昂贵——每个片段需要数分钟的 GPU 时间。质量不一致：Sora 在某些场景中表现出色，但会产生不可预测的幻觉和伪影。用户发现难以精确控制工具。到 2025 年，竞争对手已经出现：Google 的 Veo 3 直接集成到 YouTube Studio 中，开源视频模型也在快速改进。2026 年，据传 OpenAI 与迪士尼之间价值 1.5 亿美元的协议据报道告吹，带走了一个潜在的救命稻草。OpenAI 在 4 月初宣布终止 Sora，关停于 4 月 26 日生效。API 访问对现有客户持续到 2026 年 9 月 24 日。Sora 的关停之所以引人注目，是因为它揭示了 AI 行业的真相：即使是资金最充足的实验室中最受炒作的演示也可能失败。它证明了产品市场契合度与技术能力同样重要，推理成本是 AI 产品可行性的真正约束，并且先发优势并不能保证成功。这次关停被广泛报道，象征着 AI 行业"一切皆有可能"的阶段正在让位于更自律、以经济为导向的方法。

description.en: Demonstrated that even OpenAI could fail to achieve product-market fit. Highlighted the real cost constraints of video generation AI. Marked a transition from hype-driven product launches to economics-driven product decisions. Influenced investor expectations about AI monetization timelines.
description.zhHans: 证明了即使是 OpenAI 也可能未能实现产品市场契合度。突显了视频生成 AI 的真实成本约束。标志着从炒作驱动的产品发布向经济驱动的产品决策的转变。影响了投资者对 AI 货币化时间线的预期。

text.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2026 年 4 月 26 日终止 Sora——前沿 AI 实验室首次重大 AI 产品关停。

title.en: Stable Diffusion open-sources text-to-image generation to the public
title.zhHans: Stable Diffusion 将文本到图像生成开源给公众

searchSummary.en: Stable Diffusion: the open-source AI image generator released in August 2022 that democratized text-to-image. How a free model changed the AI art landscape forever.
searchSummary.zhHans: Stable Diffusion：2022 年 8 月发布的开源 AI 图像模型，让文生图变得人人可用。了解这个免费模型如何永远改变了 AI 艺术的面貌。

summary.en: Stability AI released Stable Diffusion in August 2022, an open-weight text-to-image model that could generate high-quality images from natural language descriptions on consumer-grade GPUs. Unlike DALL-E 2 (closed API) and Midjourney (proprietary), Stable Diffusion's weights were released publicly, sparking an explosion of community tools, fine-tunes, and creative applications. It transformed AI art from a curiosity into a mass phenomenon practically overnight.
summary.zhHans: Stability AI 于 2022 年 8 月发布了 Stable Diffusion，一个开源的文本到图像模型，可以在消费级 GPU 上从自然语言描述生成高质量图像。与 DALL-E 2（封闭 API）和 Midjourney（专有）不同，Stable Diffusion 的权重公开发布，引发了一波社区工具、微调和创意应用的爆发。它几乎在一夜之间将 AI 艺术从一种新奇事物转变为大众现象。

narrative.en: Stable Diffusion was built on the latent diffusion architecture (Rombach et al., 2022, 'High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models'), a University of Heidelberg / Runway ML collaboration. Stability AI funded the compute resources for training on 256 NVIDIA A100 GPUs. The model was trained on LAION-5B, a massive dataset of 5 billion image-text pairs scraped from the internet. The key innovation was performing the diffusion process in a compressed latent space rather than pixel space, drastically reducing computation. The release of the weights led to an immediate explosion: within weeks, tools like AUTOMATIC1111's web UI, Dreambooth fine-tuning, ControlNet, and LoRAs emerged from the community. The open ecosystem surpassed the quality of closed alternatives within months. The legal and ethical challenges were equally dramatic. Artists filed lawsuits alleging copyright infringement. The European Union, US Copyright Office, and national governments began formulating AI art regulation. The LAION dataset was shown to contain exploitative content, leading to the release of a cleaned version. The cat-and-mouse game between AI-generated content detection and generation began. Stable Diffusion's open-weight release established a new paradigm for AI model distribution: the 'open-weight' model, which became the standard for subsequent releases like Llama (text), Whisper (speech), and YOLO (vision). Its existence made proprietary models negotiable—anyone could run their own inference, diminishing the moat of closed APIs.
narrative.zhHans: Stable Diffusion 基于潜在扩散架构（Rombach 等人，2022 年《High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models》），由海德堡大学和 Runway ML 合作开发。Stability AI 资助了在 256 块 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上训练的计算资源。模型在 LAION-5B 上训练，这是一个包含 50 亿个从互联网抓取的图像-文本对的庞大数据集。关键创新是在压缩的潜在空间而不是像素空间中进行扩散过程，从而大幅降低了计算量。权重的发布立即引发了一场爆发：数周之内，AUTOMATIC1111 的 Web UI、Dreambooth 微调、ControlNet 和 LoRA 等工具从社区中涌现。开放生态系统在数月内超越了封闭替代方案的质量。法律和伦理挑战同样剧烈。艺术家提起诉讼，指控版权侵权。欧盟、美国版权局和各国政府开始制定 AI 艺术法规。LAION 数据集被发现有易受攻击的内容，导致清理后的版本发布。AI 生成内容的检测与生成之间的猫鼠游戏开始了。Stable Diffusion 的开源权重发布建立了一种新的 AI 模型分发范式："开源权重"模型，这成为后续发布的标准，如 Llama（文本）、Whisper（语音）和 YOLO（视觉）。它的存在使专有模型变得可协商——任何人都可以运行自己的推理，削弱了封闭 API 的护城河。

description.en: Open-weight release enabled anyone with a consumer GPU to generate high-quality images from text. Created a rich ecosystem of community tools (AUTOMATIC1111, ComfyUI), fine-tuning techniques (Dreambooth, LoRA), and control methods (ControlNet). Set the 'open-weight' distribution model that became the standard for subsequent foundational models.
description.zhHans: 开源权重发布使任何拥有消费级 GPU 的人都能从文本生成高质量图像。创建了丰富的社区工具生态（AUTOMATIC1111、ComfyUI）、微调技术（Dreambooth、LoRA）和控制方法（ControlNet）。确立了"开源权重"分发模型，成为后续基础模型的标配。

description.en: Disrupted the economics of commercial illustration, stock photography, and graphic design. Artists protested on social media platforms. Services like Shutterstock introduced AI-generated content policies while facing existential threat. The model's training on copyrighted images without consent led to multiple class-action lawsuits.
description.zhHans: 打乱了商业插画、图库摄影和平面设计的经济模式。艺术家在社交媒体平台上抗议。Shutterstock 等服务商被迫引入 AI 生成内容政策，同时面临生存威胁。模型在未经许可的版权图像上训练导致了多起集体诉讼。

description.en: Raised fundamental questions about copyright in AI training data, the right of artists to opt out, and the potential for generating non-consensual imagery. Sparked regulatory discussions worldwide about AI-generated content labeling and accountability.
description.zhHans: 引发了关于 AI 训练数据中版权、艺术家退出权以及生成未经同意图像的可能性的根本问题。引发了全球范围内关于 AI 生成内容标签和责任的监管讨论。

text.en: Stability AI released Stable Diffusion on August 22, 2022, an open-weight text-to-image model based on latent diffusion, trained on 256 A100 GPUs on the LAION-5B dataset.
text.zhHans: Stability AI 于 2022 年 8 月 22 日发布了 Stable Diffusion，一个基于潜在扩散的开源权重文本到图像模型，在 LAION-5B 数据集上用 256 块 A100 GPU 训练。

text.en: Stable Diffusion's open-weight release established a new distribution model for AI foundational models, enabling community-driven innovation and diminishing the moat of closed API-based AI services.
text.zhHans: Stable Diffusion 的开源权重发布为 AI 基础模型建立了新的分发模式，推动了社区驱动的创新，削弱了封闭 API AI 服务的护城河。

sources.quote: Stable Diffusion is a text-to-image model that enables you to create realistic images from text descriptions. The model was trained on 256 Nvidia A100 GPUs.
Stable Diffusion is a deep learning, text-to-image model released in 2022 based on diffusion techniques.

title.en: OpenAI whistleblower Suchir Balaji's death is ruled a suicide, spotlighting AI safety culture
title.zhHans: OpenAI 吹哨人 Suchir Balaji 死亡被裁定为自杀，AI 安全文化受关注

searchSummary.en: Suchir Balaji, an OpenAI whistleblower, was found dead in 2025 — ruled a suicide. The tragedy that sparked debate about AI safety culture and whistleblower protections in tech.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 吹哨人 Suchir Balaji 于 2025 年被发现死亡，裁定为自杀。这场悲剧引发了关于 AI 安全文化和科技行业举报人保护的广泛讨论。

summary.en: On February 14, 2025, the San Francisco medical examiner officially ruled the death of Suchir Balaji, a 26-year-old former OpenAI researcher and whistleblower, as a suicide with no evidence of foul play. Balaji had publicly raised concerns about OpenAI's use of copyrighted training data and its safety practices. His death intensified the debate about whistleblower protections in AI, catalyzed legislative action (California SB 53, federal AI Whistleblower Protection Act), and became a turning point in the discussion about safety culture at frontier AI labs.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 2 月 14 日，旧金山法医正式裁定 26 岁的前 OpenAI 研究员和吹哨人 Suchir Balaji 的死因为自杀，无他杀证据。Balaji 曾公开对 OpenAI 使用受版权保护的训练数据及其安全实践提出担忧。他的死亡加剧了关于 AI 领域吹哨人保护的辩论，推动了立法行动（加州 SB 53、联邦 AI 吹哨人保护法案），并成为关于前沿 AI 实验室安全文化讨论的转折点。

narrative.en: Suchir Balaji was a 26-year-old software engineer who worked at OpenAI from 2020 to 2024. He became a whistleblower in October 2024 when he publicly stated that OpenAI's use of copyrighted data for training ChatGPT likely violated copyright law, contradicting the company's 'fair use' defense. He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment in late November 2024. For weeks, speculation swirled — his family questioned the circumstances, and media coverage intensified. The February 14, 2025 autopsy ruling confirmed suicide, but the controversy did not end there. Balaji's parents continued to raise questions, and the case became a focal point for broader debates about AI safety culture. The Balaji case had direct legislative impact. It was cited by California Governor Newsom when signing SB 53 in September 2025, which included whistleblower protections for AI employees. It also influenced the US Senate's proposed AI Whistleblower Protection Act. In the AI industry, the case prompted soul-searching: multiple AI companies revised their employee non-disparagement agreements and internal reporting channels. The case also highlighted a generational divide: younger AI researchers felt increasingly uncomfortable with the gap between their safety concerns and their employers' rapid deployment priorities.
narrative.zhHans: Suchir Balaji 是一名 26 岁的软件工程师，2020 年至 2024 年在 OpenAI 工作。2024 年 10 月，他公开表示 OpenAI 使用受版权保护的数据训练 ChatGPT 可能违反版权法，与公司的"合理使用"辩护相矛盾，从而成为吹哨人。2024 年 11 月下旬，他被发现死于旧金山的公寓中。数周内，猜测四起——他的家人对情况提出质疑，媒体报道加剧。2025 年 2 月 14 日的尸检裁定确认为自杀，但争议并未就此结束。Balaji 的父母继续提出质疑，此案成为关于 AI 安全文化更广泛辩论的焦点。Balaji 案产生了直接的立法影响。加州州长纽森在 2025 年 9 月签署 SB 53 时引用了此案，该法案包括了对 AI 员工的吹哨人保护。它还影响了美国参议院提议的 AI 吹哨人保护法案。在 AI 行业中，该案引发了反思：多家 AI 公司修订了员工非贬低协议和内部报告渠道。该案还凸显了一代人的分歧：年轻 AI 研究人员对自身安全担忧与雇主快速部署优先之间的差距感到越来越不安。

description.en: Highlighted the vulnerability of AI whistleblowers and the inadequacy of protections. Catalyzed SB 53 whistleblower provisions and federal legislative proposals. Prompted AI companies to revise internal reporting policies. Exposed tension between safety concerns and rapid AI deployment.
description.zhHans: 突显了 AI 吹哨人的脆弱性和保护措施的不足。催化了 SB 53 吹哨人条款和联邦立法提案。促使 AI 公司修订内部报告政策。暴露了安全关切与 AI 快速部署之间的紧张关系。

text.en: The San Francisco medical examiner ruled Suchir Balaji's death a suicide on February 14, 2025, with no evidence of foul play.
text.zhHans: 旧金山法医于 2025 年 2 月 14 日裁定 Suchir Balaji 的死因为自杀，无他杀证据。

sources.quote: Autopsy: No foul play in OpenAI whistleblower's suicide.
Police report officially rules OpenAI whistleblower Suchir Balaji's death a suicide.

title.en: Munich court largely upholds GEMA’s claims against Suno
title.zhHans: 慕尼黑法院基本支持 GEMA 对 Suno 的诉求

searchSummary.en: Munich Regional Court I largely granted GEMA’s claims against Suno over six musical works, while the first-instance judgment remains appealable.
searchSummary.zhHans: 慕尼黑第一地方法院基本支持 GEMA 就六部音乐作品对 Suno 提出的诉求，但一审判决仍可上诉。

summary.en: Munich Regional Court I largely granted GEMA’s injunction, information and damages claims against Suno concerning six musical works. The court’s press release describes findings on training copies, model memorisation and outputs; the first-instance judgment is not final.
summary.zhHans: 慕尼黑第一地方法院基本支持了 GEMA 就六部音乐作品对 Suno 提出的禁令、信息和损害赔偿请求。法院新闻稿说明了有关训练复制、模型记忆和输出的认定；该一审判决尚未生效终局。

narrative.en: The 42nd Civil Chamber found, on the case record before it, that the works were reproducible in Suno’s models and outputs and that the asserted claims were largely justified. The press release discusses both German and US-law questions in the case, as well as the court’s distinction from US cases involving outputs that did not substantially expose training material. The ruling is a concrete copyright-governance event for generative music, but its procedural status and fact-specific findings matter: it is not a final appeal outcome or a universal judicial answer to AI-training disputes.
narrative.zhHans: 第 42 民事庭依据其审理的案卷认定，这些作品能够在 Suno 的模型和输出中被再现，GEMA 提出的诉求大体成立。新闻稿还讨论了本案中的德国法和美国法问题，以及法院为何将本案与训练材料未被实质性暴露在输出中的美国案件区分开来。该裁决是生成式音乐领域一个具体的版权治理事件，但其程序状态和事实特定性同样重要：它不是上诉终局，也不是对 AI 训练争议的普遍司法答案。

description.en: The judgment makes model memorisation and recognisable output reproduction central judicial questions for a commercial generative-music service in this case.
description.zhHans: 在本案中，该判决将模型记忆和可识别输出的再现置于商业生成式音乐服务的核心司法问题之中。

description.en: The decision increases legal and licensing uncertainty for AI-music providers while rights holders and platforms assess its limited but potentially relevant reasoning.
description.zhHans: 在权利人和平台评估其有限但可能相关的推理时，该判决增加了 AI 音乐提供方的法律和许可不确定性。

text.en: On 31 July 2026, Munich Regional Court I’s 42nd Civil Chamber largely granted GEMA’s injunction, information and damages claims against Suno in case 42 O 763/25 concerning six musical works.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 31 日，慕尼黑第一地方法院第 42 民事庭在案号 42 O 763/25 中，就六部音乐作品相关争议，基本支持了 GEMA 对 Suno 提出的禁令、信息和损害赔偿请求。

text.en: The ruling provides a judicial reference point for disputes over model memorisation, training copies and recognisable outputs in generative-music systems, subject to its case-specific record and appeal status.
text.zhHans: 该裁决为围绕生成式音乐系统的模型记忆、训练复制和可识别输出的争议提供了一个司法参照点，但仍受限于本案记录和上诉状态。

text.en: The court’s press release states that the judgment is not final. Its findings concern the six works and the record before the court and should not be generalized into a universal rule for all AI training or outputs.
text.zhHans: 法院新闻稿明确指出该判决尚未生效终局。其认定针对六部作品及法院审理的案卷，不应被泛化为适用于所有 AI 训练或输出的普遍规则。

curatorNote.en: Editorial review completed and publication approved.
curatorNote.zhHans: 编辑审核完成，已批准发布。

title.en: Major record labels sue AI music generators Suno and Udio for copyright infringement
title.zhHans: 主要唱片公司起诉 AI 音乐生成器 Suno 和 Udio 侵犯版权

searchSummary.en: Major record labels sued AI music generators Suno and Udio in 2024 for copyright infringement. The legal battle that could decide the future of AI-generated music.
searchSummary.zhHans: 主要唱片公司 2024 年起诉 AI 音乐生成器 Suno 和 Udio 侵犯版权。这场诉讼可能决定 AI 生成音乐的未来。

summary.en: On June 24, 2024, the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) filed two landmark copyright lawsuits against AI music generation companies Suno and Udio on behalf of Sony Music, Universal Music Group, and Warner Records. The suits alleged that the AI models were trained on copyrighted sound recordings without permission, and marked the first major legal confrontation between the music industry and generative AI. The cases set the template for AI x creative industry copyright disputes globally and led to partial settlements in 2025.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 6 月 24 日，美国唱片业协会（RIAA）代表索尼音乐、环球音乐集团和华纳唱片对 AI 音乐生成公司 Suno 和 Udio 提起了两起里程碑式的版权诉讼。诉讼指控这些 AI 模型在未经许可的情况下使用受版权保护的音乐录音进行训练，标志着音乐产业与生成式 AI 之间的首次重大法律对抗。这些案件为全球 AI 与创意产业版权纠纷设定了模板，并在 2025 年促成了部分和解。

narrative.en: The lawsuits came after a year of explosive growth in AI music generation. Suno and Udio, both launched in 2023-2024, could generate convincing songs from text prompts — complete with vocals, lyrics, and instrumentation in any genre. The technology was so good that generated songs went viral, raising immediate alarm in the record industry. The RIAA's lawsuits were sweeping: they alleged that the AI models had been trained on 'vast swaths' of copyrighted music, including works from artists like Taylor Swift, The Beatles, and Drake. The cases highlighted a fundamental tension that would define AI copyright debates: is training an AI on copyrighted material fair use (as AI companies argued) or infringement (as creators argued)? Suno and Udio took different legal strategies: Suno initially fought the case, while Udio engaged in settlement talks earlier. By late 2025, Universal Music Group settled with Udio, and Warner Music Group reached settlements with both companies. The cases, alongside the NYT v. OpenAI lawsuit, established 2024 as the year the legal framework for generative AI training data began to take shape. The music industry lawsuits particularly resonated because AI-generated music directly threatened the economic model of the recording industry in a way that text generation did not for publishers.
narrative.zhHans: 这些诉讼发生在 AI 音乐生成爆发式增长一年之后。Suno 和 Udio 都在 2023-2024 年推出，能够从文本提示生成令人信服的歌曲——包括人声、歌词和任何流派的编曲。这项技术的质量如此之高，以至于生成的歌曲在网上病毒式传播，立即引起了唱片业的警觉。RIAA 的诉讼影响深远：他们指控这些 AI 模型使用了"大量"受版权保护的音乐进行训练，包括 Taylor Swift、The Beatles 和 Drake 等艺术家的作品。这些案件凸显了将定义 AI 版权辩论的一个根本性紧张关系：在受版权保护的材料上训练 AI 是合理使用（如 AI 公司所主张）还是侵权（如创作者所主张）？Suno 和 Udio 采取了不同的法律策略：Suno 最初积极抗辩，而 Udio 更早参与和解谈判。到 2025 年底，环球音乐集团与 Udio 达成和解，华纳音乐集团与两家公司都达成了和解。这些案件与 NYT 诉 OpenAI 案一起，将 2024 年确立为生成式 AI 训练数据法律框架开始成形的年份。音乐产业诉讼之所以特别引人共鸣，是因为 AI 生成的音乐以文本生成对出版商所没有的方式直接威胁了唱片业的经济模式。

description.en: Threatened the economic model of the recording industry by enabling AI-generated music that competes with human-created songs. The lawsuits became a template for how creative industries could defend their intellectual property against generative AI. Partial settlements in 2025 began establishing licensing norms for AI training data in music.
description.zhHans: 通过使 AI 生成的音乐与人类创作的歌曲竞争，威胁了唱片业的经济模式。这些诉讼成为创意产业如何捍卫其知识产权对抗生成式 AI 的模板。2025 年的部分和解开始为音乐领域的 AI 训练数据建立授权规范。

description.en: Created legal uncertainty for the entire AI music generation sector. Raised questions about whether AI training on copyright-protected creative works is fair use or infringement — a question that remains unresolved.
description.zhHans: 为整个 AI 音乐生成领域带来了法律不确定性。提出了在受版权保护的创意作品上训练 AI 是合理使用还是侵权的问题——这个问题至今未解。

text.en: The RIAA filed copyright infringement lawsuits against Suno and Udio on June 24, 2024, on behalf of Sony Music, Universal Music Group, and Warner Records.
text.zhHans: RIAA 于 2024 年 6 月 24 日代表索尼音乐、环球音乐集团和华纳唱片对 Suno 和 Udio 提起版权侵权诉讼。

title.en: Google open-sources TensorFlow — deep learning becomes accessible
title.zhHans: Google 开源 TensorFlow——深度学习走向普及

searchSummary.en: TensorFlow (2015): Google open-sourced the deep learning framework that became the industry standard. How open-sourcing AI infrastructure accelerated research and adoption worldwide.
searchSummary.zhHans: TensorFlow（2015）：Google 开源了深度学习框架，它成为行业标准。开源 AI 基础设施如何加速了全球的研究和应用。

summary.en: Google releases TensorFlow as an open-source deep learning framework under Apache 2.0 license. It quickly becomes the most widely adopted machine learning library, powering research and production systems across industries.
summary.zhHans: Google 以 Apache 2.0 协议开源 TensorFlow 深度学习框架。它迅速成为最广泛采用的机器学习库，支撑了各行业的研究与生产系统。

narrative.en:
Before TensorFlow, deep learning frameworks were either proprietary (Google's DistBelief, Facebook's early internal tools) or academic projects (Caffe, Theano) with limited production readiness. Researchers shared code through PDFs and ad-hoc scripts.

TensorFlow changed this by combining Google's production-scale engineering with an open, flexible architecture. Its computational graph model, automatic differentiation, Python API, and visualization tool TensorBoard made deep learning accessible to anyone with a laptop. Within a week of launch, it gained over 11,000 GitHub stars.

TensorFlow's open-source release was a pivotal moment: it democratized access to state-of-the-art deep learning tools, accelerated research by enabling reproducible experiments, and established open-source AI infrastructure as the industry norm.
narrative.zhHans:
在 TensorFlow 之前，深度学习框架要么是闭源的（Google 的 DistBelief、Facebook 的内部工具），要么是学术项目（Caffe、Theano），不足以支撑生产环境。研究者通过 PDF 和临时脚本分享代码。

TensorFlow 改变了这一切：它将 Google 的生产级工程能力与开放的灵活架构结合在一起。计算图模型、自动微分、Python API 和可视化工具 TensorBoard 让任何人只要有台笔记本就能做深度学习。上线一周内获得超过 11,000 个 GitHub Star。

TensorFlow 的开源发布是一个转折点：它将最先进的深度学习工具民主化，通过可复现实验加速了研究，并确立了开源 AI 基础设施的行业标准。

description.en: TensorFlow made deep learning tools accessible to anyone, from students to startups to enterprise teams.
description.zhHans: TensorFlow 让任何人都能使用深度学习工具——从学生到初创公司再到企业团队。

description.en: Enabled reproducible deep learning research and scalable production deployments across industries.
description.zhHans: 使深度学习研究可复现，并支撑各行业的大规模生产部署。

description.en: Open-source AI infrastructure lowered barriers to entry, accelerating the AI startup ecosystem.
description.zhHans: 开源 AI 基础设施降低了进入门槛，加速了 AI 创业生态。

text.zhHans: TensorFlow 于 2015 年 11 月 9 日以 Apache 2.0 协议开源发布。

text.zhHans: TensorFlow 上线第一周获得超过 11,000 个 GitHub Star。

title.en: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab releases Inkling, its first AI model — a 975B open-weights multimodal model
title.zhHans: Mira Murati 创立的 Thinking Machines Lab 发布首个 AI 模型 Inkling——975B 参数开源权重多模态模型

searchSummary.en: Thinking Machines Lab, the AI startup founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, released its first model Inkling on July 15, 2026. The 975B-parameter open-weights MoE model (41B active) accepts text, image, and audio inputs, with a 1M-token context window. Valued at $12B, the company positions Inkling as a customizable enterprise alternative to rented frontier APIs.
searchSummary.zhHans: 由前 OpenAI CTO Mira Murati 创立的 AI 初创公司 Thinking Machines Lab 于 2026 年 7 月 15 日发布其首个模型 Inkling。该模型为 975B 参数开源权重 MoE（410 亿活跃），接受文本、图像和音频输入，上下文窗口达 100 万 token。公司估值 $12B，将 Inkling 定位为可定制的企业级替代方案，挑战租赁式前沿 API。

summary.en: On July 15, 2026, Thinking Machines Lab — the AI startup founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati — released Inkling, its first in-house AI model. Inkling is a Mixture-of-Experts transformer with 975 billion total parameters (41 billion active), a 1-million-token context window, and text, image, and audio inputs. Its pretraining corpus included 45 trillion tokens spanning text, images, audio, and video; that does not mean the released model accepts video as an input modality. The model is open-weights under Apache 2.0. At a $12 billion valuation following a $6.3 billion compute deal with CoreWeave, Thinking Machines Lab entered the frontier competition with a differentiated thesis: enterprises want AI they can customize, not just rent from a handful of labs.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 15 日，由前 OpenAI CTO Mira Murati 创立的 AI 初创公司 Thinking Machines Lab 发布了首个自研模型 Inkling。Inkling 是混合专家（MoE）Transformer，总参数 9750 亿（活跃参数 410 亿），上下文窗口为 100 万 token，接受文本、图像和音频输入。其预训练语料包含 45 万亿 token，覆盖文本、图像、音频和视频；这并不表示发布版模型支持视频输入。该模型以 Apache 2.0 许可证开放权重。在估值 $12B、并与 CoreWeave 达成 $6.3B 算力交易后，Thinking Machines Lab 以“企业需要可定制 AI，而不只是租用少数实验室 API”的定位进入前沿竞争。

narrative.en: Thinking Machines Lab was founded in 2025 by Mira Murati, OpenAI's former Chief Technology Officer, along with several other former OpenAI researchers and engineers. The company argues that renting API access from a small number of frontier labs leaves enterprise customers with limited control, customization, and transparency. Inkling is its first public model built around an alternative: open weights that customers can fine-tune and deploy. The architecture is a sparse 975B MoE with 41B active parameters, and the model accepts text, image, and audio inputs. Its 45-trillion-token pretraining corpus also included video. Early benchmark comparisons place it among current frontier systems on some tasks, but those provider-reported results still require independent replication. The July 15 release also arrived during a rapid fall in frontier-model API prices, making the long-term economics of self-hosting versus rented APIs an open question rather than a settled advantage.
narrative.zhHans: Thinking Machines Lab 由 OpenAI 前 CTO Mira Murati 与数位前 OpenAI 研究员和工程师于 2025 年共同创立。公司认为，从少数前沿实验室租用 API 会限制企业客户的控制权、定制能力和透明度。Inkling 是其围绕另一条路线发布的首个公开模型：开放权重，允许客户微调和部署。其架构为稀疏 975B MoE，活跃参数 41B，接受文本、图像和音频输入；45 万亿 token 的预训练语料还包含视频。早期基准比较显示它在部分任务上进入当前前沿系统区间，但这些由提供方报告的结果仍需独立复现。7 月 15 日发布时，前沿模型 API 价格也在快速下降，因此自托管与租赁 API 的长期经济性仍是开放问题，而非已经确定的优势。

title.en: "Attention Is All You Need" — the Transformer architecture is born
title.zhHans: 《Attention Is All You Need》——Transformer 架构诞生

searchSummary.en: Attention Is All You Need: the 2017 paper that introduced the Transformer. Cited 250K+ times, it founded GPT, BERT, AlphaFold, and all modern AI.
searchSummary.zhHans: 《Attention Is All You Need》：2017 年论文将 Transformer 架构带入了世界。被引 25 万次，GPT、BERT、AlphaFold 乃至所有现代 AI 都源于它。完整时间线。

summary.en: Eight Google researchers published 'Attention Is All You Need' at NeurIPS 2017, introducing the Transformer architecture. By dispensing with recurrence and convolution entirely and relying solely on self-attention mechanisms, the Transformer achieved state-of-the-art translation results while training significantly faster. The paper has been cited over 250,000 times, and the Transformer became the foundation of every major AI system since—from GPT and BERT to AlphaFold and modern speech models.
summary.zhHans: 八位 Google 研究者在 NeurIPS 2017 上发表了《Attention Is All You Need》，引入了 Transformer 架构。通过完全摒弃循环和卷积、仅依赖自注意力机制，Transformer 在实现最先进翻译结果的同时大幅加快了训练速度。这篇论文已被引用超过 25 万次，Transformer 成为此后每一个主要 AI 系统的基础——从 GPT 和 BERT 到 AlphaFold 再到现代语音模型。

narrative.en: Before Transformer, the dominant approach to sequence processing was recurrent neural networks (RNNs, LSTMs) or convolutional models. Both had fundamental limitations: RNNs processed tokens sequentially, making parallelization impossible; CNNs had limited context windows. The Transformer solved both problems with a single mechanism: self-attention. Every token in a sequence could attend to every other token simultaneously, enabling parallel training across entire sequences. The key architectural components—scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, positional encoding, and layer normalization—have proven remarkably durable. The paper's title itself became legendary for its audacity. Seven years later, 'Attention Is All You Need' stands as one of the most-cited papers of the 21st century. All eight authors have since left Google to found or join prominent AI companies: Ashish Vaswani and Niki Parmar (Essential AI), Noam Shazeer (Character.AI), Jakob Uszkoreit (Inceptive), Llion Jones (Sakana AI), Aidan Gomez (Cohere), Lukasz Kaiser (OpenAI), and Illia Polosukhin (NEAR Protocol). The Transformer's architectural innovations enabled the scaling laws that GPT-3, PaLM, and Claude exploited. Its attention patterns proved so general that they were adapted for vision (Vision Transformer, 2020), protein folding (AlphaFold's Evoformer), reinforcement learning (Decision Transformer), and multimodal models (Flamingo, GPT-4). The architecture was a gift that kept giving—each new domain that adopted it found unexpected gains.
narrative.zhHans: 在 Transformer 之前，处理序列的主导方法是循环神经网络（RNN、LSTM）或卷积模型。两者都有根本性局限：RNN 按顺序处理标记，无法并行化；CNN 的上下文窗口有限。Transformer 用单一机制解决了这两个问题：自注意力。序列中的每个标记可以同时关注每一个其他标记，实现了跨整个序列的并行训练。其关键架构组件——缩放点积注意力、多头注意力、位置编码和层归一化——已被证明具有非凡的持久性。论文的标题本身就因其大胆而成为传奇。七年之后，《Attention Is All You Need》是 21 世纪被引用最多的论文之一。所有八位作者此后都离开 Google 创立或加入了知名的 AI 公司：Ashish Vaswani 和 Niki Parmar（Essential AI）、Noam Shazeer（Character.AI）、Jakob Uszkoreit（Inceptive）、Llion Jones（Sakana AI）、Aidan Gomez（Cohere）、Lukasz Kaiser（OpenAI）和 Illia Polosukhin（NEAR Protocol）。Transformer 的架构创新使 GPT-3、PaLM 和 Claude 利用的缩放定律成为可能。其注意力模式被证明如此通用，以至于被适配到计算机视觉（Vision Transformer, 2020）、蛋白质折叠（AlphaFold 的 Evoformer）、强化学习（Decision Transformer）和多模态模型（Flamingo、GPT-4）。这个架构是一个持续给予的礼物——每个采用它的新领域都发现了意想不到的增益。

description.en: Replaced RNNs and CNNs as the dominant sequence-processing architecture across NLP, vision, speech, and biology. The self-attention mechanism proved so general and scalable that it became the universal compute substrate for modern AI—every major AI system since 2018 (BERT, GPT series, Claude, Gemini, AlphaFold) uses Transformers at its core.
description.zhHans: 替代了 RNN 和 CNN 成为 NLP、视觉、语音和生物学中主导的序列处理架构。自注意力机制被证明如此通用和可扩展，以至于成为现代 AI 的通用计算基板——2018 年以来每个主要 AI 系统（BERT、GPT 系列、Claude、Gemini、AlphaFold）都以 Transformer 为核心。

description.en: Enabled the scaling laws that led to GPT-3, ChatGPT, and all subsequent large language models. The authors collectively founded or joined companies now worth tens of billions (Cohere, Character.AI, Essential AI). The architecture's parallelizability made GPU/TPU training efficient at unprecedented scale, directly shaping the modern AI hardware market.
description.zhHans: 使导致了 GPT-3、ChatGPT 和所有后续大语言模型的缩放定律成为可能。作者们集体创立或加入了现在估值数百亿美元的公司（Cohere、Character.AI、Essential AI）。该架构的并行性使 GPU/TPU 训练在前所未有的规模上保持高效，直接塑造了现代 AI 硬件市场。

description.en: 'Attention Is All You Need' became a scientific meme. Its audacious title captured a truth that proved deeper than the authors knew: attention was sufficient not just for translation, but for vision, protein folding, reasoning, and generation. The paper marks the clearest 'before and after' line in modern AI research methodology.
description.zhHans: 《Attention Is All You Need》成为一个科学 meme。它大胆的标题捕捉到了一个比作者们所知的更深刻的真理：注意力不仅对翻译足够，对视觉、蛋白质折叠、推理和生成也足够。这篇论文标志着现代 AI 研究方法论中最清晰的"之前和之后"的分界线。

text.en: Vaswani et al. published 'Attention Is All You Need' at NeurIPS 2017, introducing the Transformer architecture based solely on self-attention mechanisms.
text.zhHans: Vaswani 等人在 NeurIPS 2017 上发表了《Attention Is All You Need》，引入了完全基于自注意力机制的 Transformer 架构。

text.en: The Transformer architecture became the foundation of every major AI system after 2018, including GPT, BERT, AlphaFold, and Vision Transformer. As of 2026, the paper has been cited over 250,000 times, making it one of the most-cited papers of the 21st century.
text.zhHans: Transformer 架构成为 2018 年后每一个主要 AI 系统的基础，包括 GPT、BERT、AlphaFold 和 Vision Transformer。截至 2026 年，这篇论文已被引用超过 25 万次，成为 21 世纪被引用最多的论文之一。

title.en: Alan Turing publishes "Computing Machinery and Intelligence", proposing what becomes the Turing Test
title.zhHans: Alan Turing 发表《计算机器与智能》，提出后来被称为图灵测试的思想实验

searchSummary.en: Alan Turing’s 1950 paper proposed the Imitation Game — the first test for machine intelligence. How a simple question started the field of AI.
searchSummary.zhHans: 艾伦·图灵 1950 年论文提出了「模仿游戏」——第一个机器智能测试。了解一个简单问题如何开创了整个 AI 领域。

summary.en: Alan Turing published his landmark paper in Mind, proposing the "Imitation Game"—a test to determine whether machines can think. Rather than defining "thinking" philosophically, Turing framed intelligence as a behavioral question: can a machine converse well enough to be indistinguishable from a human? This paper is widely regarded as the philosophical foundation of artificial intelligence.
summary.zhHans: 艾伦·图灵在哲学期刊 Mind 上发表里程碑论文《计算机器与智能》，提出用"模仿游戏"（后称图灵测试）来判断机器是否能思考。图灵不纠缠"思考"的哲学定义，而是将智能转化为可操作的行为问题：机器能否在对话中让人无法分辨？这篇论文被公认为人工智能的哲学奠基之作。

narrative.en: Turing's 28-page paper appeared in the October 1950 issue of Mind. It opens with a deceptively simple question: "Can machines think?" Turing immediately sets this aside as "too meaningless to deserve discussion" and replaces it with a concrete, testable alternative—the Imitation Game. In this game, a human interrogator converses with two hidden participants (one human, one machine) and tries to identify which is which. If the machine can fool the interrogator as often as a human can, Turing argued, we have no good reason to deny it is thinking. The paper also anticipated and refuted nine major objections to machine intelligence—from theological arguments to the "mathematical objection" based on Gödel's incompleteness theorems. Remarkably, Turing predicted that by the year 2000, computers with 10^9 bits of storage would be able to play the imitation game well enough that an average interrogator would have no more than a 70% chance of correct identification after five minutes of questioning. While his timeline was too optimistic, the core paradigm he established—judging intelligence by performance rather than by internal mechanism—has shaped all subsequent AI research. The paper has since become one of the most cited and referenced philosophical works ever published, influencing not only computer science but also epistemology, cognitive science, and the philosophy of mind.
narrative.zhHans: 图灵的 28 页论文发表于 1950 年 10 月号的 Mind。开篇以一个看似简单的问题切入："机器能思考吗？"图灵随即将其搁置，认为这个问题"太过无意义不值得讨论"，转而提出一个具体的、可检验的替代方案——模仿游戏。游戏中，一个人类审问者与两个隐藏的参与者（一个人类、一个机器）通过文本对话交流，试图判断谁是谁。如果机器能像人类一样频繁地骗过审问者，图灵认为我们没有理由否认它在思考。论文还预见并反驳了对机器智能的九种主要反对意见——从神学论证到基于哥德尔不完备定理的"数学反对"。图灵惊人地预测：到 2000 年，拥有 10^9 位存储容量的计算机将能玩好模仿游戏，让普通审问者在五分钟提问后正确识别的概率不超过 70%。虽然时间线过于乐观，但他建立的核心范式——通过表现而非内部机制来判断智能——塑造了此后所有 AI 研究。这篇论文已成为有史以来被引用和讨论最多的哲学文献之一，不仅影响计算机科学，也影响认识论、认知科学和心灵哲学。

description.en: Transformed the question of machine intelligence from abstract philosophy into an operational, testable framework. The behavioral criterion replaced essentialist debates about what "thinking" means, defining the fundamental research question for 70+ years of AI.
description.zhHans: 将机器智能的问题从抽象哲学转变为可操作的、可检验的框架。行为标准取代了关于"思考"本质的本质主义辩论，定义了此后 70 余年 AI 研究的基本问题方向。

description.en: Established natural language dialogue as the benchmark for machine intelligence, a standard that remains central to NLP research and has directly influenced the design goals of modern language models from ELIZA to GPT-4.
description.zhHans: 确立了自然语言对话作为机器智能的基准，这一标准至今仍是 NLP 研究的核心目标，并直接影响从 ELIZA 到 GPT-4 的现代语言模型的设计方向。

description.en: The behavioral criterion alone proved insufficient: John Searle's Chinese Room Argument (1980) demonstrated that passing the Turing Test does not guarantee genuine understanding or consciousness. This created an enduring philosophical debate about whether behavioral tests can adequately measure intelligence, with implications for AI safety and ethics.
description.zhHans: 仅靠行为标准被证明不足：John Searle 的中文屋论证（1980）表明通过图灵测试不保证真正的理解或意识。这创造了关于行为测试是否能充分衡量智能的持久哲学辩论，对 AI 安全和伦理产生深远影响。

text.en: Alan Turing published "Computing Machinery and Intelligence" in the October 1950 issue of Mind, volume 49, pages 433-460.
text.zhHans: 艾伦·图灵于 1950 年 10 月在 Mind 杂志第 49 卷发表《计算机器与智能》，第 433-460 页。

text.en: Turing's paper shifted the question of machine intelligence from philosophical definitions of "thinking" to a behavioral, falsifiable test—a framework that all subsequent AI research follows.
text.zhHans: 图灵的论文将机器智能问题从"思考"的哲学定义转向行为性的、可证伪的测试——这一框架被此后所有 AI 研究所遵循。

text.en: John Searle's Chinese Room Argument (1980) demonstrated that passing a behavioral test does not prove genuine understanding, exposing a fundamental limitation in the Turing Test as a measure of intelligence.
text.zhHans: John Searle 的中文屋论证（1980）表明通过行为测试不能证明真正的理解，揭示了图灵测试作为智能衡量标准的根本局限。

sources.quote: I propose to consider the question, 'Can machines think?'
The Turing test became a cornerstone in the philosophy and science of artificial intelligence.
The test remains an influential concept in AI and the philosophy of intelligence.
The Chinese Room Argument holds that a computer executing a program cannot have a mind, understanding, or consciousness.

title.en: 'Vibe coding' is coined, capturing a new paradigm of AI-assisted programming
title.zhHans: 'Vibe coding' 一词诞生，概括了 AI 辅助编程的新范式

searchSummary.en: ‘Vibe coding’ — coined by Andrej Karpathy in 2025 — captured the new paradigm where AI does the coding and humans guide with natural language. The term that defined a shift.
searchSummary.zhHans: 「Vibe coding」一词由 Andrej Karpathy 在 2025 年提出，概括了 AI 代写代码、人类用自然语言引导的新编程范式。这个定义了时代转变的词。

summary.en: On February 2, 2025, AI researcher Andrej Karpathy coined the term 'vibe coding' in a viral tweet, describing a new programming paradigm where developers describe tasks to LLMs and accept generated code without thorough review. The term quickly entered mainstream vocabulary, was named Collins Dictionary Word of the Year 2025, and was listed by Merriam-Webster. It crystallized a profound shift: AI had transformed coding from a craft of precise syntax into a conversation of intent.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 2 月 2 日，AI 研究员 Andrej Karpathy 在一条病毒式推文中创造了"vibe coding"一词，描述了一种新的编程范式：开发者向大语言模型描述任务，接受生成的代码而不经过彻底审查。该词迅速进入主流词汇，被《柯林斯英语词典》评为 2025 年度词汇，并被《韦氏词典》收录。它凝固了一个深刻的转变：AI 将编码从精确语法的工艺转变为意图的对话。

narrative.en: On February 2, 2025, Andrej Karpathy — co-founder of OpenAI and former AI lead at Tesla — posted a tweet that gave a name to a phenomenon millions of developers were already experiencing: 'There's a new kind of coding I call "vibe coding," where you fully give in to the vibes, embrace exponentials, and forget that the code even exists.' He described how with tools like Cursor Composer and SuperWhisper, he barely touched the keyboard: 'I "Accept All" always, I don't read the diffs anymore. When I get error messages I just copy paste them in with no comment, usually that fixes it.' The tweet went viral instantly. Within days, 'vibe coding' was being discussed in developer communities, tech media, and mainstream publications. The New York Times ran experiments with it. Simon Willison offered a nuanced counterpoint: 'If an LLM wrote every line of your code, but you've reviewed, tested, and understood it all, that's not vibe coding... that's using an LLM as a typing assistant.' The term captured a real shift in software engineering practice. It wasn't just a meme — it described an emerging reality where AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) had become so capable that many developers were producing working software without fully understanding the generated code. By year's end, vibe coding was named Collins Dictionary Word of the Year 2025 and listed by Merriam-Webster as a 'slang & trending' term. The concept resonated because it wasn't about technology alone — it was about a cultural reckoning with what it means to 'code' when the machines write the code and humans guide the intent. It joined 'prompt engineering' and 'hallucination' as the linguistic artifacts of the AI era.
narrative.zhHans: 2025 年 2 月 2 日，OpenAI 联合创始人、前特斯拉 AI 负责人 Andrej Karpathy 发了一条推文，为数百万开发者已经在经历的现象命了名："有一种新的编程方式，我叫它'vibe coding'，你完全沉浸在氛围中，拥抱指数级增长，忘记代码的存在。"他描述了使用 Cursor Composer 和 SuperWhisper 等工具时，他几乎不碰键盘："我永远选'全部接受'，不再读 diff 了。报错了我直接复制粘贴不加注释，通常就能修好。"该推文立即病毒式传播。几天之内，"vibe coding"就在开发者社区、科技媒体和主流出版物中被广泛讨论。《纽约时报》做了实验。Simon Willison 提出了一个微妙的观点："如果 LLM 写了你的每一行代码，但你审查、测试并理解了它们，那对我来说不是 vibe coding——那是把 LLM 当打字助手。"这个词捕捉到了软件工程实践中的真实转变。它不仅仅是一个梗——它描述了一个正在出现的现实：AI 编程工具（GitHub Copilot、Cursor、Claude Code、Codex）已经变得如此强大，许多开发者在不完全理解所生成代码的情况下生产着可工作软件。到年底，vibe coding 被《柯林斯英语词典》评为 2025 年度词汇，并被《韦氏词典》列为"俚语与趋势"词。这个概念之所以引起共鸣，因为它不仅关乎技术——它是关于当机器写代码、人类引导意图时，"编程"意味着什么的文化清算。它加入了"提示工程"和"幻觉"的行列，成为 AI 时代的语言制品。

description.en: Gave language to a profound shift in programming practice. Named Collins Word of the Year 2025 and listed by Merriam-Webster. Crystallized the transformation of software engineering from precise syntax manipulation to intent-driven AI collaboration.
description.zhHans: 为编程实践中的深刻变革赋予了语言。被《柯林斯英语词典》评为 2025 年度词汇，被《韦氏词典》收录。凝固了软件工程从精确语法操作向意图驱动的 AI 协作的转变。

text.en: Andrej Karpathy coined the term 'vibe coding' in a tweet on February 2, 2025. The term was named Collins Dictionary Word of the Year 2025 and listed by Merriam-Webster.
text.zhHans: Andrej Karpathy 于 2025 年 2 月 2 日在推文中创造了'vibe coding'一词。该术语被《柯林斯英语词典》评为 2025 年度词汇，并被《韦氏词典》收录。

sources.quote: The term was coined in February 2025 by computer scientist Andrej Karpathy. It was named the Collins English Dictionary Word of the Year for 2025.
There's a new kind of coding I call 'vibe coding'.

title.en: IBM Watson defeats human champions on Jeopardy!
title.zhHans: IBM Watson 在 Jeopardy! 上击败人类冠军

searchSummary.en: IBM Watson defeats Jeopardy! champions Ken Jennings and Brad Rutter in 2011. How a question-answering AI system proved machines could understand natural language.
searchSummary.zhHans: IBM Watson 于 2011 年在《危险边缘》中击败人类冠军。一个问答 AI 系统证明了机器可以理解自然语言。

summary.en: On February 16, 2011, IBM's Watson supercomputer defeated all-time Jeopardy! champions Ken Jennings and Brad Rutter across three episodes. Watson used natural language processing and information retrieval over 200 million pages of content, demonstrating that machines could handle the ambiguity of natural language at human-comparable levels in a constrained domain.
summary.zhHans: 2011 年 2 月 16 日，IBM 的 Watson 超级计算机在三期节目中击败了 Jeopardy! 历史总冠军 Ken Jennings 和 Brad Rutter。Watson 使用自然语言处理和检索技术，在 2 亿页内容上进行实时分析，证明了机器可以在受限领域以接近人类的水平处理自然语言的模糊性。

narrative.en: Jeopardy! is significantly harder for computers than chess. The clues require parsing puns, wordplay, indirect references, and cultural knowledge across an unbounded range of topics. Watson, developed by IBM Research under David Ferrucci, ran on 90 IBM Power 750 servers (2,880 processor cores) and was never connected to the internet during the match. It processed natural language questions in seconds, ranked its confidence across millions of possible answers, and triggered a physical buzzer mechanism to compete with the speed of human reflexes. The match was broadcast over three nights (February 14-16, 2011) and watched by millions. Watson won with $77,147, with Jennings at $24,000 and Rutter at $21,600. One memorable moment: Watson answered in a category about 'U.S. Cities' with 'What is Toronto?'—demonstrating the system's limitations in understanding geographic context. IBM pledged never to use Watson for weaponry and instead commercialized it for healthcare (tumor diagnosis), financial services, and customer service. However, Watson Health failed to deliver on its promises and was shut down in 2022, becoming a cautionary tale about overhyping AI capabilities. Despite the limited commercial outcome, the Jeopardy! victory served as a bridge between Deep Blue's narrow symbolic strength and the deep learning breakthroughs that followed.
narrative.zhHans: Jeopardy! 对计算机而言比国际象棋困难得多。线索需要解析双关语、文字游戏、间接引用以及跨无限主题的文化知识。Watson 由 IBM 研究院 David Ferrucci 领导开发，运行在 90 台 IBM Power 750 服务器（2,880 个处理器核心）上，比赛期间从未接入互联网。它在几秒钟内处理自然语言问题，对数百万个可能答案进行置信度排序，并触动物理蜂鸣器机制以与人类反应速度竞争。比赛在三晚（2011 年 2 月 14-16 日）播出，数百万人观看。Watson 以 $77,147 获胜，Jennings $24,000，Rutter $21,600。一个令人难忘的时刻：Watson 在一个关于"美国城市"的类别中回答了"多伦多是什么？"——展示了系统在地理上下文理解方面的局限。IBM 承诺绝不为武器用途使用 Watson，而是将其商业化用于医疗（肿瘤诊断）、金融服务和客户服务。然而，Watson Health 未能兑现其承诺，于 2022 年关停，成为过度炒作 AI 能力的警示故事。尽管商业成果有限，Jeopardy! 的胜利仍然架起了深蓝的窄域符号方法到后续深度学习突破之间的桥梁。

description.en: Demonstrated that NLP + information retrieval could parse natural language ambiguity in a competitive real-time setting. However, the approach (hand-engineered features, massive compute, no real learning) proved to be a dead end compared to deep learning alternatives that emerged shortly after.
description.zhHans: 证明了自然语言处理与信息检索结合可以在竞争性的实时环境中解析自然语言的模糊性。然而，其方法（手工设计特征、大规模计算、没有真正的学习能力）被随后出现的深度学习替代方案证明是死胡同。

description.en: Publicly demonstrated that machines could compete with humans on general knowledge quizzes involving natural language understanding. Shifted public perception from 'AI can play chess' to 'AI can answer any question.'
description.zhHans: 公开展示了机器可以在涉及自然语言理解的一般知识问答中与人类竞争。将公众认知从"AI 能下国际象棋"推进到"AI 能回答任何问题"。

text.en: IBM Watson defeated Jeopardy! champions Ken Jennings and Brad Rutter across three episodes broadcast February 14-16, 2011, winning $77,147.
text.zhHans: IBM Watson 在 2011 年 2 月 14-16 日播出的三期节目中击败了 Jeopardy! 冠军 Ken Jennings 和 Brad Rutter，赢得 $77,147。

text.en: Watson was commercialized for healthcare, financial services, and customer service, but Watson Health was shut down in 2022 after failing to meet expectations.
text.zhHans: Watson 被商业化用于医疗、金融服务和客户服务，但 Watson Health 在未能达到预期后于 2022 年关停。

sources.quote: Watson defeated the two most celebrated champions in Jeopardy! history—Ken Jennings and Brad Rutter—in a three-day event.
IBM has spent years trying to make its Watson technology a business success. The results have been mixed.

changeLog.summary: Initial v2 entry for Watson Jeopardy! victory.

title.en: xAI challenges Minnesota's AI nudification law in federal court
title.zhHans: xAI 在联邦法院挑战明尼苏达州 AI 裸化法

searchSummary.en: xAI files a federal lawsuit challenging Minnesota HF 1606, a law that imposes obligations and penalties on services used to create AI-generated intimate-part images.
searchSummary.zhHans: xAI 提起联邦诉讼，挑战明尼苏达州 HF 1606；该法对被用于生成 AI 裸化图像的服务设定义务和处罚。

summary.en: xAI filed a federal lawsuit on July 27, 2026, challenging Minnesota HF 1606 before its August 1 effective date. The official bill text prohibits covered services from enabling or performing AI nudification and provides civil remedies and penalties; xAI alleges that the law is an overbroad, content-based restriction. The filing is a legal milestone, not a court ruling. On July 31, the court declined emergency interim relief and set a later preliminary-injunction hearing without deciding the merits.
summary.zhHans: xAI 于 2026 年 7 月 27 日提起联邦诉讼，在明尼苏达州 HF 1606 于 8 月 1 日生效前提出挑战。官方法案文本禁止相关服务允许或执行 AI 裸化，并规定民事救济和处罚；xAI 则主张该法构成过宽的内容限制。这是法律程序节点，不是法院裁决。7 月 31 日，法院拒绝了紧急临时救济，并在未裁决实体问题的情况下安排后续预先禁令听证。

narrative.en: Minnesota House File 1606 prohibits an owner or operator of a website, application, software or other service from allowing users to access, download or use the service to nudify an image or video, or from performing the act on a user's behalf. The text includes a technical-skill exemption, a private civil action and a civil penalty of up to $500,000 for each unlawful access, download or use. xAI's complaint challenges the law under the First and Fourteenth Amendments and argues that liability can attach without intent, knowledge or bad faith. The case places platform design, content moderation and state regulation of synthetic intimate imagery in the same legal dispute. Its outcome and the effect on Grok Imagine remain unresolved. On July 31, the court denied the request for a temporary restraining order before the law took effect, citing the timing of the motion, and set an August 19 preliminary-injunction hearing. That order left the merits unresolved.
narrative.zhHans: 明尼苏达州众议院第 1606 号法案禁止网站、应用、软件或其他服务的所有者或运营者允许用户访问、下载或使用服务来裸化图像或视频，也禁止服务代用户执行该行为。法案包含技术技能例外、私人民事诉讼权，以及每次违法访问、下载或使用最高 500,000 美元的民事处罚。xAI 的诉状依据第一和第十四修正案挑战该法，并主张即使没有意图、知情或恶意也可能承担责任。该案把平台设计、内容审核以及州政府对合成私密图像的监管放进同一场法律争议中。案件结果和对 Grok Imagine 的影响仍未确定。7 月 31 日，法院以动议提出时机为由驳回了法律生效前的临时禁令请求，并将预先禁令听证定在 8 月 19 日；实体问题仍未解决。

description.en: The case tests whether state law can impose direct platform obligations for synthetic intimate imagery and how those obligations interact with constitutional protections.
description.zhHans: 该案检验州法能否为合成私密图像直接规定平台义务，以及这些义务如何与宪法保护发生关系。

description.en: The dispute exposes platforms to potentially large liability while the law's definitions, exemptions and enforcement boundaries are tested in court.
description.zhHans: 争议使平台面临潜在的高额责任，同时法案的定义、例外和执行边界将由法院检验。

text.en: xAI filed a federal lawsuit on July 27, 2026 challenging Minnesota HF 1606, which is scheduled to take effect on August 1, 2026.
text.zhHans: xAI 于 2026 年 7 月 27 日提起联邦诉讼，挑战计划于 2026 年 8 月 1 日生效的明尼苏达州 HF 1606。

text.en: The filing creates a legal test for platform liability, synthetic intimate imagery regulation and the boundary between state safety rules and constitutional protections.
text.zhHans: 该诉讼为平台责任、合成私密图像监管，以及州安全规则与宪法保护之间的边界创造了法律检验。

text.en: Because the statute is scheduled to take effect before the dispute is resolved, the case may become an early test of whether platforms change product access or moderation for particular states under legal pressure.
text.zhHans: 由于法案计划在争议解决前生效，该案可能成为平台是否会在法律压力下针对特定州改变产品访问或审核方式的早期检验。

text.en: The constitutional objections are allegations in xAI's complaint, not findings by the court; the statute also contains a technical-skill exemption that affects how its scope should be described.
text.zhHans: 宪法方面的异议是 xAI 诉状中的主张，而不是法院认定；法案还包含技术技能例外，这会影响对其适用范围的表述。

text.en: On July 31, 2026, the federal court denied xAI’s request for a temporary restraining order before the law took effect and set an August 19 hearing on the preliminary-injunction motion; the order did not decide the merits of the challenge.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 31 日，联邦法院驳回了 xAI 在法律生效前申请临时禁令的请求，并将预先禁令动议的听证排定在 8 月 19 日；该命令没有裁决挑战的实体问题。
